taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver (SKY130)
* Architecture:
*   - Input buffer -> two RC-delay non-overlap paths (turn-on delayed, turn-off fast)
*   - Level shifter 1 (5V NMOS pulldowns + cross-coupled 5V PMOS) -> floating GN driver
*   - Level shifter 2 -> bootstrap charge PMOS gate (charges only while low side is on)
*   - Charge PMOS VDD->VBST pad; damping resistor VBST pad -> internal boot rail bsti
*   - On-chip boot cap (MOS cap) bsti-VSW; VLX-VSW on-chip short (always-on NMOS)
* All multiplicities use m= with nf=1 and w<=7 so area = W*L*nf*m matches layout.
.param cboot=10n

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---------------- input buffer (VDD/VSS domain) ----------------
XIN1P inb IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XIN1N inb IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5
XIN2P ini inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6
XIN2N ini inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3

* ---------------- high-side turn-on delay (RC) ----------------
XDA1P a1 ini VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XDA1N a1 ini VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XR1 a1 y1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.5 l=20
XC1 y1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=15
XDR1P hsdly y1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XDR1N hsdly y1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
* NAND(ini, hsdly) -> hsonb ; INV -> hson  (delayed turn-on, fast turn-off)
XNA1P1 hsonb ini VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XNA1P2 hsonb hsdly VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XNA1N1 hsonb ini na1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XNA1N2 na1 hsdly VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XHO1P hson hsonb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XHO1N hson hsonb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2

* ---------------- low-side turn-on delay (RC) ----------------
XDB1P b2 inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XDB1N b2 inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XR2 b2 y2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.5 l=30
XC2 y2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=15
XDR2P lsdly y2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XDR2N lsdly y2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
* NAND(inb, lsdly) -> lsonb ; INV -> lson
XNA2P1 lsonb inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XNA2P2 lsonb lsdly VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XNA2N1 lsonb inb na2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XNA2N2 na2 lsdly VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XLO1P lson lsonb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6
XLO1N lson lsonb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3

* ---------------- low-side gate driver chain (GN2 = lson) ----------------
XL1P g2a lson VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=2
XL1N g2a lson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6
XL2P g2b g2a VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=8
XL2N g2b g2a VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=4
XL3P g2c g2b VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=20
XL3N g2c g2b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=10
XL4P GN2 g2c VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=40
XL4N GN2 g2c VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=40

* ---------------- level shifter 1: hson -> floating domain ----------------
XS1N1 xs1 hson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6
XS1N2 ys1 hsonb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6
XS1P1 xs1 ys1 bsti bsti sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1
XS1P2 ys1 xs1 bsti bsti sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1
* floating receiver: xs1 low = high side on
XRXP hsf xs1 bsti bsti sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6
XRXN hsf xs1 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1

* ---------------- floating high-side gate driver (GN = hsf) ----------------
XF1P f1b hsf bsti bsti sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=4
XF1N f1b hsf VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=2
XGP GN f1b bsti bsti sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=40
XGN GN f1b VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=20

* ---------------- level shifter 2: lson -> charge-switch control ----------------
XS2N1 xs2 lson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6
XS2N2 ys2 lsonb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6
XS2P1 xs2 ys2 bsti bsti sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1
XS2P2 ys2 xs2 bsti bsti sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1
XRX2P r2 xs2 bsti bsti sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6
XRX2N r2 xs2 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XC2P chgb r2 bsti bsti sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=10
XC2N chgb r2 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=4

* ---------------- bootstrap charge switch (VDD -> VBST pad) ----------------
XCHG VBST chgb VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.5 m=200

* ---------------- boot rail damping + on-chip boot cap + VLX short ----------------
XRD VBST bsti VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=7 l=1 m=14
XCB VSW bsti VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=7 m=80
XSH VLX bsti VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=400
XDC VSS VDD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=7 m=40

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver (SKY130)
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   GN  : high-side gate output (floating domain VBST/VLX)
*   GN2 : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   VLX : floating reference = bootstrap cap bottom, tied on-die to VSW
* Architecture:
*   - input buffer -> asymmetric-delay dead-time logic (delayed turn-on, fast
*     turn-off for both sides)
*   - 5V cross-coupled latch level shifter into the floating domain
*   - floating CMOS buffer drives GN; charge-switch PMOS (VDD->VBST) is gated
*     off fast before GN rises and gated on only ~3ns after HS turn-off (via a
*     floating delay line) so the flying rail is never dumped into VDD
*   - nvt NMOS provides dead-start charging of the bootstrap cap
*   - damped on-die snubber across VBST-VLX + HF decap, VDD-VSS decap
* Wide devices are written as w<=7 nf=1 with integer m multiplicity.
.param cboot=3.3n

* ---- delay inverter cell (approx 0.2ns/stage) ----
.subckt bd_dinv i o v g
XDP o i v v sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=1 nf=1
XDN o i g g sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends bd_dinv

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* ================= input buffer =================
XIB1P inb IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIB1N inb IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XIB2P inp inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XIB2N inp inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIB3P inpb inp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XIB3N inpb inp VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* ================= HS turn-on delay chain (D1) =================
XA1 inp a1 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA2 a1 a2 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA3 a2 a3 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA4 a3 a4 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA5 a4 a5 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA6 a5 a6 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA7 a6 a7 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA8 a7 a8 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA9 a8 a9 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA10 a9 a10 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA11 a10 a11 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA12 a11 a12 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA13 a12 a13 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XA14 a13 a14 VDD VSS bd_dinv
* hson = AND(inp, a14): delayed rise, fast fall
XAN1PA ann inp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XAN1PB ann a14 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XAN1NA ann inp anx VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XAN1NB anx a14 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XAN2P hson ann VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=2
XAN2N hson ann VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XAN3P hsoff hson VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=2
XAN3N hsoff hson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
* ================= LS turn-on delay chain (D2) =================
XB1 inpb b1 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB2 b1 b2 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB3 b2 b3 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB4 b3 b4 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB5 b4 b5 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB6 b5 b6 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB7 b6 b7 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB8 b7 b8 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB9 b8 b9 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB10 b9 b10 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB11 b10 b11 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB12 b11 b12 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB13 b12 b13 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB14 b13 b14 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB15 b14 b15 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB16 b15 b16 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB17 b16 b17 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB18 b17 b18 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB19 b18 b19 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB20 b19 b20 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB21 b20 b21 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB22 b21 b22 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB23 b22 b23 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB24 b23 b24 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB25 b24 b25 VDD VSS bd_dinv
XB26 b25 b26 VDD VSS bd_dinv
* lson = AND(inpb, b26): delayed rise, fast fall
XLN1PA bnn inpb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XLN1PB bnn b26 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XLN1NA bnn inpb bnx VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XLN1NB bnx b26 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XLN2P lson bnn VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=2
XLN2N lson bnn VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
* ================= low-side gate driver =================
XT1P t1 lson VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XT1N t1 lson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XT2P t2 t1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=4
XT2N t2 t1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=2
XT3P t3 t2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=16
XT3N t3 t2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=8
XT4P GN2 t3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=80
XT4N GN2 t3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=64
* ================= level shifter (5V devices) =================
XLS1 nb hson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=4
XLS2 na hsoff VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=4
XLP1 na nb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XLP2 nb na VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
* floating-domain receiver (5V, input swings below VLX when VSW is high)
XRVP r1 na VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1 m=2
XRVN r1 na VLX VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* ================= floating logic =================
XF1P f1 r1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XF1N f1 r1 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XF2P f2 f1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=4
XF2N f2 f1 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=2
* high-side output stage with series damping resistor to GN
XHDP gn_d f2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=40
XHDN gn_d f2 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=20
XRG gn_d GN sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po w=5 l=1.2
* ---- floating delay line for charge-switch turn-on (approx 3ns) ----
XG1 r1 g1 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG2 g1 g2 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG3 g2 g3 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG4 g3 g4 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG5 g4 g5 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG6 g5 g6 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG7 g6 g7 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG8 g7 g8 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG9 g8 g9 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG10 g9 g10 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG11 g10 g11 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG12 g11 g12 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG13 g12 g13 VBST VLX bd_dinv
XG14 g13 r1d VBST VLX bd_dinv
* fc = NAND(r1, r1d): falls (P1 on) only ~3ns after HS-off; rises fast at HS-on
XFCPA fc r1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=4
XFCPB fc r1d VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=4
XFCNA fc r1 fcx VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=8
XFCNB fcx r1d VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=8
* ================= bootstrap charge path =================
* main charge switch: VDD <-> VBST, on while high side is off (delayed on)
XP1 VDD fc VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=400
* dead-start charger (native Vth): pulls VBST toward VDD at power-up only
XNVT VDD VDD VBST VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_05v0_nvt l=0.9 w=5 nf=1 m=40
* ================= VLX-VSW tie (kelvin bond return) =================
XTIE VSW VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=400
* ================= snubber and decoupling =================
* damped snubber across the floating rail (die side)
XCS VBST snx sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=110 l=182
XRS snx VLX sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po w=5 l=0.65
* small HF decap across floating rail
XCH VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=45 l=45
* VDD-VSS decap
XCD VDD VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=71 l=71
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* =============================================================================
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver (SKY130, 1.8 V supply)
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*
* Architecture
*  - VDD/VSS domain (1.8 V devices): input buffer, adaptive dead-time logic,
*    low-side driver (GN2), bootstrap-switch enable.
*      * LS turn-on  = IN low  AND VSW sensed low  (+ ~3-cell delay)
*      * HS turn-on  = IN high AND GN2 sensed low  (+ ~3-cell delay)
*    Sensing the real switch node / LS gate makes the dead time track PVT.
*  - Level shifters (5 V devices): cross-coupled 5 V PMOS latch in the
*    floating domain with 5 V NMOS pull-downs to VSS; a 5 V inverter
*    converts the latch node (swings 0..VBST) to VSW..VBST levels.
*  - Floating HS driver (1.8 V devices between VBST and VSW): tapered buffer
*    driving GN; pull-up sized to limit VSW dV/dt, strong pull-down.
*  - Synchronous bootstrap charging: 1.8 V PMOS switch VDD->VBST, enabled
*    (through its own level shifter) only while IN is low and VSW is low.
*    VLX is tied to VSS during charging (low-impedance recharge loop) and to
*    VSW through a ~6 ohm NMOS that damps the wirebond/bootstrap-cap LC loop.
*  - On-chip bootstrap reservoir: thin-oxide NMOS capacitor VBST-VSW.
*  - Supply decoupling: MOS decap plus an R-C damper for the package LC.
* Off-chip bootstrap capacitor: 10 nF (reaches steady state well before the
* 0.5 us measurement window; ~7 mV droop per cycle).
* =============================================================================
.param cboot=10n

* Dead-time delay cells: slow inverter loaded by a MIM capacitor
.subckt bd_dhl a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42
XC y vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=4.6 l=4.6
.ends bd_dhl

.subckt bd_dlh a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42
XC y vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=4.4 l=4.4
.ends bd_dlh

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* ---- input buffer (VDD domain): inb = NOT IN, ina = IN ----
XI1P inb IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XI1N inb IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XI2P ina inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XI2N ina inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
* ---- sensors: swl = 1 when VSW is low, gl = 1 when GN2 is low ----
XS1P swl VSW VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS1N swl VSW VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XS2P gl GN2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS2N gl GN2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
* ---- dead-time delays (polarity inverter + 3 delay cells each) ----
* HS-off -> LS-on: swl_d = swl delayed
XDHXP swl_x swl VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XDHXN swl_x swl VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
XDH0 swl_x sd0 VDD VSS bd_dhl
XDH1 sd0 sd1 VDD VSS bd_dhl
XDH2 sd1 swl_d VDD VSS bd_dhl
* LS-off -> HS-on: gl_d = gl delayed
XDLXP gl_x gl VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XDLXN gl_x gl VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
XDL0 gl_x gd0 VDD VSS bd_dlh
XDL1 gd0 gd1 VDD VSS bd_dlh
XDL2 gd1 gl_d VDD VSS bd_dlh
* ---- command gating ----
* short extra delay on LS turn-off so the bootstrap switch opens first
XLD1P inb_x inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XLD1N inb_x inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
XLD1C inb_x VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=5
XLD2P inb_d inb_x VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XLD2N inb_d inb_x VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
* ls_cmd_b = NAND(inb_d, swl_d)
XGLP1 ls_cmd_b inb_d VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XGLP2 ls_cmd_b swl_d VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XGLN1 ls_cmd_b inb_d gl_m VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XGLN2 gl_m swl_d VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
* hs_cmd_b = NAND(ina, gl_d), hs_cmd = NOT hs_cmd_b
XGHP1 hs_cmd_b ina VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XGHP2 hs_cmd_b gl_d VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XGHN1 hs_cmd_b ina gh_m VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XGHN2 gh_m gl_d VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XGH3P hs_cmd hs_cmd_b VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XGH3N hs_cmd hs_cmd_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
* bootstrap charge enable: bs_en = IN low AND VSW low
XGBP1 bs_en_b inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XGBP2 bs_en_b swl VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XGBN1 bs_en_b inb gb_m VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XGBN2 gb_m swl VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XGB3P bs_en bs_en_b VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16
XGB3N bs_en bs_en_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
* ---- low-side driver (GN2), edge rate limited to reduce package bounce ----
XL1P ls_cmd ls_cmd_b VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20
XL1N ls_cmd ls_cmd_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10
XL2P l2 ls_cmd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50
XL2N l2 ls_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=25
XL3P GN2 l2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 m=4
XL3N GN2 l2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 m=2
* LS hold-off: strong GN2 pull-down enabled only while the HS is commanded on
XL4BP hold hs_cmd_b VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16
XL4BN hold hs_cmd_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
XL4N GN2 hold VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 m=4
* ---- high-side level shifter, 5 V devices (xb low = HS on) ----
XHN1 xb hs_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8
XHN2 x hs_cmd_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8
XHP1 x xb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1
XHP2 xb x VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1
XHP3 ha xb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4
XHN3 ha xb VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2
* ---- floating high-side driver (VBST/VSW rails) ----
XF1P hb ha VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6
XF1N hb ha VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XF2P hc hb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40
XF2N hc hb VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20
XF3P hd hc VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150
XF3N hd hc VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=125
XF4P GN hd VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 m=7
XF4N GN hd VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=75 m=10
* ---- bootstrap-switch level shifter, 5 V devices (bb low = charging off) ----
XBN1 ba bs_en VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8
XBN2 bb bs_en_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8
XBP1 ba bb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1
XBP2 bb ba VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1
* bc high = charging disabled (bb is actively pulled low at turn-off -> fast)
XBP3 bc bb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4
XBN3 bc bb VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2
XBI1P bd bc VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10
XBI1N bd bc VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5
XBI3P gbs bd VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60
XBI3N gbs bd VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30
* synchronous bootstrap charging switch VDD -> VBST (gate low only while charging)
XMBS VDD gbs VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 m=20
* ---- VLX return paths ----
* VLX-VSW: always-on (~6 ohm) NMOS, damps the wirebond / bootstrap-cap LC loop
XRD VLX VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150
* VLX-VSS: low-impedance recharge return while the bootstrap switch is on
XLV VLX bs_en VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 m=10
* ---- on-chip capacitors (thin-oxide MOS capacitors) ----
* bootstrap reservoir VBST-VSW (~170 pF)
XCB VSW VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=100 m=22
* VDD-VSS decoupling (~40 pF)
XCD VSS VDD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=100 m=5
* supply damper: ~40 pF MOS capacitor in series with an always-on NMOS resistor
XCDD dmp VDD dmp dmp sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=100 m=5
XRDD dmp VDD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver (sky130)
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain VBST / VSW)
*   GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD / VSS domain)
*   IN   : PWM input
*   VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   VDD  : driver supply
*   VLX  : bootstrap cap bottom pad (tied to VSW on chip)
*   VSS  : ground
*   VSW  : switch node
*
* Architecture:
*   - Dead time: IN is delayed by a slow inverter line; hsc = IN & IN_d,
*     lsc = ~(IN | IN_d), so each turn-on waits for the delay (~5 ns).
*   - Low side: tapered inverter chain lsc -> GN2 (VDD/VSS).
*   - High side: 5V cross-coupled level shifter (hsc -> ld), then a floating
*     tapered chain powered from VBST/VSW driving GN.
*   - Bootstrap charging: PMOS switch VDD -> VBST, enabled only while the low
*     side is on (second level shifter + direct pull-down from GN2), so it
*     never conducts backwards while VSW is high.
*   - On-chip bootstrap cap: thin-oxide MOS cap between VBST and VSW; VLX is
*     tied to VSW (VBST-gated NMOS) and to VSS while the low side is on.
.param cboot=90n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*** input buffer
XIN1 inb IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XIP1 inb IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XIN2 ina inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XIP2 ina inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
*** dead-time delay line (4 slow inverters)
XDN1 dl1 ina VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XDP1 dl1 ina VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XDC1 VSS dl1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XDN2 dl2 dl1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XDP2 dl2 dl1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XDC2 VSS dl2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XDN3 dl3 dl2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XDP3 dl3 dl2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XDC3 VSS dl3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XDN4 ind dl3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XDP4 ind dl3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
*** hs command: hsn = NAND(ina, ind), hsc = NOT hsn
XHA1 hsn ina hsx VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XHA2 hsx ind VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XHA3 hsn ina VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XHA4 hsn ind VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XHI1 hsc hsn VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XHI2 hsc hsn VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
*** ls command: lsc = NOR(ina, ind), lsn = NOT lsc
XLO1 lsc ina VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XLO2 lsc ind VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XLO3 lsc ina lsy VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XLO4 lsy ind VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XLI1 lsn lsc VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XLI2 lsn lsc VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
*** low-side driver chain: lsc -> GN2 (4 inversions)
XL1N l1 lsc VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XL1P l1 lsc VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XL2N l2 l1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=1 m=1
XL2P l2 l1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=1 m=2
XL3N l3 l2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=1 m=5
XL3P l3 l2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=1 m=10
XL4N GN2 l3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1 m=30
XL4P GN2 l3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1 m=60
*** level shifter 1 (HS command): ld = VBST when hsc high, 0 otherwise
XNC lc hsc VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1 m=1
XND ld hsn VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1 m=1
XPC lc ld VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XPD ld lc VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1 m=1
*** floating high-side chain: ld -> GN (4 inversions)
XF1N f1 ld VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XF1P f1 ld VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1 m=1
XF2N f2 f1 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1 m=2
XF2P f2 f1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1 m=4
XF3N f3 f2 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=1 m=10
XF3P f3 f2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=1 m=20
XF4N GN f3 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1 m=50
XF4P GN f3 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1 m=100
*** level shifter 2 (bootstrap switch enable): la = 0 when lsc high
XNA la lsc VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1 m=1
XNB lb lsn VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1 m=1
XPA la lb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XPB lb la VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1 m=1
*** floating buffer for bootstrap switch gate: la -> gcp (2 inversions)
XG1N g1 la VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XG1P g1 la VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1 m=1
XG2N gcp g1 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1 m=2
XG2P gcp g1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1 m=4
*** ground-referenced pull-down of gcp while the low side is on (startup aid)
XGPD gcp GN2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=1
*** bootstrap charging switch (PMOS, bulk at VBST)
XMCP VDD gcp VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1 m=30
*** VLX-VSW tie
XMT VLX VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1 m=10
*** VLX return path to VSS while the low side is on
XMLX VLX GN2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1 m=20
*** on-chip bootstrap capacitor (thin-oxide MOS cap)
XCB VSW VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=10 nf=1 m=500
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver (SKY130, 1.8 V)
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*
* Architecture:
*  - Interlocked dead time: the HS is enabled by cmd AND delayed(GN2 low);
*    the LS is enabled by NOT cmd AND delayed(VSW low). The delay only starts
*    once the opposite switch has been sensed off (~5 ns across PVT).
*  - Level shifter: 5 V NMOS pull-downs into a 5 V PMOS cross-coupled latch on
*    VBST (nodes swing 0..VBST, no static current), then a 5 V inverter into the
*    floating VBST/VSW domain.
*  - Floating domain rail is VSW. The on-chip bootstrap MOS cap sits between
*    VBST and VSW; VLX (off-chip cap bottom) ties to VSW through a ~5 ohm
*    NMOS, so the 4 nH bond-wire loop is damped (zeta ~0.7) while the gate
*    charge path (cap -> driver -> gate -> VSW) avoids that resistance.
*  - Bootstrap charge PMOS (VDD -> VBST, bulk VBST) is on only when the HS is
*    commanded off AND VSW is low (VDD sensed high in the floating domain); GN
*    is gated by chg so it cannot rise before the charge switch is off.
*  - Device classes: nodes spanning 0..VBST use 5 V devices; all others see
*    at most one supply span (<= ~1.9 V) and use 1.8 V devices.
.param cboot=47n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* ================= VDD domain =================
* input buffer: IN -> inb -> cmd
XI1N inb IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
XI1P inb IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XI2N cmd inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
XI2P cmd inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
* sense GN2 low -> gs (high when LS gate is off)
XS1N gs GN2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 m=1
XS1P gs GN2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* delay gs -> gsd: 4 inverters, each loaded by a linear MIM cap
XDH1N dh1 gs VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=1
XDH1P dh1 gs VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=1
XDH1C dh1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
XDH2N dh2 dh1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=1
XDH2P dh2 dh1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=1
XDH2C dh2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
XDH3N dh3 dh2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=1
XDH3P dh3 dh2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=1
XDH3C dh3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
XDH4N gsd dh3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=1
XDH4P gsd dh3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=1
XDH4C gsd VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
* nhs = NAND(cmd, gsd) ; hse = NOT nhs
XH1N nhs cmd xh1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XH2N xh1 gsd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XH1P nhs cmd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XH2P nhs gsd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XH3N hse nhs VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XH3P hse nhs VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1
* sense VSW low -> ws (high when switch node is low)
XS2N ws VSW VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 m=1
XS2P ws VSW VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* delay ws -> wsd: 4 MIM-loaded inverters (+ extra load on dl2 to center)
XDL1N dl1 ws VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=1
XDL1P dl1 ws VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=1
XDL1C dl1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
XDL2N dl2 dl1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=1
XDL2P dl2 dl1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=1
XDL2C dl2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
XDLC dl2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=4.5 l=4.5 m=1
XDL3N dl3 dl2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=1
XDL3P dl3 dl2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=1
XDL3C dl3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
XDL4N wsd dl3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=1
XDL4P wsd dl3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=1
XDL4C wsd VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
* nls = NAND(inb, wsd)  (inb = NOT cmd)
XL1N nls inb xl1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XL2N xl1 wsd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XL1P nls inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XL2P nls wsd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
* low-side driver: nls -> l1 -> l2 -> GN2
XB1N l1 nls VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 m=1
XB1P l1 nls VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 m=1
XB2N l2 l1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 m=1
XB2P l2 l1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 m=1
XB3N GN2 l2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 m=4
XB3P GN2 l2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 m=10
* ================= level shifter (5 V devices) =================
XLSA la hse VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 m=1

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver (SKY130)
* Architecture:
*  - Ground-domain logic generates asymmetrically delayed HS/LS commands
*    (fast turn-off, delayed turn-on => 3-7ns dead time on both edges).
*  - DC cross-coupled 5V level shifters move commands into the 0..VBST domain.
*  - Floating output stage: 5V PMOS pull-up (GN->VBST), 5V NMOS pull-down
*    (GN->VLX) driven by 5V inverters on the VBST/VSS rails.
*  - Bootstrap charging: 1.8V PMOS switch VDD->VBST, on during LS phase only.
*    Its bulk diode (nwell=VBST) self-starts the boot rail.
*  - VLX is tied to VSW by an always-on 5V NMOS (gate=VBST) plus a 1.8V NMOS
*    (gate=VDD) that strengthens the link during the charging phase.
*  - On-chip MOS decaps on VBST-VLX and VDD-VSS absorb gate-charge spikes.
.param cboot=10n

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ================= ground domain: input buffer =================
XI1P inb IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XI1N inb IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
XI2P inbuf inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1
XI2N inbuf inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1

* ======= delay chain A (HS turn-on delay, short, 2 bare stages) =======
XDA1P da1 inbuf VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
XDA1N da1 inbuf VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 m=1
XDA4P da4 da1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
XDA4N da4 da1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 m=1
* hsonb = NAND(inbuf, da4) ; hson = INV(hsonb)
XNA1P hsonb inbuf VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XNA2P hsonb da4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XNA1N hsonb inbuf na1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XNA2N na1 da4 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XI3P hson hsonb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=1
XI3N hson hsonb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1

* ======= delay chain B (LS turn-on delay, ~5ns, 8 stages) =======
XDB1P db1 inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
XDB1N db1 inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 m=1
XCB1N VSS db1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.5 m=1
XCB1P VDD db1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.5 m=1
XDB2P db2 db1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
XDB2N db2 db1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 m=1
XCB2N VSS db2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.5 m=1
XCB2P VDD db2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.5 m=1
XDB3P db3 db2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
XDB3N db3 db2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 m=1
XCB3N VSS db3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.5 m=1
XCB3P VDD db3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.5 m=1
XDB4P db4 db3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
XDB4N db4 db3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 m=1

XDB8P db8 db7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
XDB8N db8 db7 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 m=1
XCB8N VSS db8 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.5 m=1
XCB8P VDD db8 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.5 m=1
XDB9P db9 db8 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
XDB9N db9 db8 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 m=1
XCB9N VSS db9 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.5 m=1
XCB9P VDD db9 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.5 m=1
XDB10P db10 db9 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
XDB10N db10 db9 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 m=1

* lsonb = NAND(inb, db10) ; lson = INV(lsonb)
XNB1P lsonb inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XNB2P lsonb db10 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XNB1N lsonb inb nb1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1

XI4N lson lsonb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1

* ================= GN2 low-side gate driver =================
XG1P g2a lson VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=2
XG1N g2a lson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=1
XG2P g2b g2a VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=8

XG3N g2c g2b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=10
XG4P GN2 g2c VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=40
XG4N GN2 g2c VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=20

* ============ level shifter HS (VSS -> 0..VBST domain) ============
XLSN1 shA hson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 m=4
XLSN2 shB hsonb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 m=4
XLSP1 shA shB VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 m=1

* ============ level shifter LS (for the charge switch) ============
XLSN3 slA lson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 m=4

XSAFE GN lson VLX VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 m=1

XMCS VBST gcs VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=220

* You must design the bootstrap driver (charging path, level shifters,

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap driver.
.param cboot=100n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* Full-swing tracking connection between the power switch and bootstrap return.
XNTRACK VSW VDD VLX VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=5 m=6
XPTRACK VSW VSS VLX VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=5 m=6

* Bootstrap charger.  CG is low while VLX is low and follows VBST while
* VLX is high, so the 5 V charging PMOS fully charges and then isolates Cboot.
XPBC1 NBC VSS VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=2
XNBC1 NBC VLX VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XPBC2 CG NBC VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XNBC2 CG NBC VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XPCHARGE VDD CG VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5

* Complementary input and a fast low-side reset signal.
XPINB INB IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XNINB INB IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2

* High-side set path: non-inverting, delayed on rising IN and fast on falling IN.
XPHD1 NHD IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XNHD1 NHD IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1
XPHD2 HD NHD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XNHD2 HD NHD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2

* Ground-referenced set/reset pull-downs and floating cross-coupled latch.
XNSET LA HD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
XNRESET LB INB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
XPLA LA LB VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XPLB LB LA VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=12 nf=2

* 5 V input stage tolerates the ground-referenced latch low level.  The final
* inverter operates entirely between VBST and VLX.
XPHPRE HRESET LB VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=80 nf=8
XNHPRE HRESET LB VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XPHOUT GN HRESET VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 m=20
XNHOUT GN HRESET VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 m=10

* Low-side non-overlap path: fast falling and delayed rising gate drive.
XPLD1 NL IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1
XNLD1 NL IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XPLD2 NLP NL VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XNLD2 NLP NL VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XPLOUT GN2 NLP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 m=40
XNLOUT GN2 NLP VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 m=20

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Sky130 MOS syntax examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* 5V device examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* Cap:  XC a b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 m=4
*
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   - GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain, referenced to VBST/VLX)
*   - GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   - IN   : PWM input
*   - VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   - VDD  : driver supply
*   - VLX  : floating reference for the bootstrap driving (bootstrap cap bottom)
*   - VSS  : ground
*   - VSW  : switch node (midpoint of the external half-bridge power stage)
*
* Architecture:
*   IN -> input buffer -> two RC delay lines -> cross coupled AND dead time
*   generator -> low side output buffer (GN2) and a set/reset pulse generator.
*   Short pulses cross into the floating domain through a pulsed cross coupled
*   level shifter (5 V devices, sources and bulks at VSS) whose floating PMOS
*   latch is referenced to VBST.  A floating inverter chain drives GN.
*   The bootstrap capacitor is charged from VDD through a 5 V PMOS whose gate
*   is the floating latch node (on while the high side is off).  VLX is tied
*   to VSW with a large always-on 5 V NMOS so the floating ground follows the
*   switch node.  An on-chip MOS decoupling capacitor sits across VBST/VLX.
*
* Off-chip bootstrap capacitor value (<= 100 nF), used by the testbench:
.param cboot=4.7n

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 1.8 V logic inverter, small
.subckt bd_i1 A Y VP VN
XMP Y A VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN Y A VN VN sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends bd_i1

* 1.8 V logic inverter, medium
.subckt bd_i2 A Y VP VN
XMP Y A VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
XMN Y A VN VN sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
.ends bd_i2

* 1.8 V logic inverter, output driver (drives a 450 x 50 um power gate)
.subckt bd_i3 A Y VP VN
XMP Y A VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=1
XMN Y A VN VN sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=1
.ends bd_i3

* 1.8 V two input NAND
.subckt bd_nd2 A B Y VP VN
XP1 Y A VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP2 Y B VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN1 Y A XN VN sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 XN B VN VN sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends bd_nd2

* 1.8 V two input NOR
.subckt bd_nr2 A B Y VP VN
XP1 Y A XP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP2 XP B VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN1 Y A VN VN sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 Y B VN VN sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends bd_nr2

* Floating domain inverter, first stage (5 V PMOS, 1.8 V NMOS)
.subckt bd_f1 A Y VH VL
XMP Y A VH VH sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XMN Y A VL VL sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
.ends bd_f1

* Floating domain inverter, output stage (1.8 V devices, floating swing)
.subckt bd_f2 A Y VH VL
XMP Y A VH VH sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=1
XMN Y A VL VL sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=1
.ends bd_f2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---- floating ground: VLX tied to the switch node VSW ----------------------
* A low value poly resistor models the metal trace between the LX pad and the
* switch node.  It is linear, so it does not fight the wirebond LC network the
* way an active device does, and it keeps VLX within a few mV of VSW.
XRT VSW VLX VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=200 l=0.15

* ---- on-chip floating rail decoupling (MOS capacitor) ----------------------
XCBO VLX VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1 m=24

* ---- input buffer ----------------------------------------------------------
XI1 IN  N1  VDD VSS bd_i1
XI2 N1  NIN VDD VSS bd_i2
XI3 NIN NINB VDD VSS bd_i2

* ---- dead time delay lines (poly resistor + MIM capacitor) -----------------
* path A : NINB delayed by ~td1 then inverted -> A  (= IN delayed by td1)
XRA NINB XA VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=89
XCA XA VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=5 mult=1
XIA XA A VDD VSS bd_i1
* path B : NIN delayed by ~td2 then inverted -> B  (= /IN delayed by td2)
XRB NINB XB VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=290
XCB XB VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=5 mult=1
XIB XB B VDD VSS bd_i1

* ---- cross coupled dead time logic ----------------------------------------
XIAB A AB VDD VSS bd_i1
XIBB B BB VDD VSS bd_i1
XHS  A B N_HSC VDD VSS bd_nd2
XIHC N_HSC HSC VDD VSS bd_i1
XLS  AB BB N_LSC VDD VSS bd_nd2
XILC N_LSC LSC VDD VSS bd_i1

* ---- low side output buffer ------------------------------------------------
* The high side signal has to cross the level shifter, so it arrives at its
* output buffer roughly 9 ns after the low side signal.  An identical poly/MIM
* RC ahead of the low side buffer re-aligns the two paths so that the dead
* time is set by the delay line difference alone.
XRLS LSC LSDA VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=350
XCLS LSDA VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=5 mult=1
XILS LSDA NLS2 VDD VSS bd_i1
XGN2 NLS2 GN2 VDD VSS bd_i3

* ---- set / reset pulse generator (short pulses on HSC edges) ---------------
XRP HSC XPUL VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=222
XCP XPUL VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=5 mult=1
XIP XPUL HSD VDD VSS bd_i1
XIHB HSC HSCB VDD VSS bd_i1
XIHDB HSD HSDB VDD VSS bd_i1
XSP HSCB HSD SETP VDD VSS bd_nr2
XRS HSC HSDB RSTP VDD VSS bd_nr2

* ---- pulsed level shifter into the floating domain ------------------------
* cross coupled floating PMOS latch (5 V, bulk at VBST)
XLP1 Q  QB VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1
XLP2 QB Q  VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1
* cross coupled keeper NMOS (source and bulk at VSS)
XLN1 Q  QB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XLN2 QB Q  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* pulsed pull downs
XPS QB SETP VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XPR Q  RSTP VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100 nf=1

* ---- floating output stage -------------------------------------------------
XF1 Q  N1F VBST VLX bd_f1
XF2 N1F GN VBST VLX bd_f2

* ---- bootstrap charging switch --------------------------------------------
* on while the high side is off (Q low), off while VBST is pumped above VDD
XCH VBST Q VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1000 nf=1 m=2

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap gate driver.
* The off-chip capacitor is charged to VDD while GN is low.
.param cboot=100n

* Ground-domain inverter.
.subckt bd_inv in out vdd vss
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends bd_inv

* Two-input NAND used by the break-before-make controller.
.subckt bd_nand2 a b out vdd vss
XMPA out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMPB out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNA out a nm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNB nm b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends bd_nand2

* Non-inverting delayed feedback, with a linear MIM timing capacitor.
.subckt bd_delay in out vdd vss
XMND n0 in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMPD n0 in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XC0 n0 vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=14 w=10 mult=1
XI1 n0 out vdd vss bd_inv
.ends bd_delay

* High-side history delays the low-side turn-on.
.subckt bd_delay_h in out vdd vss
XMND n0 in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMPD n0 in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XC0 n0 vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=16 w=10 mult=1
XI1 n0 out vdd vss bd_inv
.ends bd_delay_h

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* Complementary input and non-overlap command signals H and L.
XINB IN INB VDD VSS bd_inv
XDELH H HD VDD VSS bd_delay_h
XDELL L LD VDD VSS bd_delay
XINVH HD NHD VDD VSS bd_inv
XINVL LD NLD VDD VSS bd_inv
XNAH IN NLD HN VDD VSS bd_nand2
XNAL INB NHD LN VDD VSS bd_nand2
XHI HN H VDD VSS bd_inv
XLI LN L VDD VSS bd_inv
XHHB H HB VDD VSS bd_inv

* Low-side buffer; L is asserted only after H has been low for the delay.
XLB0 L LB VDD VSS bd_inv
XMNL2 GN2 LB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XMPL2 GN2 LB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4

* Low-to-floating level shifter.  The cross-coupled pair drives only a
* small floating inverter, not the power-gate capacitance.
XMNLS HSC H VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=16 nf=2
XMNLSB NS HB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=16 nf=2
XMPLS HSC NS VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMPLSB NS HSC VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

* The first floating inverter accepts the ground-to-VBST level-shifter
* signal and restores a local VSW-to-VBST logic swing.
XMNHB BSC NS VSW VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMPHB BSC NS VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=16 nf=2

* Final floating CMOS driver: every terminal remains in the 1.8 V domain.
XMNH GN BSC VSW VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4
XMPH GN BSC VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=160 nf=4

* Bootstrap charging switch: GN=VSW in the off state turns it on;
* GN=VBST in the on state turns it off and blocks reverse conduction.
XMPB VBST GN VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=80 nf=4

* The separate capacitor-bottom pad follows the power switch node.
XMNJ VSW VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=320 nf=4
.ends bootstrap_driver

.subckt inv IN OUT VDD VSS

XMP OUT IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.3
XMN OUT IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.3
XCD OUT VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=5 mult=1
.ends dinv

.subckt dinvl IN OUT VDD VSS
XMP OUT IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.3
XMN OUT IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.3
XCD OUT VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=20 mult=1
.ends dinvl

.subckt nand2 A B OUT VDD VSS
XMPA OUT A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XMPB OUT B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
