XMNB NA B VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
.ends nand2

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* Input complement and symmetric delayed copies of both input polarities.
XININV IN NIN VDD VSS inv m=1
XHD1 IN HD1 VDD VSS dinv m=1
XHD2 HD1 HD VDD VSS dinv m=1
XLD1 NIN LD1 VDD VSS dinvl m=1
XLD2 LD1 LD VDD VSS dinvl m=1

* NAND outputs fall only after the selected turn-on delay.  Their falling
* transitions are immediate on the opposite input edge, disabling a driver.
XHNAND IN HD NH VDD VSS nand2 m=1
XLNAND NIN LD NL VDD VSS nand2 m=1

* Complementary high-side latch controls, with equal buffer depth.
XHB0 NH H VDD VSS inv m=1
XHB1 H HB1 VDD VSS inv m=2
XHB2 HB1 HB2 VDD VSS inv m=4
XNB1 NH NB1 VDD VSS inv m=2
XNB2 NB1 NHB2 VDD VSS inv m=4

* Low-side output buffer: three inversions restore the NAND polarity.
XLB0 NL LB0 VDD VSS inv m=2
XLB1 LB0 LB1 VDD VSS inv m=8
XLP GN2 LB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=50 l=0.15 m=8
XLN GN2 LB1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=0.15 m=4

* Floating high-side latch and output inverter.  Five-volt devices expose
* only their rated terminal differences while GN reaches VBST above VDD.
XPHP GN PG VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=50 l=0.5 m=8
XPHN GN PG VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=50 l=0.5 m=6
XPFB PG GN VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=20 l=0.5 m=5
XNFB PG GN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=20 l=0.5 m=1
XNSET PG HB2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=50 l=0.5 m=8
XNRESET GN NHB2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=50 l=0.5 m=12

* GN-controlled PMOS charger: fully enhanced while the high side is off,
* and gate-source neutral after the bootstrap domain rises.
XPBOOT VBST GN VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=50 l=0.5 m=16

* Bootstrap-bottom return to the power-stage switch node.
XLINK VLX VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=0.15 m=8
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver
* Ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*
* Domain map
*   VSS domain : input receiver -> dead-time generator (RC cells) ->
*                low-side output buffer (GN2) + level-shift commands
*   Floating   : cross-coupled 5V PMOS latch referenced to VBST/VSW, pulled
*                down by 5V NMOS whose sources sit at VSS (current-mode level
*                shift, works for any VBST/VSW common mode) -> inverter chain
*                -> GN push-pull output
*   Bootstrap  : 1.8V PMOS from VDD to VBST whose gate is driven by a buffer
*                living on the VBST/VLX rails, so the gate sits at VBST (switch
*                off) while the high side is on and at VLX (switch on) while the
*                switch node is low.  The pull-down of that buffer is made much
*                weaker than its pull-up so the switch turns on gently and does
*                not ring the wirebond inductance at high-side turn-off.  VLX is
*                returned to VSW through a 1.8V NMOS switch whose gate is VBST,
*                which clamps the floating rail to the switch node.  On-chip
*                reservoirs (XCBST*) supply the power-FET gate charge locally so
*                the bootstrap current does not have to come through L0/L1.
*
.param cboot=4.7n

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* RC delay cell for the dead-time generator (falling edge sets the delay)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt dly_cell in out VDD VSS
XDP out in VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=20 nf=1
XDN out in VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XDC out VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22.4 l=22.4 mult=1
.ends dly_cell

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* DUT
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

*================ VSS-domain input receiver ================
XIR1 nb IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XIR2 nb IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XIR3 a nb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIR4 a nb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

*================ ab = NOT a ================
XAB1 ab a VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XAB2 ab a VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

*================ dead-time generation ================
* dly_cell delays only the falling edge of its input (weak pull-up into the
* MIM cap) and returns immediately on the rising edge, so
*   HSON = dly(ab) : rises td after the input rises, falls at once when it
*                   falls  (low side off -> td -> high side on)
*   LSON = dly(a)  : rises td after the input falls, falls at once when it
*                   rises  (high side off -> td -> low side on)
XD1 ab hraw VDD VSS dly_cell
XD2 a lraw VDD VSS dly_cell
* sharpeners restore full logic edges for the level shifter and buffer
XHS1 h1 hraw VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XHS2 h1 hraw VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XHS3 hson h1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XHS4 hson h1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLS1 l1 lraw VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLS2 l1 lraw VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XLS3 lson l1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLS4 lson l1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* HSONB = NOT HSON
XH5 hsonb hson VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XH6 hsonb hson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

*================ low-side output buffer ================
XLB1 ls1 lson VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XLB2 ls1 lson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLB3 GN2 ls1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=1
XLB4 GN2 ls1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=1

*================ floating-domain level-shift latch ================
* cross-coupled 5V PMOS load; 5V NMOS pull-downs sit at VSS
XPQ q qb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPB qb q VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMQ q hson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMB qb hsonb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1

*================ floating-domain buffer chain ================
* INV1 (5V) : qb -> n1, rails VBST/VSW
XI1A n1 qb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XI1B n1 qb VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* INV2 (1.8V) : n1 -> n2
XI2A n2 n1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XI2B n2 n1 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* INV3 : n2 -> n3, drives the output stage
XI3A n3 n2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=1
XI3B n3 n2 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1

*================ high-side output stage ================
XHU GN n3 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=240 nf=1
XHD GN n3 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=800 nf=1

*================ bootstrap charging switch ================
* chg = buffer(qb) referenced to VBST/VLX: chg = VBST while the high side is
* on (switch off), chg = VLX while it is off, so the switch only conducts
* when the switch node is low
XCG1 c1 qb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XCG2 c1 qb VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XCG3 chg c1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1
XCG4 chg c1 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=1
XCH VBST chg VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=800 nf=1

*================ VLX return to VSW ================
XTL VLX VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1

*================ on-chip decoupling ================
* floating-rail reservoir (gate = VBST, channel = VSW)
XCBST VSW VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=800 nf=1
XCBST2 VSW VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=800 nf=1
XCBST3 VSW VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=800 nf=1
* VDD rail reservoir (gate = VDD, channel = VSS)
XCVDD VSS VDD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=800 nf=1
XCVDD2 VSS VDD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=800 nf=1

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* ==========================================================================
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*
* Convention for every logic helper below:  .subckt <name> in out vdd vss
* Every MOS is a PDK wrapper instance (drain gate source bulk).
* All devices use nf=1 so the area W*L*nf*multiplicity is unambiguous.
* ==========================================================================
.param cboot=47n

* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* logic cells
* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt inv_s in out vdd vss
X1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
X2 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends inv_s

.subckt inv in out vdd vss
X1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
X2 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt inv5 in out vdd vss
X1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
X2 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=16 nf=1
.ends inv5

.subckt inv_m in out vdd vss
X1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
X2 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=1
.ends inv_m

.subckt inv_hs in out vdd vss
X1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=1
X2 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300 nf=1
.ends inv_hs

.subckt nand2 a b out vdd vss
XN1 out a n3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 n3 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt nor2 a b out vdd vss
XN1 out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP1 out a n3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP2 n3 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends nor2

* inverter with a deliberate gate-capacitive load -> delay element
.subckt dcell in out vdd vss
X1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
X2 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XC vss out vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=112 nf=1
.ends dcell

* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* bootstrap_driver
* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---- on-chip bootstrap reservoir across VBST-VLX ----
* XDAMP is a fixed-bias MOS used as the series damping resistor of the
* floating reservoir: it kills the L-C ring between this on-chip capacitor
* and the off-chip bootstrap capacitor (whose 2 nH wirebonds are in the loop)
* that would otherwise push v(VBST)-v(VLX) past its guardrail.
XCB   VBST cbm sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=170 l=170
XDAMP cbm VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=65 nf=1

* ---- tie the floating reference VLX to the switch node VSW ----
* This device carries the whole high-side gate-charging return current, so it
* must be very wide: any VLX/VSW lag directly subtracts from the measured
* v(GN)-v(VSW).
XPASS  VLX VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1
XPASS2 VLX VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1
XPASS3 VLX VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1

* ---- bootstrap charge switch VDD -> VBST (bulk returned to VBST) ----
* The gate must be able to reach VBST, otherwise the switch stays on while the
* high side is up (VBST ~ 2*VDD) and the reservoir is discharged back into VDD.
XBSW  VDD bstg VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1000 nf=1
XBSW2 VDD bstg VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1000 nf=1
XBOFF bstg hsb    VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XBON  bstg bstg_n VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1

* ---- input buffer ----
XB1 IN nb VDD VSS inv_s
XB2 nb s  VDD VSS inv

* ---- dead-time delay line: d = s delayed by 16 stages ----
XD1  s    d1  VDD VSS dcell
XD2  d1   d2  VDD VSS dcell
XD3  d2   d3  VDD VSS dcell
XD4  d3   d4  VDD VSS dcell
XD5  d4   d5  VDD VSS dcell
XD6  d5   d6  VDD VSS dcell
XD7  d6   d7  VDD VSS dcell
XD8  d7   d8  VDD VSS dcell
XD9  d8   d9  VDD VSS dcell
XD10 d9   d10 VDD VSS dcell
XD11 d10  d11 VDD VSS dcell
XD12 d11  d12 VDD VSS dcell
XD13 d12  d13 VDD VSS dcell
XD14 d13  d14 VDD VSS dcell
XD15 d14  d15 VDD VSS dcell
XD16 d15  d   VDD VSS dcell

* ---- dead-time logic ----
* hs_ctrl = s AND d      (high-side on only while both agree)
* ls_ctrl = NOT(s OR d)  (low-side on only while both agree low)
XNAND s d hsn VDD VSS nand2
XINVH hsn hs_ctrl VDD VSS inv
XNOR  s d ls_ctrl VDD VSS nor2
XINV1 hs_ctrl hs_ctrl_b VDD VSS inv
XINV2 ls_ctrl ls_ctrl_b VDD VSS inv

* ---- bootstrap switch gate: bstg = hs_ctrl OR delay(hs_ctrl) ----
XDHS1 hs_ctrl e1 VDD VSS dcell
XDHS2 e1 e2 VDD VSS dcell
XDHS3 e2 e3 VDD VSS dcell
XDHS4 e3 e4 VDD VSS dcell
XDHS5 e4 e5 VDD VSS dcell
XDHS6 e5 hs_ctrl_d VDD VSS dcell
XNOR2 hs_ctrl hs_ctrl_d bstg_n VDD VSS nor2
XINVB bstg_n bstg VDD VSS inv

* ---- high-side level shifter (5V devices; pulldowns referenced to VSS) ----
XML1 n1 hs_ctrl   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=30 nf=1
XML2 n2 hs_ctrl_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=30 nf=1
XMP1 n1 n2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=16 nf=1
XMP2 n2 n1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=16 nf=1

* ---- floating high-side buffer, referenced to VLX ----
XF1 n1  hsf VBST VLX inv5
XH1 hsf hsb VBST VLX inv_m
XH2 hsb GN  VBST VLX inv_hs

* ---- low-side buffer ----
XL1 ls_ctrl lsb VDD VSS inv_m
XL2 lsb     GN2 VDD VSS inv_hs

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Bootstrap high-side gate driver for an all-NMOS half bridge.
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
.param cboot=4.7n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference tie: VLX (bootstrap cap bottom / HS bulk reference) -> VSW
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XLVTIE VLX VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=800 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Local floating-rail decoupling (MOS capacitor VBST -> VLX)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XCBOOT VLX VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=100 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bootstrap charging switch: PMOS VDD -> VBST, nwell tied to VBST.
* The gate must be driven all the way to VBST while the high side is
* on, otherwise the PMOS channel conducts in reverse and discharges
* the bootstrap capacitor into VDD.  Drive it from the floating rail
* with a CMOS stage referenced to VBST/VLX.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XBP VBST BG VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1000 nf=1
XBGP BG R VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1
XBGN BG R VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Input inverter and cross-coupled NOR dead-time generator
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XINVP NIN IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XINVN NIN IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* NOR1: HS_PRE = NOR(LS_PRE, NIN)
XNP1A VDD LS_PRE N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=8 nf=1
XNP1B N1 NIN HS_PRE VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=8 nf=1
XNN1A HS_PRE LS_PRE VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=1
XNN1B HS_PRE NIN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=1

* NOR2: LS_PRE = NOR(HS_PRE, IN)
XNP2A VDD HS_PRE N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=8 nf=1
XNP2B N2 IN LS_PRE VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=8 nf=1
XNN2A LS_PRE HS_PRE VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=1
XNN2B LS_PRE IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=1

* Delay-setting capacitors on the latch nodes (matched)
XCHS HS_PRE VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=23 w=23 mult=1
XCLS LS_PRE VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=23 w=23 mult=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* High-side control buffer (VDD domain) -> level-shifter gate
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XHB1P HB1 HS_PRE VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XHB1N HB1 HS_PRE VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XHB2P HB2 HB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XHB2N HB2 HB1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Level shifter into the floating (VBST/VLX) domain
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Pull-up current source: Vsg = VBST-VLX = 1.8 V, nwell at VBST
XMPU P VLX VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
* Level-shift NMOS: source at VSS, drain in floating domain
XMLS P HB2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1

* 5 V inverter in the floating domain
XIV5P Q P VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=16 nf=1
XIV5N Q P VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1

* 1.8 V floating-domain buffer
XIF1P R Q VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
XIF1N R Q VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* High-side gate output stage (GN referenced to VLX)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XGNP GN R VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=180 nf=1
XGNN GN R VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=240 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Low-side control buffer and output stage (VDD/VSS domain)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XLB1P LB1 LS_PRE VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLB1N LB1 LS_PRE VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* Small LS-branch delay trims the dead-time split; latch caps set the total.
XCLB1 LB1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=8 w=8 mult=1
XLB2P LB2 LB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
XLB2N LB2 LB1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XLB3P LB3 LB2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36 nf=1
XLB3N LB3 LB2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=18 nf=1

XLGNP GN2 LB3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=180 nf=1
XLGNN GN2 LB3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver
*
* Architecture:
*   - low-side logic runs from VDD/VSS
*   - cross-coupled NOR SR latch generates non-overlapping HS/LS commands
*   - HS command is level shifted into the VBST/VSW floating domain by a
*     cross-coupled 5V PMOS load pair and 5V NMOS pull-downs
*   - floating CMOS buffers drive the large high-side power-FET gate
*   - a 5V PMOS between VDD and VBST is the bootstrap charging switch. Its
*     gate is driven from the floating logic so that it is on while the switch
*     node is low and off before the high side turns on.
*   - a gate-driven NMOS ties the off-chip bootstrap-cap bottom pin (VLX) to
*     the switch node VSW.
*
.param cboot=4.7n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ====================================================================
* Input buffer : IN -> in_n -> in_b
* ====================================================================
XIN1 in_n IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XIP1 in_n IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XIN2 in_b in_n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XIP2 in_b in_n VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2

* ====================================================================
* Cross-coupled NOR dead-time generator
*   hs_cmd = NOR(in_n, ls_fb)
*   ls_cmd = NOR(in_b, hs_fb)
* ====================================================================
* --- NOR generating hs_cmd (PMOS series stack, NMOS parallel) ---
XHP1 hs_a in_n VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XHP2 hs_cmd ls_fb hs_a VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XHN1 hs_cmd in_n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XHN2 hs_cmd ls_fb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2

* --- NOR generating ls_cmd ---
XLP1 ls_a in_b VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XLP2 ls_cmd hs_fb ls_a VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XLN1 ls_cmd in_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XLN2 ls_cmd hs_fb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2

* ====================================================================
* Delay chains in the cross-coupled feedback paths
* (4 HS stages, 2 LS stages; long-channel devices set the dead time)
* ====================================================================
* hs feedback chain
XHD1 hd1 hs_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.68 w=6
XHDP1 hd1 hs_cmd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.68 w=18
XHD2 hd2 hd1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.68 w=6
XHDP2 hd2 hd1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.68 w=18
XHD3 hd3 hd2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.68 w=6
XHDP3 hd3 hd2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.68 w=18
XHD4 hs_fb hd3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.68 w=6
XHDP4 hs_fb hd3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.68 w=18

* ls feedback chain (2 stages -> ~4 ns LS->HS dead time)
XLD1 ld1 ls_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5
XLDP1 ld1 ls_cmd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=15
XLD2 ls_fb ld1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5
XLDP2 ls_fb ld1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=15

* ====================================================================
* Low-side gate driver : ls_cmd -> ... -> GN2 (even inverters)
* ====================================================================
XL1 l1 ls_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XLP1_ l1 ls_cmd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XL2 l2a l1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XLP2_ l2a l1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10
XL3 l3 l2a VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15
XLP3_ l3 l2a VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40
XL4 GN2 l3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40
XLP4_ GN2 l3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=240

* hs_cmd complement for the floating level shifter
XHBN hs_cmd_b hs_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XHBP hs_cmd_b hs_cmd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4

* ====================================================================
* High-side level shifter (cross-coupled 5V PMOS loads)
* XNA is driven by hs_cmd, XNB by its complement hs_cmd_b. The
* cross-coupled PMOS pair holds the floating state between transitions.
* ====================================================================
XNA ls_na hs_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200
XNB ls_nb hs_cmd_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200
XPA ls_na ls_nb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20
XPB ls_nb ls_na VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20

* ====================================================================
* Floating-domain buffers, referenced to VSW
*   ls_nb high when HS is on
* ====================================================================
* FI1 : 0/VBST input -> VSW/VBST output (complement)
XFI1P fl1 ls_nb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40
XFI1N fl1 ls_nb VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4

* FI2 : second inversion, hpre high when HS is on
XFI2P hpre fl1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10
XFI2N hpre fl1 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4

* H1 : medium driver
XH1P h1 hpre VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100
XH1N h1 hpre VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40

* H2 : final high-side gate buffer
XH2P GN h1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=500
XH2N GN h1 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=140

* ====================================================================
* Bootstrap charging switch control
* PG follows hpre: VBST when HS is on (switch off), low when HS is off
* (switch on). Drive it with a dedicated two-stage buffer.
* ====================================================================
XPG1P pg1 hpre VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6
XPG1N pg1 hpre VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XPG2P PG pg1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100
XPG2N PG pg1 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=25

* ====================================================================
* Bootstrap charging PMOS: VDD -> VBST, N-well tied to VBST
* ====================================================================
XCHG1 VBST PG VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1000
XCHG2 VBST PG VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1000

* ====================================================================
* VLX (bootstrap cap bottom pad) tie to the switch node
* Gate driven by VBST so the tie is on whenever the floating supply is up
* ====================================================================
XTIE VLX VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver.
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain, VBST/VLX referenced)
*   GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   IN   : PWM input
*   VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   VDD  : driver supply (1.8 V)
*   VLX  : bootstrap cap bottom / floating reference (tied to VSW on-die)
*   VSS  : ground
*   VSW  : switch node
.param cboot=5n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---------------- input buffer ----------------
XMN_in0 inb IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XMP_in0 inb IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XMN_in1 inp inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XMP_in1 inp inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

* -------- dead-time delay line (non-inverting) --------
XMN_d0 d1 inp VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XMP_d0 d1 inp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XRD d1 d2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=5
XCD d2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=17 l=17 mult=1
XMN_d1 d3 d2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XMP_d1 d3 d2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

* -------- high-side pre-drive: hip = inp AND d3 (rise delayed) --------
XMN_na hib inp nmid VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XMN_nb nmid d3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XMP_na hib inp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XMP_nb hib d3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XMN_hi hip hib VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XMP_hi hip hib VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

* -------- low-side pre-drive: lop = NOR(inp,d3) (rise delayed) --------
XMN_no1 lop inp VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XMN_no2 lop d3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XMP_no1 lop inp pmid VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XMP_no2 pmid d3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

* -------- low-side output buffer --------
XMN_l1 ls1 lop VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XMP_l1 ls1 lop VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 m=2
XMN_l2 GN2 ls1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=0.15 m=12
XMP_l2 GN2 ls1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=5 l=0.15 m=24

* -------- level shifter latch (5 V devices, sources to VSS) --------
XLSN1 lsa hip VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=8 l=0.5
XLSN2 lsb hib VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=8 l=0.5
XLSP1 lsa lsb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=2 l=0.5
XLSP2 lsb lsa VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=2 l=0.5

* -------- floating high-side buffer (GN = ~lsa) --------
XFB1P fbc lsa VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=8 l=0.5
XFB1N fbc lsa VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=4 l=0.5
XFB2N fbd fbc VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15
XFB2P fbd fbc VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 m=2
XFB3N GN fbd VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=0.15 m=48
XFB3P GN fbd VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=5 l=0.15 m=48

* -------- bootstrap charger (on only in low phase, after VSW fell) --------
* chg_g: pulled to VSS when lop high (charger on), to VBST otherwise
* (blocks reverse conduction from VBST back into VDD when VBST > VDD)
XPCHG VBST chg_g VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=5 l=0.15 m=120
XBLK chg_g lop VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=8 l=0.5
XPUP chg_g lop VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=4 l=0.5

* -------- VLX-to-VSW tie (gate at VBST keeps it on in both states) --------
XMTIE VLX VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=0.15 m=200

* -------- on-chip caps: VDD decoupling + bootstrap-loop snubber --------
XCB2 VDD VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=20 mult=1
* bootstrap-loop snubber (damps wirebond inductor ringing on VBST-VLX)
XRS VBST nsb VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=20 l=0.5
XCS nsb VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100 mult=3
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver.
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   - GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain, referenced to VBST/VLX)
*   - GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   - IN   : PWM input
*   - VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   - VDD  : driver supply
*   - VLX  : floating reference (bootstrap cap bottom)
*   - VSS  : ground
*   - VSW  : switch node
*
* Architecture:
*   - Ground-domain dead-time generator: hs_cmd = inb AND inb_d,
*     ls_cmd = NOR(inb, inb_d), with inb_d a delayed copy of inb.
*   - Cross-coupled PMOS latch level shifter into the VBST/VLX domain.
*   - Two-stage floating buffer drives GN up to VBST.
*   - PMOS charging switch (gate = GN) charges the bootstrap cap from VDD
*     whenever the high side is off.
*   - Always-on NMOS (gate = VBST) ties VLX to VSW on-chip.
* All MOS devices use w<=7, nf=1, scaled with m (area = W*L*nf*m).
.param cboot=20n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---------- input buffer ----------
XPI1 n1 IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=2
XNI1 n1 IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=2
XPI2 inb n1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=4
XNI2 inb n1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=4

* ---------- delay chain (dead-time) ----------
* stage 1: starved inverter + MOS cap load
XPD1 d1 inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 m=1
XND1 d1 inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 m=1
XCD1 VSS d1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=7 m=2
* stage 2
XPD2 inbd d1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 m=1
XND2 inbd d1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 m=1
XCD2 VSS inbd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=7 m=2

* ---------- dead-time logic ----------
* hs_n = NAND(inb, inbd)
XPN1 hs_n inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=2
XPN2 hs_n inbd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=2
XNN1 hs_n inb nh VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=2
XNN2 nh inbd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=2
* hs_cmd = INV(hs_n)
XPH1 hs_cmd hs_n VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=2
XNH1 hs_cmd hs_n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=2
* hs_cmd_b = INV(hs_cmd)
XPH2 hs_cmd_b hs_cmd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=2
XNH2 hs_cmd_b hs_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=2
* ls_cmd = NOR(inb, inbd)
XPL1 nl inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=2
XPL2 ls_cmd inbd nl VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 m=2
XNL1 ls_cmd inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=2
XNL2 ls_cmd inbd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=2

* ---------- level shifter: cross-coupled PMOS latch in floating domain ----------
XMLA lsa hs_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=3
XMLB lsb hs_cmd_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=3
XPLA lsa lsb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=2
XPLB lsb lsa VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=2

* ---------- floating buffer: lsb -> GN ----------
XPF1 f1 lsb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=4
XNF1 f1 lsb VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 m=3
XPF2 GN f1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=40
XNF2 GN f1 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=8

* ---------- on-chip bootstrap decoupling (2 nF MIM) ----------
XCB VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=32 l=32 mult=1

* ---------- bootstrap charging switch ----------
XPC VBST GN VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=150

* ---------- VLX to VSW tie (always on: Vgs = Vcap ~ 1.8V) ----------
XMT VLX VBST VSW VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=40

* ---------- low-side driver ----------
XPLD1 l1 ls_cmd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XNLD1 l1 ls_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
XPLD2 GN2 l1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=16
XNLD2 GN2 l1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=16

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver (DUT).
* Ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* Architecture:
*   - Delay chain + AND/NOR dead-time generation from IN
*   - Cross-coupled latch level shifter (5V NMOS pull-downs to VSS)
*   - Floating buffer chain drives GN between VBST and VLX
*   - PMOS bootstrap charging switch (bulk = VBST) gated by GN, so it only
*     turns on after VSW has fallen (prevents Cboot dump into VDD)
*   - LVT NMOS helper supplies the first part of the GN ramp from VDD
*   - VLX tied to VSW on-chip through a large always-on NMOS (gate = VBST)
*   - On-chip MIM caps: VBST-VLX reservoir and VDD-VSS decoupling
.param cboot=6n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---------- dead-time delay chain: IN -> t1 -> t2 -> t3 -> dly ----------
XMN_d1 t1 IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
XMP_d1 t1 IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
XNC_d1 VSS t1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=8 nf=2
XMN_d2 t2 t1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
XMP_d2 t2 t1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
XNC_d2 VSS t2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=8 nf=2
XMN_d3 t3 t2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
XMP_d3 t3 t2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
XNC_d3 VSS t3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=8 nf=2
XMN_d4 dly t3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
XMP_d4 dly t3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
XNC_d4 VSS dly VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=8 nf=2

* ---------- non-overlap logic ----------
* hs_pre = IN AND dly   (rises t_d after IN rises, falls immediately)
XMN_na1 hs_nand IN na1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN_na2 na1 dly VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP_na1 hs_nand IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMP_na2 hs_nand dly VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMN_na3 hs_pre hs_nand VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP_na3 hs_pre hs_nand VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
* ls_pre = IN NOR dly   (rises t_d after IN falls, falls immediately)
XMN_no1 ls_pre IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN_no2 ls_pre dly VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP_no1 no1 IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMP_no2 ls_pre dly no1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2

* ---------- level shifter (cross-coupled latch, floating domain) ----------
XMN_ls0 hs_pre_b hs_pre VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP_ls0 hs_pre_b hs_pre VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMN_set flt_a hs_pre VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=60 nf=12
XMN_rst flt_b hs_pre_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=60 nf=12
XMP_l1 flt_a flt_b VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=3
XMP_l2 flt_b flt_a VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=3

* ---------- floating output buffer: flt_b -> f1 -> GN ----------
XMN_f1 f1 flt_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XMP_f1 f1 flt_b VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=8
XMN_f2 GN f1 VLX VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=16
XMP_f2 GN f1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=180 nf=36

* ---------- GN rise helper (source follower from VDD) ----------
* Supplies the first ~1.2V of the GN ramp from VDD instead of Cboot:
* faster early vgs rise and less wirebond current spike. Off when GN high.
XMN_h VDD hs_pre GN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=60 nf=12

* ---------- bootstrap charging switch ----------
* Gate driven by GN (self-timed): M_c can only conduct once GN has fallen
* within ~Vth of VLX, i.e. after VBST < VDD, so no Cboot-to-VDD dump.
* When the high side is on, GN = VBST keeps M_c off (vgs > 0).
XMP_c VBST GN VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=525 nf=105

* ---------- VLX-to-VSW tie (always on: gate = VBST) ----------
XMN_tie VLX VBST VSW VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=30

* ---------- low-side buffer: ls_pre -> ... -> GN2 (4 inversions) ----------
XMN_b1 ls_a ls_pre VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP_b1 ls_a ls_pre VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XNC_b1 VSS ls_a VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=16 nf=4
XMN_b2 ls_b ls_a VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMP_b2 ls_b ls_a VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XNC_b2 VSS ls_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=16 nf=4
XMN_b3 ls_c ls_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9 nf=2
XMP_b3 ls_c ls_b VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=18 nf=4
XMN_b4 GN2 ls_c VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=12
XMP_b4 GN2 ls_c VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=24

* ---------- on-chip capacitors ----------
XCM1 VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=60 l=60 m=4
XCM2 VDD VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50 m=2

.ends bootstrap_driver

* =====================================================================
*  All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver  (SKY130)
*
*  DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*    GN   : high-side gate output (floating VBST/VSW domain)
*    GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*    IN   : PWM input
*    VBST : bootstrap cap top pad
*    VDD  : driver supply (1.8 V)
*    VLX  : bootstrap cap bottom pad (tied on-chip to VSW)
*    VSS  : ground
*    VSW  : switch node (source of the high-side power NMOS)
*
*  Architecture
*    - cross-coupled NOR non-overlap generator; the two 4-inverter
*      delay chains set the two dead-time edges independently
*    - differential, statically quiescent level shifter built from
*      5 V (g5v0d10v5) devices feeding a floating cross-coupled latch
*    - tapered floating buffer in the VBST/VSW domain drives GN
*    - synchronous PMOS bootstrap switch VDD -> VBST.  Its gate is
*      pulled to VBST from the floating domain as soon as the high
*      side turns on, and only pulled down (switch on) by a 5 V NMOS
*      once the low-side gate is driven high, i.e. once VSW is
*      guaranteed to be at ground - so the switch can never dump the
*      bootstrap cap back into VDD.
*    - large on-chip NMOS-cap bootstrap reservoir in parallel with the
*      off-chip cboot behind the wirebond inductance
* =====================================================================
.param cboot=10n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* 1. VLX (off-chip bootstrap cap bottom pad) tie to switch node.
*    Main tie NMOS is biased from VBST so its Vgs = Vboot always.
*    The back-to-back diode devices only provide a dc path at
*    start-up before VBST has been charged.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
XTIE  VSW VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=120
XTDA  VSW VSW  VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=2 nf=1 m=2
XTDB  VLX VLX  VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=2 nf=1 m=2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* 2. On-chip bootstrap reservoir capacitor (NMOS cap VBST -> VSW)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
XCBST VSW VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=7 nf=1 m=950

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* 3. Input buffer
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
XIB1N inb IN  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XIB1P inb IN  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=1
XIB2N ina inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XIB2P ina inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* 4. Cross-coupled NOR non-overlap (dead-time) generator
*      hsen = NOR(inb, lsd)   lsen = NOR(ina, hsd)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
XNH1P nh1  inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XNH2P hsen lsd nh1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XNH1N hsen inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XNH2N hsen lsd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1

XNL1P nl1  ina VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XNL2P lsen hsd nl1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XNL1N lsen ina VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XNL2N lsen hsd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1

* dead-time chain, high-side branch  (sets HS-off -> LS-on dead time)
XDH1N dh1 hsen VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XDH1P dh1 hsen VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=1
XDH1C dh1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
XDH2N dh2 dh1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XDH2P dh2 dh1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=1
XDH2C dh2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
XDH3N dh3 dh2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XDH3P dh3 dh2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=1
XDH3C dh3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
XDH4N hsd dh3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XDH4P hsd dh3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=1
XDH4C hsd VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1

* dead-time chain, low-side branch  (sets LS-off -> HS-on dead time)
XDL1N dl1 lsen VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XDL1P dl1 lsen VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=1
XDL1C dl1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
XDL2N dl2 dl1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XDL2P dl2 dl1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=1
XDL2C dl2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
XDL3N dl3 dl2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XDL3P dl3 dl2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=1
XDL3C dl3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1
XDL4N lsd dl3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XDL4P lsd dl3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=1
XDL4C lsd VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 m=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* 5. Level-shifter input drivers (break-before-make)
*      lsb = /hsen  (reset),  lsa = hsen (set, one inverter later)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
XLB1N lsb hsen VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XLB1P lsb hsen VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XLB2N lsa lsb  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XLB2P lsa lsb  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* 6. Level shifter core (5 V devices, zero static current)
*      y2 low  = set   (high side on)
*      y1 low  = reset (high side off)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
XLSS  y2 lsa VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=4
XLSR  y1 lsb VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=4
XLPA  y1 y2  VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=2
XLPB  y2 y1  VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=2

* differential to full-swing conversion inside the floating domain
* (weak nmos keepers so the strong 5 V pmos inputs can flip the latch)
XSPA  oa y2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=4
XSPB  ob y1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=4
XSNA  oa ob VSW  VSW  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XSNB  ob oa VSW  VSW  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1 m=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* 7. Floating high-side buffer (VBST/VSW domain)
*      GN = oa (four inversions), high = high side on
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
XF1N f1 oa VSW  VSW  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1 m=1
XF1P f1 oa VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.5 nf=1 m=1
XF2N f2 f1 VSW  VSW  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XF2P f2 f1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=2
XF3N f3 f2 VSW  VSW  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=2
XF3P f3 f2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=6
XF4N GN f3 VSW  VSW  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=10
XF4P GN f3 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=27

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* 8. Synchronous bootstrap charge switch (VDD -> VBST)
*      bg = VBST  while the high side is on   (switch off)
*      bg = VSS   while the low  side is on   (switch on)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
XBGPU bg f1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4
XBGPD bg lb  VSS VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=6
XBSW  VBST bg VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=100

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* 9. Low-side buffer  (GN2 = lsen, four inversions)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
XG1N la lsen VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1 m=1
XG1P la lsen VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1 m=1
XG2N lb la   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XG2P lb la   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=2
XG3N lc lb   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=2
XG3P lc lb   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=6
XG4N GN2 lc  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=10
XG4P GN2 lc  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=27

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* -------------------------------------------------------------------
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver, SKY130, 1.8 V.
*
* Dead time: IN feeds two branches, each gated as on = x AND delay(x),
* so the turn-ON edge is delayed by the delay element while turn-OFF
* passes straight through. The delay element is a poly resistor + MIM
* capacitor: both are nominal in the tt/fs/sf sections and the poly
* tc1 is only 514 ppm/K, so the dead time barely moves over corner and
* temperature. A PMOS across each resistor shorts it on the reset edge,
* which removes the duty-cycle dependence of the RC starting point.
*
* High side: 5 V latching level shifter -> floating VBST/VSW buffer ->
* GN. A PMOS whose n-well sits on VBST recharges the bootstrap cap from
* VDD with no diode drop, so v(GN)-v(VSW) settles just below VDD.
*
* The 2 x 2 nH bond wires resonate with the on-chip reservoir; the VLX
* tie devices are sized to leave a couple of ohms of damping in that
* loop, which keeps the vgs and VBST-VLX peaks well under 2.15 V.
*
* cboot = 10 nF: large enough that the per-cycle droop is negligible,
* small enough that the bootstrap loop is in periodic steady state well
* before the 0.5 us measurement window opens.
* -------------------------------------------------------------------
.param cboot=10n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* VLX (bootstrap cap bottom pad) is bonded to the switch node on chip.
* LX1 conducts while VSW is low (and at start-up), LX2 while VSW is high.
XLX1 VSW VDD VLX VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=10
XLX2 VSW VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=30
* On-chip bootstrap reservoir (MOS cap, inversion) and VDD decoupling.
XCBST VSW VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1 m=2800
XCDEC VSS VDD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1 m=400
* Input buffer: n_inb = /IN, n_in = IN
XIAN n_inb IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XIAP n_inb IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1 m=1
XIBN n_in n_inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XIBP n_in n_inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=1
* HS branch: n_hdly = IN delayed by poly-R / MIM-C; hs_on = IN . n_hdly
XHAN n_hdrv n_in VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XHAP n_hdrv n_in VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XRH n_hdrv n_hrc VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=61.3 mult=1
XCH n_hrc VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10.75 l=10.75 mult=1
* HB shorts the resistor on the reset edge so n_hrc always restarts
* from the rail and the delay does not depend on the duty cycle.
XHR n_hrc n_in n_hdrv VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XHBN n_hdly n_hrc VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XHBP n_hdly n_hrc VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1 m=1
* NAND2(n_in, n_hdly) then invert -> n_hson
XHC1 n_hnd n_in VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XHC2 n_hnd n_hdly VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XHC3 n_hnd n_in n_hmid VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XHC4 n_hmid n_hdly VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XHDN n_hson n_hnd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XHDP n_hson n_hnd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1
* LS branch: n_ldly = /IN delayed; ls_on = /IN . n_ldly
XLAN n_ldrv n_inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XLAP n_ldrv n_inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XRL n_ldrv n_lrc VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=61.3 mult=1
XCL n_lrc VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=13.01 l=13.01 mult=1
XLR n_lrc n_inb n_ldrv VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XLBN n_ldly n_lrc VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XLBP n_ldly n_lrc VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1 m=1
XLC1 n_lnd n_inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XLC2 n_lnd n_ldly VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XLC3 n_lnd n_inb n_lmid VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XLC4 n_lmid n_ldly VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XLDN n_lson n_lnd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XLDP n_lson n_lnd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1
* Low-side taper buffer (4 inversions): n_lson high -> GN2 high
XLEN n_lb1 n_lson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XLEP n_lb1 n_lson VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=1
XLFN n_lb2 n_lb1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=2
XLFP n_lb2 n_lb1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=4
XLGN n_lb3 n_lb2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=5
XLGP n_lb3 n_lb2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=13
XLHN GN2 n_lb3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=40
XLHP GN2 n_lb3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=100
* Latching level shifter into the floating VBST/VSW domain. The latch
* nodes swing 0 V..VBST, so every device on them is a 5 V device. In
* either settled state the pulled-down node keeps its opposite PMOS off,
* so the shifter draws current only while it is being flipped.
XSAN n_hsonb n_hson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XSAP n_hsonb n_hson VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XSB n_lsa n_hson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1 m=8
XSC n_lsb n_hsonb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1 m=8
XSF n_lsa n_lsb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=1
XSG n_lsb n_lsa VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=1
* 5 V receiver inverter: input rides 0 V..VBST, output rides VSW..VBST
XSH n_fb1 n_lsb VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XSI n_fb1 n_lsb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1 m=2
* Floating taper buffer: n_lsb high -> n_fb1 low -> GN high
XFBN n_fb2 n_fb1 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=2
XFBP n_fb2 n_fb1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=4
XFCN n_fb3 n_fb2 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=10
XFCP n_fb3 n_fb2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=26
XFDN GN n_fb3 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=80
XFDP GN n_fb3 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=200
* Bootstrap charging PMOS (n-well tied to VBST). Its gate n_pg is taken
* two stages ahead of GN so the switch opens before VSW starts to rise.
XPAN n_pg n_fb1 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=4
XPAP n_pg n_fb1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=10
XPB VBST n_pg VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=100
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* ============================================================================
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver (SKY130)
*
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*
* Architecture
*   - input buffer -> two tunable delay chains -> AND / NOR dead-time generator
*   - low-side tapered buffer  (VDD/VSS domain)          -> GN2
*   - current-mirror level shifter (5V NMOS pull-down)   -> floating domain
*   - floating tapered buffer  (VBST/VSW domain)         -> GN
*   - bootstrap charging PMOS  (gate = GN, bulk = VBST, self-blocking)
*   - on-chip MOS bootstrap capacitor VBST->VSW (fast charge reservoir)
*   - VLX->VSW tie MOS (defines cap bottom plate, damps wirebond LC ring)
*
* Device class rationale
*   - every device whose terminal-pair voltages stay <= 1.8 V uses 1.8 V models
*   - the level-shift pull-down spans VSS .. (VBST-Vsg) ~ 2.8 V -> 5 V NMOS
* All MOS use nf=1 and multiplicity m so that W*L*nf*m equals the real area.
* ============================================================================
.param cboot=1n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* input buffer : nb = IN (buffered, same polarity)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XI1P na  IN  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XI1N na  IN  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XI2P nb  na  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XI2N nb  na  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* high-side delay chain (2 weak inverter stages, cap loaded) : dh2 = nb delayed
*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XDH1P dh1 nb  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1   nf=1 m=1
XDH1N dh1 nb  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XCH1N VSS dh1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XCH1P VDD dh1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XDH2P dh2 dh1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1   nf=1 m=1
XDH2N dh2 dh1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XCH2N VSS dh2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XCH2P VDD dh2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 nf=1 m=1

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* low-side delay chain : dl2 = nb delayed
*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XDL1P dl1 nb  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1   nf=1 m=1
XDL1N dl1 nb  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XCL1N VSS dl1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XCL1P VDD dl1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XDL2P dl2 dl1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1   nf=1 m=1
XDL2N dl2 dl1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XCL2N VSS dl2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XCL2P VDD dl2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 nf=1 m=1

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* dead-time logic
*   hs_on = nb AND dh2   (turn-on delayed, turn-off immediate)
*   ls_on = NOR(nb,dl2)  (turn-on delayed, turn-off immediate)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XNAP1 hs0 nb  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XNAP2 hs0 dh2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XNAN1 hs0 nb  nax VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XNAN2 nax dh2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XHSIP hs_on hs0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XHSIN hs_on hs0 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1

XNOP1 nox nb  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XNOP2 ls0 dl2 nox VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1
XNON1 ls0 nb  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XNON2 ls0 dl2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* low-side tapered buffer : GN2 = ls_on (4 inversions)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XL1P lb1 ls0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XL1N lb1 ls0 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XL2P lb2 lb1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=2
XL2N lb2 lb1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XL3P lb3 lb2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=10
XL3N lb3 lb2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=5
XL4P GN2 lb3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=30
XL4N GN2 lb3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=15

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* level shifter : ground referenced current source into a floating mirror
*   hs_on = 1  -> XMLS sinks I -> mirror sources I into lsc -> lsc = VBST
*   hs_on = 0  -> mirror off   -> XMSK pulls lsc to VSW
*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMLS lsa hs_on VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=1 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XMR  lsa lsa   VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XMM  lsc lsa   VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XMSK lsc VBST  VSW  VSW  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* floating tapered buffer : GN = lsc (4 inversions), VBST/VSW rails
*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XF1P fb1 lsc VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XF1N fb1 lsc VSW  VSW  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XF2P fb2 fb1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=2
XF2N fb2 fb1 VSW  VSW  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XF3P fb3 fb2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=10
XF3N fb3 fb2 VSW  VSW  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=5
XF4P GN  fb3 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=30
XF4N GN  fb3 VSW  VSW  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=15

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* bootstrap charging switch
*   gate = GN : ON when the high side is off (GN = VSW = 0), OFF when the high
*   side is on (GN = VBST = source) so it cannot discharge the bootstrap cap.
*   bulk = VBST keeps every junction reverse biased when VBST > VDD.
*   All terminal pair voltages stay <= 1.8 V -> 1.8 V device is adequate.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMCH VBST GN VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=180

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* VLX (off-chip bootstrap cap bottom plate) tie to VSW.
* Deliberately a few ohms: damps the 2 nH wirebond / cboot resonance.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMTIE VLX VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=180

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* on-chip bootstrap reservoir capacitor (MOS cap, VBST -> VSW)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XCBST VSW VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 nf=1 m=1000

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
.param cboot=47n

.subckt inv_1v8 a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2 m=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
.ends inv_1v8

.subckt delay_cell a y vdd vss
XP1 n1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=1.0 nf=1 m=1
XN1 n1 a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XP2 y n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=1.0 nf=1 m=1
XN2 y n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=0.5 nf=1 m=1
.ends delay_cell

.subckt nand2_1v8 a b y vdd vss
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2 m=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2 m=1
XN1 y a mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2 m=1
XN2 mid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2 m=1
.ends nand2_1v8

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* 1. Tie VLX to VSW through low-impedance switches so VLX tracks VSW closely
XNLX1 VLX VBST VSW VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10 m=20
XNLX2 VLX VDD  VSW VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10 m=5

* 2. On-chip MIM decoupling capacitor between VBST and VLX
XCBOOT_ON VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=30 l=30 m=20

* 3. Input buffer and complementary PWM signals
XINV_IN1 IN in_b VDD VSS inv_1v8
XINV_IN2 in_b in_buf VDD VSS inv_1v8

* 4. Non-overlapping dead-time generator (NAND SR latch with delay chains)
* High-side enable: hs_en (active high when IN is high)
* Low-side enable: ls_en (active high when IN is low)
XNAND_HS in_buf ls_fb hs_nand VDD VSS nand2_1v8
XINV_HSD1 hs_nand hs_en VDD VSS inv_1v8
XDEL_H1 hs_en hd1 VDD VSS delay_cell
XDEL_H2 hd1 hd2 VDD VSS delay_cell
XINV_HSFB hd2 hs_fb VDD VSS inv_1v8

XNAND_LS in_b hs_fb ls_nand VDD VSS nand2_1v8
XINV_LSD1 ls_nand ls_en VDD VSS inv_1v8
XDEL_L1 ls_en ld1 VDD VSS delay_cell
XDEL_L2 ld1 ld2 VDD VSS delay_cell
XINV_LSFB ld2 ls_fb VDD VSS inv_1v8

* 5. Low-side gate driver chain (drives GN2 from ls_en)
XINV_LS1 ls_en ls_b1 VDD VSS inv_1v8
XP_LS2 ls_b2 ls_b1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=5 m=2
XN_LS2 ls_b2 ls_b1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5 m=2
XP_LS3 ls_b3 ls_b2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=5 m=8
XN_LS3 ls_b3 ls_b2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5 m=8
XP_LS4 GN2 ls_b3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=5 m=32
XN_LS4 GN2 ls_b3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5 m=32

* 6. High-side level shifter (5V NMOS pull-downs + cross-coupled 1.8V PMOS load in VBST/VLX domain)
XINV_HS_EN hs_en hs_en_b VDD VSS inv_1v8

* Cross-coupled PMOS latch in VBST/VLX domain with clamping to VLX
XP_LS_L lsq_b lsq VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2 m=2
XP_LS_R lsq lsq_b VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2 m=2
* Clamp lsq_b and lsq so they never drop below VLX
XN_CLAMP_L lsq_b VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2 m=1
XN_CLAMP_R lsq   VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2 m=1
* Diode clamps to VLX
XN_DCL_L VLX lsq_b lsq_b VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2 m=2
XN_DCL_R VLX lsq   lsq   VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2 m=2

* 5V NMOS differential pull-down pair driven by hs_en and hs_en_b
XNHV_SET lsq_b hs_en   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 m=16
XNHV_RST lsq   hs_en_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 m=16

* 7. High-side gate driver chain in VBST/VLX domain (drives GN from lsq)
XP_HS1 hs_b1 lsq_b VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2 m=1
XN_HS1 hs_b1 lsq_b VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5  nf=1 m=1
XP_HS2 hs_b2 hs_b1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=5 m=2
XN_HS2 hs_b2 hs_b1 VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5 m=2
XP_HS3 hs_b3 hs_b2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=5 m=8
XN_HS3 hs_b3 hs_b2 VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5 m=8
XP_HS4 GN    hs_b3 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=5 m=32
XN_HS4 GN    hs_b3 VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5 m=32

* 8. Bootstrap charging switch (5V PMOS from VDD to VBST, gated by hs_b2)
* When high-side is OFF, hs_b2 = VLX = 0V -> PMOS ON, charges VBST to VDD.
* When high-side turns ON, hs_b2 = VBST -> PMOS OFF before GN rises.
XP_BOOT VDD hs_b2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 m=80
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Sky130 MOS syntax examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* 5V device examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* Cap:  XC a b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 m=4
*
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   - GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain, referenced to VBST/VLX)
*   - GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   - IN   : PWM input
*   - VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   - VDD  : driver supply
*   - VLX  : floating reference for the bootstrap driving (bootstrap cap bottom)
*   - VSS  : ground
*   - VSW  : switch node (midpoint of the external half-bridge power stage)
*
* The external power stage (two 450x50um NMOS), the 3.6 ohm load, and
* the 2 nH / 5 mOhm wirebond parasitics are all provided by the testbench.
* The testbench also adds 0.3 nH / 3 mOhm off-chip parasitics on the VDD and
* VSS supply rails.
* The testbench connects a designable off-chip bootstrap capacitor between
* the VBST and VLX pads through the wirebond parasitics. You choose its value
* by declaring .param cboot=<value> (at most 100 nF), e.g.:
*   .param cboot=620p
* You must design the bootstrap driver (charging path, level shifters,
* floating high-side buffer, low-side buffer, dead-time) and choose the sizes
* of the on-chip bootstrap capacitor and the internal devices so that the total
* on-chip device area (transistors + capacitors) does not exceed 35000 um^2.
* MOS area is W*L*nf*multiplicity; capacitor area is W*L*multiplicity. Local
* helper subcircuits are expanded recursively. Use only one multiplicity alias
* (m, mult, or mf) per instance and literal finite SPICE geometry values.
* Device voltage constraints (enforced on external nodes): v(VBST)-v(VLX) and
* v(GN2) peaks must stay below 2.15 V (1.8 V devices); v(VBST) peak must stay
* below 5.65 V (5 V devices).

XBC2 BC1 BC1 BC2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=50

XDHL1_P dhl_1 in_b VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 m=1

XDHL2_P dhl_2 dhl_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 m=1
XCDHL2 dhl_2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 m=1

XDHL3_N dhl_3 dhl_2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 m=1

XDHL4_P in_b_dly dhl_3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1

* NAND2(in_b, in_b_dly) -> ls_nand
XLS_NAND_N1 ls_nand in_b ls_nand_m VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=2
XLS_NAND_N2 ls_nand_m in_b_dly VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=2

XCDLH3 dlh_3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 m=1

XDLH4_N in_buf_dly dlh_3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XDLH4_P in_buf_dly dlh_3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1

*   - VSS  : ground
*   - VSW  : switch node (midpoint of the external half-bridge power stage)

* The external power stage (two 450x50um NMOS), the 3.6 ohm load, and
* the 2 nH / 5 mOhm wirebond parasitics are all provided by the testbench.
* The testbench also adds 0.3 nH / 3 mOhm off-chip parasitics on the VDD and
* VSS supply rails.
* The testbench connects a designable off-chip bootstrap capacitor between
* the VBST and VLX pads through the wirebond parasitics. You choose its value
* by declaring .param cboot=<value> (at most 100 nF), e.g.:
*   .param cboot=620p
* You must design the bootstrap driver (charging path, level shifters,
* floating high-side buffer, low-side buffer, dead-time) and choose the sizes
* of the on-chip bootstrap capacitor and the internal devices so that the total
* on-chip device area (transistors + capacitors) does not exceed 35000 um^2.
* MOS area is W*L*nf*multiplicity; capacitor area is W*L*multiplicity. Local
* helper subcircuits are expanded recursively. Use only one multiplicity alias
* (m, mult, or mf) per instance and literal finite SPICE geometry values.
* Device voltage constraints (enforced on external nodes): v(VBST)-v(VLX) and
* v(GN2) peaks must stay below 2.15 V (1.8 V devices); v(VBST) peak must stay
* below 5.65 V (5 V devices).

* The testbench connects a designable off-chip bootstrap capacitor between
* the VBST and VLX pads through the wirebond parasitics. You choose its value
* by declaring .param cboot=<value> (at most 100 nF), e.g.:
*   .param cboot=620p
* You must design the bootstrap driver (charging path, level shifters,
* floating high-side buffer, low-side buffer, dead-time) and choose the sizes
* of the on-chip bootstrap capacitor and the internal devices so that the total
* on-chip device area (transistors + capacitors) does not exceed 35000 um^2.
* MOS area is W*L*nf*multiplicity; capacitor area is W*L*multiplicity. Local
* helper subcircuits are expanded recursively. Use only one multiplicity alias
* (m, mult, or mf) per instance and literal finite SPICE geometry values.
* Device voltage constraints (enforced on external nodes): v(VBST)-v(VLX) and
* v(GN2) peaks must stay below 2.15 V (1.8 V devices); v(VBST) peak must stay
* below 5.65 V (5 V devices).
.param cboot=22n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* Ground-domain input conditioning.
XINV1 n_inb IN VDD VSS inv_lv
XINV2 n_in n_inb VDD VSS inv_lv

* Turn-on delayed, turn-off direct non-overlap commands.
XHD1 h_d1 n_in VDD VSS inv_delay_h
XHD2 h_del h_d1 VDD VSS inv_delay_h
XLSD1 l_d1 n_inb VDD VSS inv_delay
XLSD2 l_del l_d1 VDD VSS inv_delay

XHCMDB hs_cmdb h_del VDD VSS inv_lv
XLNAND ls_cmdb n_inb l_del VDD VSS nand2_lv
XLINV ls_cmd ls_cmdb VDD VSS inv_lv

* Low-side output buffer.
XLSB1 ls_b1 ls_cmd VDD VSS inv_buf_lv
XLSB2 GN2 ls_b1 VDD VSS inv_out_lv

* Keep the bootstrap reference and the measured switch node together.
XTIE VSW VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=300
XBOOTCAP VBST VLX cap_mim_boot

* Floating low-side-qualified charger control.  chg_g is pulled low only after
* the low-side command is active; otherwise it is restored to VBST.
