XCHGBP chg_gb chg_g VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 m=3
XCHGN chg_g ls_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 m=5
XCHGBN chg_gb ls_cmdb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 m=5

* Bootstrap charging path.
XCHG VDD chg_g VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 m=9

* Static 5 V level shifter into the floating bootstrap domain.
XLSHP hs_l hs_lb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 m=10
XLSHBP hs_lb hs_l VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 m=10
XLSHN hs_l h_del VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 m=18
XLSHBN hs_lb hs_cmdb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 m=18

* Floating high-side output stage.
XHOUTP GN hs_l VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=150
XHOUTN GN hs_l VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=120
.ends bootstrap_driver

.subckt inv_lv Y A VDD VSS
XMP Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XMN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
.ends inv_lv

.subckt inv_buf_lv Y A VDD VSS
XMP Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=4
XMN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=2
.ends inv_buf_lv

.subckt inv_out_lv Y A VDD VSS
XMP Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=38
XMN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=26
.ends inv_out_lv

.subckt inv_delay Y A VDD VSS
XMP Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=0.84
XMN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=0.84
XCD Y VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=7 w=7 mult=1
.ends inv_delay

.subckt inv_delay_h Y A VDD VSS
XMP Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=0.84
XMN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=0.84
XCD Y VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=2.5 w=2.5 mult=1
.ends inv_delay_h

.subckt nand2_lv Y A B VDD VSS
XMPA Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.6
XMPB Y B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.6
XMNA Y A n_mid VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XMNB n_mid B VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
.ends nand2_lv

.subckt cap_mim_boot A B
XC A B sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=170 w=170 mult=1
.ends cap_mim_boot

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Sky130 MOS syntax examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* 5V device examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* Cap:  XC a b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 m=4
*
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   - GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain, referenced to VBST/VLX)
*   - GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   - IN   : PWM input
*   - VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   - VDD  : driver supply
*   - VLX  : floating reference for the bootstrap driving (bootstrap cap bottom)
*   - VSS  : ground
*   - VSW  : switch node (midpoint of the external half-bridge power stage)
*
* The external power stage (two 450x50um NMOS), the 3.6 ohm load, and
* the 2 nH / 5 mOhm wirebond parasitics are all provided by the testbench.
* The testbench also adds 0.3 nH / 3 mOhm off-chip parasitics on the VDD and
* VSS supply rails.
* The testbench connects a designable off-chip bootstrap capacitor between
* the VBST and VLX pads through the wirebond parasitics. You choose its value
* by declaring .param cboot=<value> (at most 100 nF), e.g.:
*   .param cboot=620p
* You must design the bootstrap driver (charging path, level shifters,
* floating high-side buffer, low-side buffer, dead-time) and choose the sizes
* of the on-chip bootstrap capacitor and the internal devices so that the total
* on-chip device area (transistors + capacitors) does not exceed 35000 um^2.
* MOS area is W*L*nf*multiplicity; capacitor area is W*L*multiplicity. Local
* helper subcircuits are expanded recursively. Use only one multiplicity alias
* (m, mult, or mf) per instance and literal finite SPICE geometry values.
* Device voltage constraints (enforced on external nodes): v(VBST)-v(VLX) and
* v(GN2) peaks must stay below 2.15 V (1.8 V devices); v(VBST) peak must stay
* below 5.65 V (5 V devices).
.param cboot=10n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* The package bootstrap return is a floating copy of the switch node.  A
* complementary HV transmission path keeps VLX close to VSW in both
* directions while remaining inside the 5 V device domain.
XVLXN VSW VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=250
XVLXP VLX VSS VSW VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=250

* PMOS bootstrap charger.  Its body is tied to the boosted side and a
* floating gate command below drives the gate to VBST during boost, avoiding
* both channel and body-diode clamping of the raised supply.
XCHG VBST chgate VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=1000

* Ground-referenced complementary input and asymmetric delay cells.  The
* resistor charges each delay node slowly; the cross-controlled NMOS gives
* a fast discharge on the opposite edge.  The two delays therefore create
* non-overlap at both transitions.
XINBN inb IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XINBNN inb IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XRHD IN hdel VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=12
XCH hdel VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22.4 l=22.4 mult=1
XDH hdel inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4
XRLD inb ldel VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=24
XCL ldel VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22.4 l=22.4 mult=1
XDL ldel IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4

* Two-stage low-voltage buffers for the delayed commands.  Hcmd is the
* delayed high-side command; Lcmd is the delayed complementary command.
XHBN hbuf1 hdel VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XHBNN hbuf1 hdel VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XHBP hcmd hbuf1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XHBN2 hcmd hbuf1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XHINVB hcmdb hcmd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XHINVN hcmdb hcmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

XLBN lbuf1 ldel VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLBNN lbuf1 ldel VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLBP GN2 lbuf1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=20
XLBN2 GN2 lbuf1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=20

* Isolate the bootstrap-switch latch capacitance from the public low-side
* gate so its charge-pump control does not stretch GN2 edges.
XLCGP lctrl lbuf1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4
XLCGN lctrl lbuf1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4

* Bootstrap-switch level shifter.  chgate is low only after GN2 is high and
* the switch node has entered its recharge interval; otherwise it follows
* VBST and fully isolates the charge switch.
XCGN  chgate lctrl VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XCGNB chgb   lbuf1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XCGP  chgb   chgate VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XCGPB chgate chgb   VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4

* Cross-coupled 5 V level shifter.  When Hcmd is high, the hbar branch is
* pulled to VLX and the opposite latch node rises to VBST; the output
* inverter consequently drives GN high in the floating domain.
XLSN  hbar hcmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=100
XLSNB h     hcmdb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=100
XLSP  h     hbar VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XLSPB hbar h    VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4

* Floating high-side output buffer, sized for the external 450-finger gate.
XHOP GN hbar VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=60
XHON GN hbar VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=24
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Sky130 MOS syntax examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* 5V device examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* Cap:  XC a b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 m=4
*
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   - GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain, referenced to VBST/VLX)
*   - GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   - IN   : PWM input
*   - VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   - VDD  : driver supply
*   - VLX  : floating reference for the bootstrap driving (bootstrap cap bottom)
*   - VSS  : ground
*   - VSW  : switch node (midpoint of the external half-bridge power stage)
*
* The external power stage (two 450x50um NMOS), the 3.6 ohm load, and
* the 2 nH / 5 mOhm wirebond parasitics are all provided by the testbench.
* The testbench also adds 0.3 nH / 3 mOhm off-chip parasitics on the VDD and
* VSS supply rails.
* The testbench connects a designable off-chip bootstrap capacitor between
* the VBST and VLX pads through the wirebond parasitics. You choose its value
* by declaring .param cboot=<value> (at most 100 nF), e.g.:
*   .param cboot=620p
* You must design the bootstrap driver (charging path, level shifters,
* floating high-side buffer, low-side buffer, dead-time) and choose the sizes
* of the on-chip bootstrap capacitor and the internal devices so that the total
* on-chip device area (transistors + capacitors) does not exceed 35000 um^2.
* MOS area is W*L*nf*multiplicity; capacitor area is W*L*multiplicity. Local
* helper subcircuits are expanded recursively. Use only one multiplicity alias
* (m, mult, or mf) per instance and literal finite SPICE geometry values.
* Device voltage constraints (enforced on external nodes): v(VBST)-v(VLX) and
* v(GN2) peaks must stay below 2.15 V (1.8 V devices); v(VBST) peak must stay
* below 5.65 V (5 V devices).
.param cboot=20n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* Bootstrap-referenced return switch: on whenever the floating supply is valid.
* It joins the bootstrap return pad to the external power-switch source.
XNREF VSW VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=400 nf=1

* Ground-domain complement.  IN high commands the high-side switch on.
XPINV INB IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
XNINV INB IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1

* Prebuffer isolates the package input edge from the large low-side output
* devices and produces the true-polarity low-side control.
XPLB LSCTL INB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=1
XNLB LSCTL INB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1

* Rising-edge-only delay for the high-side command.  The strong NMOS resets
* the delay node promptly so high-side turn-off is not delayed.
XPHD INHS INB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNHD INHS INB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
XCDLY INHS VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 mf=1

* Static 5 V level shifter.  HCTL is high for the low-side interval and low
* for the high-side interval, so it can directly drive a floating inverter.
XNLS0 HCTL INHS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=80 nf=1
XNLS1 HCTLB INB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=80 nf=1
XPLS0 HCTL HCTLB VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1
XPLS1 HCTLB HCTL VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1

* Floating high-side gate buffer.
XPGH GN HCTL VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=310 nf=1
XNGH GN HCTL VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=300 nf=1

* GN turns this isolated-well charger off before VBST rises above VDD.
XPCH VBST GN VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=180 nf=1

* Low-side output: strong turn-off and deliberately slower turn-on create
* non-overlap on both input edges together with the high-side path delay.
XPGN2 GN2 LSCTL VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=1
XNGN2 GN2 LSCTL VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300 nf=1

* Local charge reservoirs at the two package-inductance boundaries.
XCBST VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=100 w=100 mf=3
XCVDD VDD VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=50 w=50 mf=1
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Bootstrap high-side driver for all-NMOS half-bridge.
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   GN   : high-side gate output (floating VBST/VLX domain)
*   GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   IN   : PWM input (0-1.8V, through 50 ohm series resistor)
*   VBST : bootstrap cap top pad
*   VDD  : 1.8V supply
*   VLX  : bootstrap cap bottom pad (floating reference / HS bulk)
*   VSS  : ground
*   VSW  : switch node (half-bridge midpoint)
.param cboot=600p

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* =================================================================
* 1) Input buffer (1.8 V domain): reshape IN with small input cap.
*    Even number of stages so inb follows IN (non-inverting).
* =================================================================
XI1b0 n1 IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 m=1
XI1b1 n1 IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1
XI2a0 inb n1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=1 m=1
XI2a1 inb n1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.05 nf=1 m=1
XI4c0 inn inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=1 m=1
XI4c1 inn inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.05 nf=1 m=1

* =================================================================
* 2) Dead-time generation (1.8 V domain)
*    Skewed delay: hs_cmd rises late (HS on delayed), falls fast;
*                  ls_cmd rises late (LS on delayed), falls fast.
* =================================================================
* -- hs arm: node hs_d falls slowly through weak long-L NMOS --
Xh1 hs_d inb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=1 m=1
Xh2 hs_d inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1
Xh3 hs_cmd hs_d VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=1 m=1
Xh4 hs_cmd hs_d VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=1 m=1
Xh5 hs_cmdN hs_cmd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=1 m=1
Xh6 hs_cmdN hs_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.05 nf=1 m=1
* -- ls arm: node ls_d falls slowly through weak long-L NMOS --
Xl1 ls_d inn VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=1 m=1
Xl2 ls_d inn VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1
Xl3 ls_cmd ls_d VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=1 m=1
Xl4 ls_cmd ls_d VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=1 m=1
Xl5 ls_cmdN ls_cmd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=1 m=1
Xl6 ls_cmdN ls_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.05 nf=1 m=1

* =================================================================
* 3) Level shifter (5 V devices): low-domain hs_cmd -> q in VBST/VLX domain
*    hs on  => q = VBST ; hs off => q ~ 0 V
*    Strong NFETs so q flips fast even with the charging-switch
*    gate on q (a stuck latch = delayed HS off = shoot-through).
* =================================================================
XlsA q qb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=8
XlsB qb q VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=4
XlsC q hs_cmdN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=15 nf=1 m=16
XlsD qb hs_cmd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=15 nf=1 m=6

* =================================================================
* 4) Floating predriver (5 V inverter, VBST/VLX rails): q -> c
* =================================================================
XpdP c q VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1 m=6
XpdN c q VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1 m=4

* =================================================================
* 5) Final high-side driver (1.8 V, VBST/VLX rails, bulks local): c -> GN
* =================================================================
XfdP GN c VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=96
XfdN GN c VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=24

* =================================================================
* 6) Low-side driver (1.8 V, VDD/VSS rails): ls_cmd -> GN2 (non-inverting)
*    ls_cmdN is the active-low command; gate the driver with it so GN2 = ls_cmd.
* =================================================================
XldP GN2 ls_cmdN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=10
XldN GN2 ls_cmdN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=12

* =================================================================
* 7) Bootstrap charging switch (5 V PMOS): VDD -> VBST, on during LS on
*    Gate = q (level-shifted): q=VSS during LS => forward charge;
*    q=VBST during HS => all terminals at VBST, blocks reverse
*    conduction (VBST rises ~1.8 V above VDD while HS is on).
* =================================================================
Xchg VBST q VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=50 nf=1 m=64

* =================================================================
* 8) VLX-VSW clamp switch (5 V NMOS): keep VLX following VSW
* =================================================================
Xsws VSW VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1 m=24

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Sky130 bootstrap high-side gate driver for an all-NMOS half-bridge.
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   - GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain, referenced to VBST/VLX)
*   - GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   - IN   : PWM input
*   - VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   - VDD  : driver supply
*   - VLX  : floating reference for the bootstrap driving
*   - VSS  : ground
*   - VSW  : switch node (midpoint of the external half-bridge power stage)
.param cboot=2n

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Low-voltage (1.8 V) digital helpers
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt inv2x out in vdd vss
X0 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
X1 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
.ends inv2x

.subckt inv8x out in vdd vss
X0 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=2
X1 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=4
.ends inv8x

.subckt nand2x out a b vdd vss
X0 out a nb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
X1 nb1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
X2 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
X3 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
.ends nand2x

* Non-inverting RC delay buffer (dead-time element)
.subckt dlyrc in out vdd vss
X0 n1 in vdd vss inv8x
XRIN n1 rc vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=100
XCM rc vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=9 l=9 mult=1
X1 n2 rc vdd vss inv8x
X2 n3 n2 vdd vss inv8x
X3 out n3 vdd vss inv8x
.ends dlyrc

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bootstrap high-side driver
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* ---- input buffer (A follows IN, Ab = !A) ----
XIB1 ina IN VDD VSS inv2x
XIB2 A  ina VDD VSS inv2x
XIB3 Ab A  VDD VSS inv2x

* ---- dead-time generator: two non-overlapping phases ----
* h_on = A AND NOT(d_l);  l_on = NOT(A) AND NOT(d_h)
XDL d_l l_on VDD VSS dlyrc
XDH d_h h_on VDD VSS dlyrc
XIVL dlb d_l VDD VSS inv2x
XIVH dhb d_h VDD VSS inv2x
XND1 nt1 A dlb VDD VSS nand2x
XINV1 h_on nt1 VDD VSS inv2x
XND2 nt2 Ab dhb VDD VSS nand2x
XINV2 l_on nt2 VDD VSS inv2x
XIVH2 honb h_on VDD VSS inv2x

* ---- low-side output stage (drives GN2, push-pull inverts l_onb) ----
XIVL2 l_onb l_on VDD VSS inv2x
XPLS GN2 l_onb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=50
XNLS GN2 l_onb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=25

* ---- level shifter (0/VDD -> 0/VBST), 5 V devices ----
XLSN1 xb h_on VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1 m=4
XLSN2 xs honb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1 m=4
XLSP1 xb VBST xs VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1 m=4
XLSP2 xs VBST xb VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1 m=4

* ---- floating inverter (VBST/VLX domain) ----
XFP c xs VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1 m=8
XFN c xs VLX VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1 m=4

* ---- high-side output stage (drives GN between VLX and VBST) ----
XHP VBST GN c VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1 m=250
XHN GN c VLX VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1 m=50

* ---- bootstrap charging path: PMOS switch VDD->VBST (body=VBST) ----
XCHG VBST h_on VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1 m=200

* ---- floating-reference tie: on-chip connect VLX to switch node VSW ----
* NMOS pass with gate driven by VBST so it conducts over the full VSW range
XPAS VLX VBST VSW VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=200

* ---- on-chip decoupling / bootstrap capacitance ----
XC1 VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=71 l=71 mult=1
XC2 VDD VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50 mult=1

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Sky130 all-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   GN   : high-side gate (drives high-side power NMOS gate)
*   GN2  : low-side gate (drives low-side power NMOS gate)
*   IN   : PWM input (VDD domain)
*   VBST : bootstrap cap top
*   VDD  : driver supply (1.8V)
*   VLX  : floating reference / bootstrap cap bottom
*   VSS  : ground
*   VSW  : switch node
*
* Architecture:
*   - VLX is shorted to VSW (same physical switch node).
*   - Bootstrap charging: 5V PMOS synchronous rectifier (VDD->VBST),
*     bulk tied to VBST, gate driven by GN (on while high-side is off).
*   - Dead time: in_b and its delayed copy ind are combined with an AND
*     (-> hs, high-side command) and a NOR (-> lo, low-side command), which
*     yields non-overlapping rising edges with dead time ~= the delay.
*   - Low-side driver: 1.8V CMOS chain -> GN2 (VDD/VSS domain).
*   - Level shifter: 5V NMOS input pair (source=VSS) + cross-coupled 5V PMOS
*     latch (source=VBST) converts the VDD-domain hs to a 0..VBST swing.
*   - High-side buffer: first 5V inverter (accepts 0..VBST input), then 1.8V
*     CMOS chain powered VBST..VLX -> GN (VLX..VBST swing).

.param cboot=10n

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* VLX <-> VSW short (same switch node). Always-on 5V NMOS (gate=VBST).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XSWL VLX VBST VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1 m=60

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bootstrap charging path: PMOS synchronous rectifier VDD -> VBST.
* source=VDD, drain=VBST, bulk=VBST (floating n-well), gate=GN.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XCB VBST GN VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1 m=60

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Input buffer: IN -> nin -> in_b  (in_b = IN, buffered)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XIN0 nin IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XIP0 nin IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XIN1 in_b nin VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XIP1 in_b nin VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Delay element: transmission gate + MIM cap, then two inverters to square.
* in_b -> nd -> (inv) -> ni1 -> (inv) -> ind   (ind = delayed in_b)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XTRN nd VDD in_b VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=6 nf=1 m=1
XTRP nd VSS in_b VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=18 l=6 nf=3 m=1
XCD nd VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=4 mult=1
XDL0 ni1 nd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XDLP0 ni1 nd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XDL1 ind ni1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XDLP1 ind ni1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Dead-time combinational logic (1.8V CMOS)
*   hs_b = NAND(in_b, ind)
*   hs   = NOT(hs_b)  = AND(in_b, ind)
*   lo   = NOR(in_b, ind)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* NAND(in_b, ind): series NMOS pull-down, parallel PMOS pull-up.
XNND1 nand_o in_b nmid VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XNND2 nmid ind VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XPND1 nand_o in_b VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XPND2 nand_o ind VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
* hs = NOT(nand_o)
XHS0 hs nand_o VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XHSP0 hs nand_o VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
* NOR(in_b, ind): parallel NMOS pull-down, series PMOS pull-up.
XNOR1 lo in_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XNOR2 lo ind VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XPOR1 lo in_b pmid VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XPOR2 pmid ind VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Low-side driver chain: lo -> l1 -> l2 -> l3 -> GN2 (non-inverting)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XLN1 l1 lo VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XLP1 l1 lo VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XLN2 l2 l1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XLP2 l2 l1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 m=3
XLN3 l3 l2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 m=3
XLP3 l3 l2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 m=9
XLN4 GN2 l3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 m=7
XLP4 GN2 l3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 m=19

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Level shifter: 5V NMOS input pair (source=VSS) + cross-coupled 5V PMOS.
*   B = hs (level shifted to 0..VBST swing)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XLSN1 A hs VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1 m=3
XLSN2 B nand_o VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1 m=3
XLSP1 A B VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XLSP2 B A VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* High-side buffer chain: B -> b1 -> b2 -> b3 -> GN (non-inverting)
*   b1 stage: 5V inverter powered VBST..VLX (accepts 0..VBST input).
*   b2,b3: 1.8V inverters powered VBST..VLX.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XHN1 b1 B VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1 m=6
XHP1 b1 B VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1 m=6
XHN2 b2 b1 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 m=3
XHP2 b2 b1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 m=6
XHN3 b3 b2 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 m=28
XHP3 b3 b2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 m=40
XHN4 GN b3 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 m=20
XHP4 GN b3 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 m=170

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver.
* DUT: .subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*
* Architecture:
*   - VLX is tied to VSW (floating reference = switch node) via an always-on
*     transmission gate.
*   - Bootstrap charging path: floating-well PMOS switch (source=VDD, drain=VBST,
*     bulk=VBST) driven by GN. When the low side is on (VSW~0, GN~VLX~0) the
*     switch charges VBST to VDD; when the high side turns on (GN~VBST) it blocks.
*   - Dead-time logic (VDD/VSS domain): HS_ON = IN & DELAY(IN),
*     LS_ON = ~IN & DELAY(~IN)  ->  non-overlapping gate commands.
*   - Level shifter: cross-coupled 5 V PMOS latch in the VBST/VLX floating
*     domain, pulled down by 5 V NMOS referenced to VSS, followed by one 5 V
*     inverter that restores a clean VLX..VBST swing for the 1.8 V buffer chain.
*   - Low-side driver: tapered 1.8 V buffer in the VDD/VSS domain.
*
.param cboot=2n

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* =================== VLX <-> VSW tie (always-on transmission gate) ===========
XTG_N VLX VDD VSW VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=200 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XTG_P VLX VSS VSW VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=400 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1

* =================== input inversion ========================================
XINV1 nb IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XINV1P nb IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1

* =================== delay elements (RC, ~4.5 ns @ 0.9 V) ====================
* DELAY(IN)
XRDI IN rcin VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=45 mult=1
XCDI rcin VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=6 l=5 mult=1
XDI1 din_b rcin VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XDI1P din_b rcin VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XDI2 d_in din_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XDI2P d_in din_b VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1

* DELAY(~IN)
XRDIB nb rcnb VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=45 mult=1
XCDIB rcnb VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=6 l=5 mult=1
XDIB1 dnb_b rcnb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XDIB1P dnb_b rcnb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XDIB2 d_nb dnb_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XDIB2P d_nb dnb_b VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1

* =================== non-overlap / dead-time generation =====================
* HS_ON = AND(IN, DELAY(IN)) = NOT(NAND(IN, DELAY(IN)))
XNH1 hs_n IN hs_nm VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XNH2 hs_nm d_in VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XPH1 hs_n IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XPH2 hs_n d_in VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XIH hs_on hs_n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XIHP hs_on hs_n VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1

* LS_ON = AND(~IN, DELAY(~IN))
XNL1 ls_n nb ls_nm VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XNL2 ls_nm d_nb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XPL1 ls_n nb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XPL2 ls_n d_nb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XIL ls_on ls_n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XILP ls_on ls_n VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1

* =================== low-side tapered buffer -> GN2 =========================
* path-balancing delay: RC + sharpen to match the HS level-shifter latency
XRDL ls_on ls_rc VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=15 mult=1
XCDL ls_rc VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=2 l=2 mult=1
XLD1 ls_d1 ls_rc VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XLD1P ls_d1 ls_rc VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XLD2 ls_d2 ls_d1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XLD2P ls_d2 ls_d1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XLB1 lb1 ls_d2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XLB1P lb1 ls_d2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XLB2 lb2 lb1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=16 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XLB2P lb2 lb1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=32 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XLB3 lb3 lb2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=64 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XLB3P lb3 lb2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=128 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XLBO GN2 lb3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=160 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XLBOP GN2 lb3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=320 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1

* =================== high-side level shifter (5 V) ==========================
* Cross-coupled PMOS latch, source=VBST, bulk=VBST; NMOS pull-downs to VSS.
XLSN1 lsh_a hs_on VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=12 l=0.5 nf=1 mult=1
XLSN2 lsh_b hs_n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=12 l=0.5 nf=1 mult=1
XLSP1 lsh_a lsh_b VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=3 l=0.5 nf=1 mult=1
XLSP2 lsh_b lsh_a VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=3 l=0.5 nf=1 mult=1

* 5 V inverter: GN_pre = ~lsh_a  (restores clean VLX..VBST swing)
XHVN gnpre lsh_a VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=4 l=0.5 nf=1 mult=1
XHVP gnpre lsh_a VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=8 l=0.5 nf=1 mult=1

* =================== high-side tapered buffer -> GN =========================
XHB1 hb1 gnpre VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XHB1P hb1 gnpre VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XHB2 hb2 hb1 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=16 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XHB2P hb2 hb1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=32 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XHB3 hb3 hb2 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=64 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XHB3P hb3 hb2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=128 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XHBO GN hb3 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=160 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1
XHBOP GN hb3 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=320 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1

* =================== bootstrap charging switch (floating-well PMOS) =========
* source=VDD, drain=VBST, bulk=VBST, gate=GN.
XMBST VBST GN VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=800 l=0.15 nf=1 mult=1

* =================== on-chip decoupling =====================================
* On-chip bootstrap cap (VBST - VLX) for the floating supply.
XCIN VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=150 mult=1
* VDD rail decoupling (VDD - VSS).
XCDD VDD VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100 mult=1

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Sky130 MOS syntax examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* 5V device examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* Cap:  XC a b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 m=4
*
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   - GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain, referenced to VBST/VLX)
*   - GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   - IN   : PWM input
*   - VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   - VDD  : driver supply
*   - VLX  : floating reference for the bootstrap driving (bootstrap cap bottom)
*   - VSS  : ground
*   - VSW  : switch node (midpoint of the external half-bridge power stage)
*
* The external power stage (two 450x50um NMOS), the 3.6 ohm load, and
* the 2 nH / 5 mOhm wirebond parasitics are all provided by the testbench.
* The testbench also adds 0.3 nH / 3 mOhm off-chip parasitics on the VDD and
* VSS supply rails.
* The testbench connects a designable off-chip bootstrap capacitor between
* the VBST and VLX pads through the wirebond parasitics. You choose its value
* by declaring .param cboot=<value> (at most 100 nF), e.g.:
*   .param cboot=620p
* You must design the bootstrap driver (charging path, level shifters,
* floating high-side buffer, low-side buffer, dead-time) and choose the sizes
* of the on-chip bootstrap capacitor and the internal devices so that the total
* on-chip device area (transistors + capacitors) does not exceed 35000 um^2.
* MOS area is W*L*nf*multiplicity; capacitor area is W*L*multiplicity. Local
* helper subcircuits are expanded recursively. Use only one multiplicity alias
* (m, mult, or mf) per instance and literal finite SPICE geometry values.
* Device voltage constraints (enforced on external nodes): v(VBST)-v(VLX) and
* v(GN2) peaks must stay below 2.15 V (1.8 V devices); v(VBST) peak must stay
* below 5.65 V (5 V devices).
.param cboot=100n

* Ground-referenced CMOS inverter.
.subckt inv_core Y A VP VN
XN Y A VN VN sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP Y A VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
.ends inv_core

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* The bootstrap bottom pad is the floating driver's Kelvin switch reference.
RLX VLX VSW 5m

* Local high-frequency reservoir; the large capacitor is off chip.
XCBOOT VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100 mult=3

* Restore the package input and form both polarities.
XINV0 NIN IN VDD VSS inv_core
XINV1 PIN NIN VDD VSS inv_core

* HRC rises slowly and falls quickly: delayed high-side turn-on.
RH PIN HRC 3k
XHCL HRC NIN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XH0 HRCB HRC VDD VSS inv_core
XH1 HSON HRCB VDD VSS inv_core

* LRC rises slowly and falls quickly: delayed low-side turn-on.
RL NIN LRC 10k
XLCL LRC PIN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=2
XL0 LRCB LRC VDD VSS inv_core
XL1 LSON LRCB VDD VSS inv_core
XLB LSONB LSON VDD VSS inv_core

* Physical timing capacitors.  The nominal RC crossing is near 5 ns.
XCH HRC VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=20 mult=1
XCL LRC VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=20 mult=1

* Low-side power-gate buffer.
XNLO GN2 LSONB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=40
XPLO GN2 LSONB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=30

* Active bootstrap charging switch.  Its gate is returned to VBST when off,
* and is pulled to ground only during the low-side phase.
RCHG PCHG VBST 100k
XNCH PCHG NIN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XPOCH PCHG NIN VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
XPCH0 VDD PCHG VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=240 nf=1
XPCH1 VDD PCHG VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=240 nf=1
XPCH2 VDD PCHG VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=240 nf=1
XPCH3 VDD PCHG VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=240 nf=1
XPCH4 VDD PCHG VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=240 nf=1

* Direct high-side level shifter/output stage.  HSON pulls PDRV low after
* dead time; NIN discharges GN immediately when the high-side phase ends.
RDRV PDRV VBST 8k
XNDRV0 PDRV HSON VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XNDRV1 PDRV HSON VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XNDRV2 PDRV HSON VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XPDRV0 GN PDRV VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=114 nf=1
XPDRV1 GN PDRV VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=114 nf=1
XPDRV2 GN PDRV VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=114 nf=1
ROFF NIN NOFF 1k
XNHOFF0 GN NOFF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=160 nf=1
XNHOFF1 GN NOFF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=160 nf=1
XNHOFF2 GN NOFF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=160 nf=1
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver (SKY130)
* DUT: .subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*
* Architecture:
*  - Dead-time / non-overlap logic in the VDD domain (IN, delayed IN).
*  - Low-side gate drive GN2 = AND(IN, IN_delayed) buffered.
*  - Resistive level shifter (R + 5V NMOS pull-down) generates a
*    VBST/VSW-referenced signal x = NOT(OR(IN, IN_delayed)).
*  - Floating tapered buffer drives the high-side gate GN.
*  - 5V PMOS bootstrap charging switch (bulk tied to VBST), gated by
*    NAND(IN, IN_delayed) so it only charges while the switch node is low.
*  - VLX (bootstrap-cap bottom / HS bulk) is tied to VSW.

.param cboot=1n

* ---------------- Basic logic gates (VDD domain, 1.8 V LVT devices) ----------------
.subckt INV A Y VDD VSS
XMP Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4 m=1
XMN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 m=1
.ends INV

.subckt NAND2 A B Y VDD VSS
XMP1 Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4 m=1
XMP2 Y B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4 m=1
XMN1 Y A n1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XMN2 n1 B VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 m=1
.ends NAND2

.subckt NOR2 A B Y VDD VSS
XMN1 Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XMN2 Y B VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XMP1 Y A p1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4 m=1
XMP2 p1 B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4 m=1
.ends NOR2

* ---------------- Top-level bootstrap driver ----------------
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* Tie the floating reference VLX (bootstrap-cap bottom, HS bulk) to VSW.
XRL VLX VSW VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=500 l=1

* --- Input buffer ---
XIN1 IN inb VDD VSS INV
XIN2 inb in VDD VSS INV

* --- Dead-time delay (~5 ns RC, poly resistor + MIM cap) ---
XRD in drc VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=8
XCD drc VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=13 l=13.5
XDLY drc indb VDD VSS INV
XDLY2 indb ind VDD VSS INV

* --- Dead-time / non-overlap logic ---
* chg = NAND(in, ind): low while the low side is fully on -> charging switch on
XNAND1 in ind chg VDD VSS NAND2
* lowc = AND(in, ind): low-side gate command
XIN3 chg lowc VDD VSS INV
* hioff = OR(in, ind): level-shifter pull-down command (high side off)
XNOR1 in ind hioffb VDD VSS NOR2
XIN4 hioffb hioff VDD VSS INV

* --- Low-side gate driver chain (lowc -> GN2) ---
XMP_L1 g2a lowc VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7 m=3
XMN_L1 g2a lowc VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 m=1
XMP_L2 GN2 g2a VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7 m=28
XMN_L2 GN2 g2a VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 m=12

* --- Bootstrap charging switch ---
* 1.8 V LVT PMOS, floating n-well tied to VBST. Its gate is driven by a
* VBST/VSW-referenced copy of the level-shifter output x (NOT(OR(IN,IN_del))):
*  - low side on (x=0): gate low -> switch on, VBST charges from VDD.
*  - high side on (x=VBST): gate=VBST -> switch off, blocks VBST>VDD so the
*    bootstrap cap cannot discharge back into VDD (reverse conduction).
* A VDD-domain gate (chg) would stay at ~1.8 V while VBST floats to ~3.4 V,
* leaving Vsg=VBST-1.8>|Vtp| and turning the switch on in reverse.
XMP_C1 xc1 x2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7 m=1
XMN_C1 xc1 x2 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 m=1
XMP_C2 xc xc1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7 m=5
XMN_C2 xc xc1 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 m=2
XCHG VBST xc VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7 m=40

* --- Resistive level shifter (VBST-referenced) ---
XRS VBST x VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=2 l=5
XMS x hioff VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=2

* --- Floating buffer (VBST/VSW domain): x -> GN (non-inverting) ---
* F1: floating inverter (VBST/VSW domain). x swings rail-to-rail in the
* floating domain (VSW..VBST), so 1.8 V LVT devices are within their voltage
* limits here and avoid the high-temp/slow-corner convergence issues of the
* 5 V gate devices at this node.
XMP_F1 xb x VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7 m=2
XMN_F1 xb x VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 m=1
* F2
XMP_F2 x2 xb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7 m=3
XMN_F2 x2 xb VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 m=1
* F3
XMP_F3 x3 x2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7 m=10
XMN_F3 x3 x2 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 m=5
* F4 -> GN
XMP_F4 GN x3 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7 m=56
XMN_F4 GN x3 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 m=22

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver
* Architecture:
*   - input squaring inverters: A=~IN, B=IN
*   - RC delay (poly R + MIM C) for the dead-time reference
*   - NAND/NOR non-overlap logic: H=B*D (rise delayed), L=~(B+D) (fall delayed)
*   - 5V level shifter: pull-down NMOS (source VSS) vs cross-coupled 5V PMOS
*     loads on VBST; the cross-coupled pair itself retains state
*   - floating 5V decoder inverters produce SBN (HS-on command, VBST when set)
*     and RBN (VLX when set); SBN drives the HS buffer directly (no latch)
*     and RBN drives the bootstrap-switch gate pull-up
*   - tapered 1.8V buffer chains: 6 stages for GN (floating, bulks VLX/VBST),
*     8 stages for GN2 so the LS edges trail the HS edges
*   - 5V PMOS bootstrap switch VDD->VBST: gate pulled to VLX while charging,
*     pulled to VBST by RBN while HS is on
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
.param cboot=2.2n

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* ---- bootstrap bottom reference: VLX follows VSW through damping resistor ----
* (resistor wrapper does not apply mult electrically, so use total w)
XRD VSW VLX VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=2000 l=0.5 mult=1

* ---- input squaring: A=~IN, B=IN ----
XPIB1 A IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XNIB1 A IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPIB2 B A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XNIB2 B A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

* ---- RC delay line: poly R + MIM C ----
XRDLY B drc VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=18 mult=1
XCDLY drc VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=6 mult=1
XPD1 d1 drc VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XND1 d1 drc VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPD2 D d1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XND2 D d1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

* ---- non-overlap logic ----
* H = B*D : NAND2 then INV (H drives the 5V level-shifter NMOS gate)
XPH1 hn B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XPH2 hn D VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNH1 hn B hx VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XNH2 hx D VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XPH3 H hn VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XNH3 H hn VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* L = ~(B+D) : NOR2
XPL1 L B lx VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XPL2 lx D VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XNL1 L B VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNL2 L D VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---- 5V level shifter: H sets, A (~IN) resets ----
XNSET SN H VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XNRST RN A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XPLS1 SN RN VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XPLS2 RN SN VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=2 nf=1

* ---- floating 5V decoder inverters (inputs may sit 0 with VLX at 1.8) ----
* SBN = VBST when set (SN low): high-side-on command
* RBN = VLX when set (RN high): bootstrap-switch gate pull-up command
XPDC1 SBN SN VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XNDC1 SBN SN VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XPDC2 RBN RN VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XNDC2 RBN RN VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1

* ---- high-side tapered buffer chain (floating 1.8V, 6 stages even) ----
* input SBN high (VBST) when HS on -> GN high
XPHB0 h0 SBN VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNHB0 h0 SBN VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPHB1 h1 h0 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNHB1 h1 h0 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPHB2 h2 h1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XNHB2 h2 h1 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
XPHB3 h3 h2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XNHB3 h3 h2 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XPHB4 h4 h3 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36 nf=4
XNHB4 h4 h3 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=18 nf=2
XPHB5 GN h4 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=10
XNHB5 GN h4 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=5

* ---- low-side tapered buffer chain (8 stages: extra pair trails HS edges) ----
XPLB0 l0 L VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNLB0 l0 L VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPLB1 l1 l0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
XNLB1 l1 l0 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.3 nf=1
XPLB2 l2 l1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNLB2 l2 l1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPLB3 l3 l2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XNLB3 l3 l2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.5 nf=1
XPLB4 l4 l3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=13 nf=2
XNLB4 l4 l3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.5 nf=1
XPLB5 l5 l4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=26 nf=3
XNLB5 l5 l4 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=13 nf=1
XPLB6 l6 l5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=52 nf=6
XNLB6 l6 l5 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=26 nf=3
XPLB7 GN2 l6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=10
XNLB7 GN2 l6 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=5

* ---- bootstrap switch: strong 5V PMOS VDD -> VBST ----
* total W=3600: low Ron so 2.2nF recharges within the shortest LS-on window
XBSTSW VDD BG VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=30 nf=120
* gate pull-down while charging (gate=VDD, source follows VLX)
XNBG BG VDD VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
* gate pull-up while HS on: RBN=VLX when set -> PMOS pulls BG to VBST
XPBG BG RBN VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver.
* Architecture:
*   VDD-domain input buffer -> long-L delay line -> asymmetric dead-time logic
*   (H_cmd = A*Ad: delayed rise / immediate fall; L_or = A+Ad)
*   Ground-referenced 5 V pulldown level-shift + cross-coupled 5 V PMOS latch
*   (works while VLX is high: pulldown sources stay at VSS, Vds <= 3.6 V)
*   Floating chain: 5 V translator stage, then 1.8 V tapered buffer -> GN
*   Low-side chain: identical 3-stage topology -> GN2 (matched delays)
*   Bootstrap charge path: PMOS VDD->VBST, gate tied to VLX (self-driven).
*
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
.param cboot=100n

* ---- helper: long-L inverter used in the delay line ----
.subckt dlyinv in out vp vn
XN in out vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 nf=2
XP in out vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=4
.ends dlyinv

* ---- helper: small 1.8 V inverter ----
.subckt inv18s in out vp vn
XN in out vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP in out vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends inv18s

* ---- helper: 5 V inverter (stage-1 of both drive chains, delay-matched) ----

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver.
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   - GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain, referenced to VBST/VLX)
*   - GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   - IN   : PWM input
*   - VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   - VDD  : driver supply
*   - VLX  : bootstrap cap bottom terminal (floating reference)
*   - VSS  : ground
*   - VSW  : switch node (midpoint of the external half-bridge)
*
.param cboot=1n

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* Tie the bootstrap bottom pad to the switch node with a low poly tie so the
* floating (cap) domain follows VSW.
XTIE vsw vlx sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po w=100 l=1

* ---------------- Input buffer (1.8V domain) ----------------
* in -> inb -> a (a is high when IN is high -> HS on command)
Xin1n inb in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1

Xnan na a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

Xh1n hnh a mid1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xh2n mid1 ad vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xh1p hnh a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
Xh2p hnh ad vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

Xl1n2 gn2m1 ls vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver.
*
* Architecture:
*   IN -> inverter buffer -> dead-time logic (RC delayed IN, NAND gating:
*   immediate turn-off, delayed turn-on for both legs) -> edge-pulse gens.
*   SET/RST pulses drive drain-extended 5V NMOS pulse FETs (source = VSS) that
*   pull the cross-coupled 5V latch in the floating VBST/VLX domain. The latch
*   drives a tapered 5V buffer chain -> GN (high-side gate).
*   Low side: tapered 1.8V buffer chain -> GN2.
*   Bootstrap charger: 5V PMOS VDD->VBST, gate = GN (on while GN~VLX, i.e.
*   low-side phase), bulk = VBST so its body diode cannot reverse-conduct.
*   On-die bootstrap reservoir: 1.8V MOS cap between VBST and VLX with a series
*   poly damping resistor that suppresses the wirebond-L / cap-C ringing on the
*   VSW switching edges (keeps v(VBST)-v(VLX) within the 1.8V rating).
*   VLX follows VSW through a low-ohm poly link.
*
* MOS terminals are d g s b; big buffer FETs use d=out g=in.
* Area accounting: MOS area = W*L*nf*m; one multiplicity alias per device.
*
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
.param cboot=10n

* ---- 1.8V logic gates (VDD/VSS domain) ----
.subckt inv18 a y vdd vss
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
.ends inv18

.subckt nand2_18 a b y vdd vss
XN1 y a nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2.25 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XN2 nmid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2.25 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
.ends nand2_18

* ---- 5V floating-domain inverter (VBST/VLX), latch unit ----
.subckt inv5v a y vp vn
XN y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=3 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XP y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=12 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
.ends inv5v

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---- input buffer: IN -> n1 (~IN) -> inb (IN buffered) ----
XI0 IN  n1  VDD VSS inv18
XI1 n1  inb VDD VSS inv18

* ---- dead-time delay: inb through RC (~5 ns) -> dlyn -> dly ----
XRD inb dlyr VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=5
XCD VSS dlyr VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.15 nf=1 m=300
XI2 dlyr dlyn VDD VSS inv18
XI3 dlyn dly  VDD VSS inv18

* ---- leg commands (both low during the dead-time band) ----
* hson = IN & dly : HS waits for the delay before turning on; turns off at once
XA_HN inb dly  hsonn VDD VSS nand2_18
XIH   hsonn hson  VDD VSS inv18
* lson = ~IN & ~dly : LS waits for the delay before turning on; turns off at once
XA_LN n1  dlyn  lsonn VDD VSS nand2_18
XIL   lsonn lson  VDD VSS inv18

* ---- edge-pulse generator on hson (~0.8 ns pulses) ----
XRP hson hdr VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=0.35
XCP VSS hdr VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.15 nf=1 m=70
XI4 hdr  hdrn   VDD VSS inv18
XI5 hson hsonn2 VDD VSS inv18
* SET pulse on the rising edge of hson: pa = hson & ~hdr
XA_PA hson hdrn pan VDD VSS nand2_18
XPA   pan  pa   VDD VSS inv18
* RST pulse on the falling edge of hson: pb = ~hson & hdr
XA_PB hsonn2 hdr pbn VDD VSS nand2_18
XPB   pbn  pb   VDD VSS inv18

* ---- floating level-shifter latch (5V, VBST/VLX domain) ----
* drain-extended 5V NMOS pulse pull-downs (source/bulk = VSS)
XSET SB pa VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1 m=4
XRST SA pb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1 m=4
* cross-coupled inverters: INV1 SB->SA, INV2 SA->SB
XL1 SB SA VBST VLX inv5v
XL2 SA SB VBST VLX inv5v
* power-up: weak pull SA to VLX -> SB high -> GN low -> charger on
XRK SA VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=5

* ---- high-side tapered buffer (5V): SB -> h1 -> h2 -> GN ----
XH1  SB h1 VBST VLX inv5v m=4
XHN1 h2 h1 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=80 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XHP1 h2 h1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=80 l=0.5 nf=1 m=4
XHN2 GN h2 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 w=80 l=0.5 nf=1 m=6
XHP2 GN h2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=80 l=0.5 nf=1 m=24

* ---- low-side tapered buffer (1.8V): lsonn(active low) -> l1 -> l2 -> GN2 ----
XLB0 lsonn l1 VDD VSS inv18 m=2
XLN1 l2 l1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=80 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XLP1 l2 l1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=0.15 nf=1 m=4
XLN2 GN2 l2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=80 l=0.15 nf=1 m=3
XLP2 GN2 l2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=0.15 nf=1 m=13

* ---- bootstrap charger: 5V PMOS VDD -> VBST, gate = GN, bulk = VBST ----
XCHG VBST GN VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 w=80 l=0.5 nf=1 m=10

* ---- on-die bootstrap reservoir (~200 pF) with damping series resistor ----
XRB VBST cfnode VLX sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=10 l=1 m=5
XCF VLX cfnode VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.15 nf=1 m=13200

* ---- VLX follows VSW through a low-ohm poly link ----
XRT VSW VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=50 l=1 m=8

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver.
* Ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   GN  : high-side gate drive (floating VBST/VLX domain)
*   GN2 : low-side gate drive (VDD/VSS domain)
*   IN  : PWM input (100 ns period, 20/50/80 ns pulse, 50 ohm source)
*   VBST: bootstrap capacitor top pad (off-chip cap through 2nH/5m wirebonds)
*   VDD : 1.8 V driver supply ; VSS : ground
*   VLX : floating bootstrap return (high-side power FET bulk side)
*   VSW : switch node (external half-bridge midpoint)
*
* Architecture:
*   Input inverter chain -> RC non-overlap (dead time) logic:
*     hs_drv = IN AND delayed(IN)   (turn-on delayed, turn-off immediate)
*     ls_drv = NOT(IN) NOR delayed  (turn-off immediate, turn-on delayed)
*   Bootstrap: active g5v0 PMOS switch VDD->VBST, gate driven by ls_drv
*     (on while low side on; self-released when the floating domain flies).
*   VLX tracking: always-on g5v0 NMOS VSW->VLX, gate tied to VBST
*     (Vgs = bootstrap cap voltage ~1.8 V at all times).
*   Level shift: MIM-cap-coupled pulsed g5v0 NMOS pull-downs whose sources
*     stay in the floating domain (no cross-domain crowbar); the pulses
*     drive a floating cross-coupled-inverter SR latch that is deterministic
*     at power-up (weak always-on pull-down defaults to RESET = HS off).
*   Floating g5v0 buffer chain -> GN ; 1.8V buffer chain -> GN2.
* Off-chip bootstrap capacitor (max 100 nF):
.param cboot=10n

* ---------------- 1.8 V logic cells ----------------
.subckt inv18 a y vdd vss
XI0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
.ends inv18

.subckt inv18b a y vdd vss
XI0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1 m=1
.ends inv18b

.subckt inv18c a y vdd vss
XI0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=4
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=8
.ends inv18c

.subckt inv18d a y vdd vss
XI0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=16
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=32
.ends inv18d

.subckt nand2_18 a b y vdd vss
XN1 y a na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1 m=1
XN2 na b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1 m=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=1 m=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=1 m=1
.ends nand2_18

.subckt nor2_18 a b y vdd vss
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XP1 y a pb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XP2 pb b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
.ends nor2_18

.subckt obuf18 a y vdd vss
XI0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=48
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=96
.ends obuf18

* ---------------- 5 V logic cells (floating domain) ----------------
.subckt inv5 a y vdd vss
XI0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1 m=1
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1 m=1
.ends inv5

.subckt inv5b a y vdd vss
XI0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=1
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1 m=2
.ends inv5b

.subckt inv5c a y vdd vss
XI0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=5
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1 m=10
.ends inv5c

.subckt inv5d a y vdd vss
XI0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=24
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1 m=48
.ends inv5d

.subckt obuf5 a y vdd vss
XI0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6.5 nf=1 m=70
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6.5 nf=1 m=140
.ends obuf5

* =================================================================
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---- input buffer chain (1.8 V domain) ----
XIB1 IN ib1 VDD VSS inv18
XIB2 ib1 ib2 VDD VSS inv18

* ---- dead-time / non-overlap: RC-delayed copy of ib2 ----
XRDH ib2 dlyhx VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=4.5 m=1
XCDH dlyhx VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22.4 l=22.4 m=1
XDH1 dlyhx dlyh1 VDD VSS inv18
XDH2 dlyh1 dlyh VDD VSS inv18
* hs_drv = ib2 AND dlyh  (rising edge delayed, falling immediate)
XNA ib2 dlyh na_hs VDD VSS nand2_18
XNB na_hs hs_drv VDD VSS inv18
* ls_drv = NOR(ib2, dlyh) (fall immediate on IN rise, rise delayed after IN fall)
XNL ib2 dlyh ls_drv VDD VSS nor2_18

* ---- low-side gate driver chain (6 inversions -> GN2 = ls_drv) ----
XL0 ls_drv ls0 VDD VSS inv18
XL1 ls0 ls1 VDD VSS inv18b
XL2 ls1 ls2 VDD VSS inv18c
XL3 ls2 ls3 VDD VSS inv18d
XL4 ls3 ls4 VDD VSS inv18d
XL5 ls4 GN2 VDD VSS obuf18

* ---- edge pulse generators (level-shift SET / RST, active high) ----
XRPD hs_drv dhsx VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=2.6 m=1
XCPD dhsx VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=18 l=18 m=1
XPD1 dhsx dhsb VDD VSS inv18
XPD2 dhsb dhs VDD VSS inv18
XHB hs_drv hsb VDD VSS inv18
* SET pulse: hs_drv=1 while dhs still 0 (dhsb=1) -> setp low
XPS hs_drv dhsb setp VDD VSS nand2_18
* RST pulse: hsb=1 while dhs still 1 -> rstp low
XPR hsb dhs rstp VDD VSS nand2_18
* gate drivers (active high pulses, 0-1.8 V)
XLS1 setp nset VDD VSS inv18b
XLS2 rstp nrst VDD VSS inv18b

* ---- cap-coupled level shifters into the floating domain ----
* coupling caps (MIM, low side = 1.8 V pulse, high side = floating gate node)
XCC1 gps1 nset sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22.4 l=22.4 m=1
XCC2 gps2 nrst sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22.4 l=22.4 m=1
* DC-restore resistors (high-value poly) hold the floating pulse-gate nodes
* at VLX between pulses but are too weak to damp the ~2 ns AC pulse kick
* (tau = R*Cgate ~ 3 ns). All floating-domain devices see only Vboot (~1.8 V)
* across terminals, so 1.8 V core devices are safe (bulks ride the rails).
XRR1 gps1 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=120 m=1
XRR2 gps2 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=120 m=1
* pulse pull-down NMOS in the floating domain: source = VLX
XQN1 SETn gps1 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1 m=1
XQN2 RSTn gps2 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1 m=1

* ---- floating SR latch (1.8 V core devices, VBST/VLX floating rails) ----
* Inverter XPU1/XND1 (in=RSTn, out=SETn); XPU2 (gate SETn) pulls RSTn up.
* Weak always-on XND2 holds RSTn low at power-up -> SETn high = RESET (HS off).
* SET: XQN1 pulls SETn low -> XPU2 on -> RSTn high -> XND1 holds SETn low.
* RST: XQN2 pulls RSTn low -> XPU1 on -> SETn high -> XPU2 off.
XPU1 SETn RSTn VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XND1 SETn RSTn VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XPU2 RSTn SETn VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XND2 RSTn VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.5 nf=1 m=1

* ---- floating high-side gate driver chain (5 inversions -> GN = NOT(SETn);
*      SET state has SETn low -> GN high). 1.8 V core devices on floating rails.
XF1 SETn f1 VBST VLX inv18
XF2 f1 f2 VBST VLX inv18b
XF3 f2 f3 VBST VLX inv18c
XF4 f3 f4 VBST VLX inv18d
XF5 f4 GN VBST VLX obuf18

* ---- on-chip bootstrap snubber cap (VBST-VLX, no bondwire) ----
XCBS VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100 m=2

* ---- VLX tracking switch: always on, gate = VBST (Vgs ~ boot cap voltage) ----
XTRK VSW VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6.5 nf=1 m=300

* ---- active bootstrap PMOS switch (VDD -> VBST) ----
* main switch: source VBST, drain VDD, bulk VBST
XBPM VBST bpg VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6.5 nf=1 m=230
* gate pull-up: bpg -> VBST when ls_drv low (turns XBPM off before the
* floating domain flies; fast, full-rail). 5 V PMOS tolerates VBST=3.6 V.
XBPU VBST ls_drv bpg VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6.5 nf=1 m=2
* gate pull-down: bpg -> VLX when ls_drv high. Self-timed: during fly-down
* it only conducts once VLX < ~1.8-Vth, so XBPM stays blocked until the cap
* is back near VDD; during fly-up ls_drv=0 keeps it off.
XBPD bpg ls_drv VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6.5 nf=1 m=2

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   GN  : high-side gate drive (floating, ref VBST/VLX)
*   GN2 : low-side gate drive (VDD/VSS domain)
*   IN  : PWM input (through 50 ohm off-chip)
*   VBST: bootstrap cap top pad   VLX: bootstrap cap bottom pad
*   VDD : 1.8V driver supply      VSS: ground
*   VSW : switch node (external)
*
* Off-chip bootstrap capacitor (designable, <= 100 nF):
.param cboot=22n
*
* ===========================================================================
* Local helper subcircuits (PDK devices only)
* ===========================================================================

* ---- 1.8V core inverter, rails vdd/vss ----
.subckt inv1 in out vdd vss
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends inv1

* ---- 1.8V floating inverter (core), rails vbst/vlx ----
.subckt invf in out vbst vlx
XP out in vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XN out in vlx  vlx  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends invf

* ---- 5V floating inverter (input tolerant 0..vbst), rails vbst/vlx ----
.subckt invf5 in out vbst vlx
XP out in vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.6 w=6 nf=3
XN out in vlx  vlx  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.6 w=6 nf=3
.ends invf5

* ---- slow 1.8V inverter (long L) for delay lines, rails vdd/vss ----
.subckt invd in out vdd vss
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=1 nf=1
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=1 nf=1
.ends invd

* ---- 1.8V 2-input NAND, rails vdd/vss ----
.subckt nand2 a b out vdd vss
XN1 out a xn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN2 xn  b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
.ends nand2

* ===========================================================================
* Top-level driver
* ===========================================================================
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---- Input buffer ----
XIB1 IN  ib1 VDD VSS inv1
XIB2 ib1 ib2 VDD VSS inv1

* ---- Complement of buffered input ----
XINV ib2 nib VDD VSS inv1

* ---- Dead-time delay chains (EVEN stage count keeps polarity) ----
XHD1 ib2 hd1 VDD VSS invd
XHD2 hd1 hd2 VDD VSS invd
XHD3 hd2 hd3 VDD VSS invd
XHD4 hd3 dib VDD VSS invd
XLD1 nib ld1 VDD VSS invd
XLD2 ld1 ld2 VDD VSS invd
XLD3 ld2 ld3 VDD VSS invd
XLD4 ld3 dnib VDD VSS invd

* ---- Non-overlap commands ----
* hcmd = ib2 AND dib : HS turn-ON delayed, turn-OFF immediate
XNH ib2 dib nhand VDD VSS nand2
XHIN nhand hcmd VDD VSS inv1
* lcmd = nib AND dnib : LS turn-ON delayed, turn-OFF immediate
XNL nib dnib nland VDD VSS nand2
XLIN nland lcmd VDD VSS inv1

* ---- Edge-pulse generator for level shifter (wide ~1.2ns full-swing) ----
XED1 hcmd ed1 VDD VSS inv1
XED2 ed1  ed2 VDD VSS invd
XED3 ed2  ed3 VDD VSS invd
XED4 ed3  ed4 VDD VSS invd
XNED ed4  ned   VDD VSS inv1
XNHCM hcmd nhcmd VDD VSS inv1
* setp = hcmd & !ed2  (pulse on hcmd rising edge)
XNSP hcmd ned nsp VDD VSS nand2
XISP nsp  setp VDD VSS inv1
* rstp = !hcmd & ed4  (pulse on hcmd falling edge)
XNRP nhcmd ed4 nrp2 VDD VSS nand2
XIRP nrp2  rstp VDD VSS inv1

* ===========================================================================
* Floating reference tie: bootstrap cap bottom (VLX) follows switch node.
* 5V NMOS pass device, gate=VBST (~1.8V above VLX in both states), bulk=VSS.
* ===========================================================================
* Complementary clamp: NMOS pulls VLX down (bulk=VLX), PMOS pulls VLX up (bulk=VSW)
XTN  VSW VLX VBST VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.6 w=6 nf=3 m=30
XTP  VSW VLX VSS  VSW  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.6 w=6 nf=3 m=30

* ===========================================================================
* Bootstrap charging
*  - diode-connected 5V NMOS: power-up precharge of VBST from VDD
*  - 5V PMOS switch (gate = GN): low-drop charge when HS off (GN~VLX),
*    reverse-blocks when HS on (GN=VBST -> Vsg=0)
* ===========================================================================
XBDD VDD  VDD  VBST VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.6 w=6 nf=3 m=2
XBPS VDD  GN   VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.6 w=6 nf=3 m=4

* ===========================================================================
* High-side level shifter: floating cross-coupled CMOS SR latch (5V devices).
* Cross-coupled PMOS pull up to VBST, cross-coupled NMOS pull down to VLX;
* edge-pulsed NMOS pull nset/nrst to VSS to flip the latch. No static path.
*   SET pulse (HS on)  -> nset low  -> GN high
*   RST pulse (HS off) -> nrst low  -> GN low
* ===========================================================================
* cross-coupled PMOS loads to VBST
XPLA nset nrst VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.6 w=6 nf=3
XPLB nrst nset VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.6 w=6 nf=3
* cross-coupled NMOS to VLX
XNLA nset nrst VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.6 w=6 nf=3
XNLB nrst nset VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.6 w=6 nf=3
* edge-pulsed pulldowns to VSS (VDS up to VBST~3.6V -> 5V NMOS), strong
XNST nset setp VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.6 w=6 nf=3 m=4
XNR2 nrst rstp VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.6 w=6 nf=3 m=4
* weak power-up reset: hold nrst low (GN low) until latch is established
XWK  nrst VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2.0 w=2 nf=1

* ---- Floating HS buffer: nset -> invf5 -> invf -> final driver (GN=!nset) ----
XHB1 nset hb1 VBST VLX invf5
XHB2 hb1  hb2 VBST VLX invf
* final floating driver (tapered, strong)
XHPN GN hb2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=10
XHNN GN hb2 VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=7

* ===========================================================================
* Low-side output buffer: lcmd -> 2 inversions -> GN2 (GN2 = lcmd)
* ===========================================================================
XLB1 lcmd lb1 VDD VSS inv1
XLPN GN2 lb1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=10
XLNN GN2 lb1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=7

* ---- On-chip bootstrap decoupling MIM cap (HF, across wirebond inductance) ----
XCBC VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=90 w=90 m=3

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Bootstrap high-side gate driver for all-NMOS half-bridge.
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain VBST/VLX)
*   GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   IN   : PWM input (100 ns period, 3 ns edges, 20/50/80 ns pulse)
*   VBST : bootstrap cap top (driver floating supply)
*   VDD  : 1.8 V driver supply
*   VLX  : floating reference (bootstrap cap bottom) -> tied to VSW
*   VSS  : ground
*   VSW  : switch node
*
* Non-overlap: HS_en=AND(IN,INd) (on td after rise, off immediate);
*              LS_en=NOR(IN,INd) (off immediate, on td after fall).
* Continuous cross-coupled level shifter (5V) -> floating buffer -> GN.
.param cboot=200p
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* === VLX<->VSW floating tie (transmission gate, low-ohm) ===
XTGN vlx vdd vsw vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=8
XTGP vlx vss vsw vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=10

* === Synchronous bootstrap charger: VDD -> VBST, gated by ls_n=NOT(ls_en) ===
* On only while LS_en high (VSW low); fully off while HS on (prevents cap drain).
XCHP vbst ls_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=20

* === On-chip bootstrap decoupling (VBST-VLX) ===
XCBT vbst vlx sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50 m=1

* === Input buffer: IN -> a (2 inv) ===
XIBP1 n1 in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XIBN1 n1 in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 m=1
XIBP2 a  n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XIBN2 a  n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 m=1

* === Dead-time delay line: a -> b (4 inv, non-inverting), cap loaded ===
XDP1 d1 a  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XDN1 d1 a  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 m=1
XCD1 d1 vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=30 l=30 m=1
XDP2 d2 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XDN2 d2 d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 m=1
XCD2 d2 vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=30 l=30 m=1
XDP3 d3 d2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XDN3 d3 d2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 m=1
XCD3 d3 vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=30 l=30 m=1
XDP4 b  d3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XDN4 b  d3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 m=1

* === HS_en = AND(a,b); hs_n = NAND(a,b) ===
XNAP hs_n a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XNBP hs_n b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XNAN nmid a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 m=1
XNBN hs_n b nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 m=1
XHEP hs_en hs_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XHEN hs_en hs_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 m=1

* === LS_en = NOR(a,b) -> ls_en ===
XNOP pmid a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XNOP2 ls_en b pmid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
XLNN ls_en a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 m=1
XLNN2 ls_en b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 m=1

* === Low-side buffer: ls_en -> GN2 (2 inv, non-inverting) ===
XLBP1 e1 ls_en vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=2
XLBN1 e1 ls_en vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=2
XLBP2 GN2 e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=10
XLBN2 GN2 e1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=10

* === Continuous level shifter (floating VBST/VLX, pull-down to VSS) ===
* s = NOT(hs_en); cross-coupled PMOS loads at VBST, 5V pull-down NMOS at VSS.
XLSP1 r s vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 m=1
XLSP2 s r vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 m=1
XLSN1 r hs_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 m=2
XLSN2 s hs_en vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 m=2

* === High-side floating buffer: s -> GN (3 inv, inverting => GN=hs_en) ===
* invA: input s swings 0..VBST -> PMOS sees VSG up to VBST (5V), NMOS 1.8V ok.
XHAP1 hb s vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 m=3
XHAN1 hb s vlx  vlx  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 m=1
* invB: input hb in [VLX,VBST] -> 1.8V devices ok.
XHAP2 hc hb vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=3
XHAN2 hc hb vlx  vlx  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=2
* invC big (drives 7pF HS gate), 1.8V devices.
XHAP3 GN hc vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 m=10
XHAN3 GN hc vlx  vlx  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=8


.ends bootstrap_driver
