taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver (DUT)
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain referenced to VBST/VLX)
*   GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   IN   : PWM input (0/1.8 V, 50 ohm series in testbench)
*   VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal (off-chip cap + wirebond in testbench)
*   VDD  : driver supply (1.8 V)
*   VLX  : floating reference for bootstrap driving (bootstrap cap bottom)
*   VSS  : ground
*   VSW  : switch node (high-side source / low-side drain, NMOS bulk=VLX)
*
* Strategy:
*   - Tie VLX to VSW with a transmission gate so the floating high-side
*     driver reference tracks the switch node (bootstrap cap bottom = VSW).
*   - Bootstrap charge path: 5V PMOS from VDD to VBST, gated by Lb (on only
*     while the low-side is commanded on) -> reverse-blocking, low drop.
*   - Grounded-domain non-overlap generator (dead time = RC delay) produces
*     H (high-side enable) and L (low-side enable), never overlapping:
*       H = NOR(inb, Ld) = IN AND NOT(Ld) ;  L = NOR(inh2, Hd) = NOT(IN) AND NOT(Hd)
*       Hd = delay(H) ; Ld = delay(L)   (dead time = delay)
*   - L -> low-side driver -> GN2.  H -> cross-coupled level shifter ->
*     floating high-side driver -> GN.
.param cboot=1n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* =====================================================================
* VLX-VSW tie : transmission gate (bootstrap cap bottom tracks switch node)
* NMOS (gate=VDD) conducts near ground, PMOS (gate=VSS) conducts near VDD.
* =====================================================================
XTIE_N VLX VDD VSW VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=18
XTIE_P VLX VSS VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=18

* =====================================================================
* Input buffer : IN -> inh2 (buffered IN), inb = NOT IN
* =====================================================================
XIB1N inh IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIB1P inh IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XIB2N inh2 inh VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XIB2P inh2 inh VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XIB3N inb inh2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIB3P inb inh2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* =====================================================================
* Non-overlap generator :  H = NOR(inb, Ld) ;  L = NOR(inh2, Hd)
*   NOR(a,b): 2 PMOS series to VDD, 2 NMOS parallel to VSS
* =====================================================================
* H = NOR(inb, Ld)
XNHP1 H inb hp1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XNHP2 hp1 Ld VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XNHN1 H inb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XNHN2 H Ld VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
* L = NOR(inh2, Hd)
XNLP1 L inh2 lp1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XNLP2 lp1 Hd VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XLNN1 L inh2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XLNN2 L Hd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

* =====================================================================
* Dead-time delay : weak inverter + MIM cap + restoring inverter
*   x = NOT(sig) drives cap ; out = NOT(x)  =>  out = sig delayed (non-inverting)
* =====================================================================
* Hd = delay(H)
XHD1N hd1 H VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XHD1P hd1 H VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XHDC hd1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=40 l=40 mult=1
XHD2N Hd hd1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XHD2P Hd hd1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
* Ld = delay(L)
XLD1N ld1 L VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XLD1P ld1 L VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLDC ld1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=40 l=40 mult=1
XLD2N Ld ld1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLD2P Ld ld1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* =====================================================================
* Low-side driver : GN2 = buffer(L) (non-inverting, 2 stages), big output
* =====================================================================
XLS1N gl1 L VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLS1P gl1 L VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XLS2N GN2 gl1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=8
XLS2P GN2 gl1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=96 nf=14

* =====================================================================
* Bootstrap charge switch : 5V PMOS VDD->VBST, gate=Lb (on while low-side on)
* Lb = NOT L ; reverse-blocking (off during high-side & dead time)
* =====================================================================
XLBN Lb L VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLBP Lb L VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XCHGP VBST Lb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=400 nf=60

* =====================================================================
* Level shifter (grounded -> floating), cross-coupled, outputs nA/nB
*   MP1/MP2 : 5V PMOS cross-coupled loads (source=VBST)
*   MN1(gate=H) pulls nA low ; MN2(gate=Hb) pulls nB low
*   Hb = NOT H
* =====================================================================
XHBN Hb H VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XHBP Hb H VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XLS_P1 nA nB VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XLS_P2 nB nA VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XLS_N1 nA H VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XLS_N2 nB Hb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2

* =====================================================================
* High-side driver (floating VBST/VLX), GN = NOT(nA)  (single big stage)
*   5V PMOS (tolerates nA swinging below VLX) + 1.8V NMOS
*   nA low (H high) -> GN high (VBST) => vgs ~ 1.8 V
* =====================================================================
XHS_P GN nA VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=80 nf=12
XHS_N GN nA VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=8

* On-chip bootstrap decoupling (snubber across floating supply)
XCBST VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50 mult=1

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Bootstrap high-side gate driver for an all-NMOS half-bridge.
*
* Architecture
*   - input buffer: IN -> nx (buffered) / nxb (inverted)
*   - cross-coupled NOR dead-time generator:
*       H = NOR(nxb, Ld)  (high-side command)
*       L = NOR(nx,  Hd)  (low-side command)
*     feedback delay chains Hd, Ld set the two dead times.
*   - level shifter #1 (cross-coupled 5V latch, zero static current) shifts H
*     into the floating domain; a 4-stage floating buffer drives GN.
*   - level shifter #2 shifts nx/nxb; its output gsw drives the bootstrap
*     switch gate pull-up so the switch always cuts off BEFORE VSW rises
*     (a switch still on while VSW rises would dump the bootstrap cap into
*     VDD through the anti-series body diode).
*   - the switch pull-down command chg derives from nxb through an
*     asymmetric RC delay: fast turn-off at IN rising, ~3 ns delayed
*     turn-on at IN falling (after VSW has settled low).
*   - synchronous bootstrap switch: anti-series 1.8V PMOS pair
*     VDD - MD - VBST (no diode drop, reverse blocking in both directions).
*   - VLX-VSW transmission-gate tie: references the floating domain to the
*     switch node and returns the gate-charge current; body diodes clamp
*     transient tie drops into the power nodes only.
*   - on-chip MIM C_on decouples the floating supply; off-chip cboot is the
*     main reservoir (chosen below, <= 100 nF).
*
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
.param cboot=4.7n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---------------- input buffer (grounded domain) ----------------
XIB1N na1 IN  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XIB1P na1 IN  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XIB2N nx  na1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XIB2P nx  na1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XIB3N nxb nx  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XIB3P nxb nx  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4

* ---------------- dead-time generator ----------------
* H = NOR(nxb, Ld)  (parallel NMOS, series PMOS)
XHN1 H   nxb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XHN2 H   Ld  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XHP1 hp1 nxb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10
XHP2 H   Ld  hp1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10
* L = NOR(nx, Hd)
XLN1 L   nx  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XLN2 L   Hd  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XLP1 lp1 nx  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10
XLP2 L   Hd  lp1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10
* complements for the level-shifter pull-downs
XHBN hb H VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XHBP hb H VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
XLBN lb L VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XLBP lb L VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8

* ---------------- Hd delay chain: H -> Hd (non-inverting) ----------------
XHD1N hd1 H   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XHD1P hd1 H   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XCD1  hd1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22 l=22 m=1
XHD2N hd2 hd1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XHD2P hd2 hd1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XCD2  hd2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22 l=22 m=1
XHD3N hd3 hd2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XHD3P hd3 hd2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XCD3  hd3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22 l=22 m=1
XHD4N Hd  hd3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XHD4P Hd  hd3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8

* ---------------- Ld delay chain: L -> Ld (non-inverting) ----------------
XLD1N ld1 L   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XLD1P ld1 L   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XCL1  ld1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22 l=22 m=1
XLD2N ld2 ld1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XLD2P ld2 ld1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XCL2  ld2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22 l=22 m=1
XLD3N ld3 ld2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XLD3P ld3 ld2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
XLD4N Ld  ld3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XLD4P Ld  ld3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8

* ---------------- switch pull-down command chg ----------------
* swz = NOT(nxb) with weak-N / strong-P and a MIM load: fast rise (turn-off
* of the bootstrap switch at IN rising), slow fall (delayed switch turn-on
* at IN falling, after VSW has discharged through the load).
XSWN swz nxb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
XSWP swz nxb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16
XCSW swz VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=25 l=25 m=1
XCGN chg swz VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32
XCGP chg swz VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64

* ---------------- low-side driver: L -> GN2 ----------------
XLA1N la1 L   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20
XLA1P la1 L   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40
XLA2N GN2 la1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300
XLA2P GN2 la1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=540

* ---------------- level shifter #1: H -> floating F ----------------
XNA1 A1 H  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200
XNB1 B1 hb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200
XPA1 A1 B1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100
XPB1 B1 A1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100
* floating receiver: F = NOT(A1)
XRV1N F  A1 VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=16
XRV1P F  A1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=32

* ---------------- floating buffer: F -> GN (4 stages) ----------------
XFB1N fb1 F   VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XFB1P fb1 F   VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
XFB2N fb2 fb1 VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16
XFB2P fb2 fb1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32
XFB3N fb3 fb2 VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64
XFB3P fb3 fb2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=128
XFB4N GN  fb3 VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=128
XFB4P GN  fb3 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=256

* ---------------- level shifter #2: nx/nxb -> floating gsw ----------------
* gsw = nxb level-shifted (drives the switch gate pull-up XPGS):
* high while IN is low (switch released), low right after IN rises.
XNA2 A2 nx  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200
XNB2 B2 nxb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200
XPA2 A2 B2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100
XPB2 B2 A2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100
XRV2N rcv2 A2 VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=16
XRV2P rcv2 A2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=32
XGSWN gsw rcv2 VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64
XGSWP gsw rcv2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=128

* ---------------- synchronous bootstrap switch ----------------
* anti-series PMOS pair: VDD - MD - VBST, gates on GS
XPS1 MD GS VDD  VDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=600 m=4
XPS2 MD GS VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=600 m=4
* GS pull-down to VSS (5V device: sees VBST when off). Deliberately
* weak (48 ohm): a strong pull-down rings against the supply bond
* inductance and the switch gate capacitance at ~5 GHz and the
* transient integration collapses; 48 ohm is overdamped and still
* switches the 4 pF gate node in ~200 ps.
XNGS GS chg VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100
* GS pull-up to VBST (gate driven by floating gsw), 56 ohm for the
* same reason (turn-off edge is local to the floating domain, so it
* stays fast in spite of the resistance).
XPGS GS gsw VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64

* ---------------- VLX-VSW tie (transmission gate) ----------------
XTIEN VSW VDD VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000
XTIEP VSW VSS VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 m=2

* ---------------- floating supply decoupling ----------------
XCON VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50 m=4

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* =====================================================================
*  Bootstrap high-side gate driver for an all-NMOS half-bridge  (SKY130)
*
*  DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*
*  Architecture
*   - floating domain (rails vb / VSW) references the switch node:
*     transmission gate ties VLX to VSW so the bootstrap cap bottom
*     follows the flying node
*   - on-chip MOS-cap reservoir vb->VSW (~100 pF) supplies the fast HS
*     gate charge locally; the VBST pad link is damped (~4 ohm)
*   - synchronous PMOS charge switch VDD -> vb with its gate driven from
*     the floating domain (truly off while the domain flies, no reverse
*     conduction); its bulk sits on vb so no junction ever forward
*     biases.  Weak-NMOS gate stage gives a ~1 ns delayed, gentle
*     recharge start after VSW has fallen.
*   - ground-domain logic: input buffer, cross-coupled NAND dead-time
*     core, RC feedback delays (poly R + MIM C, corner-stable)
*   - static differential level shifter (5 V NMOS pulls, cross-coupled
*     5 V PMOS latch, 5 V receiver) into floating buffers and the
*     high-current HS driver
*   - low-side buffer shares the same dead-time core
*
*  Off-chip bootstrap capacitor (testbench): cboot = 2 nF
* =====================================================================
.param cboot=4.7n

* ---- helper: minimum-size CMOS inverter (usable in any domain) -------
.subckt bd_inv a y vp vn
XMP y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XMN y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
.ends bd_inv

* ---- helper: medium drive CMOS inverter (usable in any domain) -------
.subckt bd_inv20 a y vp vn
XMP y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XMN y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
.ends bd_inv20

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* =============================================================
*  F1: floating rails
* =============================================================
* transmission gate tying the bootstrap return pad (VLX) to the switch
* node; NMOS gate on VDD / PMOS gate on VSS (always on)
XTGN VLX VDD VSW VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=800 nf=1
XTGP VLX VSS VSW VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=800 nf=1 m=2

* damped link from the VBST pad to the internal floating rail vb (~4 ohm)
XRDM VBST vb VSW sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=200 l=0.15

* local floating-domain reservoir (~100 pF), MOS cap with gate on vb
XCL VSW vb VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=835 nf=1

* =============================================================
*  F2: bootstrap charging path, synchronous PMOS VDD -> vb
* =============================================================
XPCH vb cg VDD vb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300 nf=1

* charge-switch gate stage: strong PMOS pulls cg to vb fast when the HS
* turns on; long-channel NMOS discharges cg slowly (~1 ns to threshold)
* when the HS turns off, so recharge starts only after VSW has fallen
XCGP cg hs_n vb vb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XCGN cg hs_n VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=1 nf=1

* =============================================================
*  ground-domain logic: input buffer + dead-time generator
* =============================================================
XIB1 IN  a_n VDD VSS bd_inv
XIB2 a_n ain VDD VSS bd_inv
XIB3 ain ann VDD VSS bd_inv

* n1 = NAND(ain, d2)   (n1 low = HS commanded on)
XN1P n1 ain VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN1Q n1 d2  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN1A n1 ain na1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1B na1 d2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* n2 = NAND(ann, d1)   (n2 low = LS commanded on)
XN2P n2 ann VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN2Q n2 d1  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN2A n2 ann na2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2B na2 d1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* fast-reset helper: while IN is high (HS commanded) the tap is held low
* through a small NFET so every cycle's delay starts from the same state
* (otherwise the tap keeps residual charge when the off-time is short)
*
* feedback delay 1 (sets dead_hl): delays the n1 rising edge ~5 ns
XFD1 m1n ain VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XR1 n1 m1n VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=26.5
XC1 m1n VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=19.5 l=19.5
XD1A m1n m1b VDD VSS bd_inv
XD1B m1b d1  VDD VSS bd_inv

* feedback delay 2 (sets dead_lh): delays the n2 rising edge ~5 ns
XFD2 m2n ann VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XR2 n2 m2n VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=26.5
XC2 m2n VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=18 l=18
XD2A m2n m2b VDD VSS bd_inv
XD2B m2b d2  VDD VSS bd_inv

* high-side command (ground domain) and its complement for the shifter
XHC  n1   hcmd  VDD VSS bd_inv
XHCN hcmd hcmdn VDD VSS bd_inv

* low-side command
XLC n2 lcmd VDD VSS bd_inv

* low-side driver, final stage drives the ~19 pF LS power gate
XLD1 lcmd l1n VDD VSS bd_inv20
XLD2P GN2 l1n VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=1
XLD2N GN2 l1n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1

* =============================================================
*  level shifter (5 V devices): differential pulls + cross-coupled latch
* =============================================================
XNA SA hcmd  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XNB SB hcmdn VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XRA vb SA VSW sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=305
XRB vb SB VSW sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=305
XPA SA SB vb vb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XPB SB SA vb vb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1

* 5 V receiver: hs (high = HS on) = NOT(SA), rails vb / VSW
XR5P hs SA vb vb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XR5N hs SA VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1

* =============================================================
*  floating-domain high-side driver and charge-gate pre-inverter
* =============================================================
XH1  hs  hs1  vb VSW bd_inv20
XHFP GN  hs1  vb  vb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=330 nf=1
XHFN GN  hs1  VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=1

* hs_n = NOT(hs): input of the skewed charge-gate stage
XH3  hs  hs_n vb VSW bd_inv

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Bootstrap high-side gate driver for an all-NMOS half-bridge.
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   GN   : high-side gate drive (floating domain VBST/VLX)
*   GN2  : low-side gate drive (VDD/VSS domain)
*   IN   : PWM input (0/1.8 V, 3 ns edges, 50 ohm source)
*   VBST : bootstrap capacitor top plate (die pad)
*   VDD  : 1.8 V driver supply
*   VLX  : bootstrap capacitor bottom plate (die pad, floating reference)
*   VSS  : ground
*   VSW  : switch node (high-side NMOS source)
*
* Architecture
*   1. Input squarer (2 inverters).
*   2. Dead time: cross-coupled NOR latch whose feedback arms are
*      RC-delayed (poly R + MIM C).  The QH->QH_d arm sets the
*      high-off -> low-on dead time, the QL->QL_d arm the
*      low-off -> high-on dead time.  The two arms are tuned
*      independently to compensate the level-shifter delay split.
*   3. Low-side path: QL -> tapered buffer chain -> GN2.
*   4. High-side path: QH -> buffer -> static level shifter
*      (poly pull-up R to VBST, 5 V NFET pull-down to VSS, node P)
*      -> 5 V floating inverter (rails VBST/VLX) -> tapered floating
*      buffer chain -> GN.
*   5. Bootstrap refresh: synchronous PMOS switch VDD->VBST (bulk on
*      VBST) gated by QL, i.e. it only closes while the low side is on
*      and VSW/VLX sit at 0.  A VDD-domain CMOS driver swings the
*      switch gate 0..VDD so the PMOS is truly off (VGS=0) even when
*      VBST flies to 2*VDD.
*   6. VLX-VSW tie: wide NMOS with its gate on VBST (VGS = bootstrap
*      voltage), closing the floating gate-drive return path with
*      ~0.2 ohm and self-starting from a discharged cap.
*
* Geometry notes: numeric l/w are micrometres (scale=1u in the SKY130
* libs).  Only one multiplicity spelling (m) is used per instance.
*
* Off-chip bootstrap capacitor (wirebond parasitics are in the tb):
.param cboot=4.7n

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* helper cells (all literal geometry, expanded recursively for area)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* small inverter
.subckt xinv_s out in cc vv
XMP out in cc cc sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1 m=1
XMN out in vv vv sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
.ends xinv_s

* medium inverter
.subckt xinv_m out in cc vv
XMP out in cc cc sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XMN out in vv vv sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
.ends xinv_m

* large inverter
.subckt xinv_l out in cc vv
XMP out in cc cc sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=1 m=1
XMN out in vv vv sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1 m=1
.ends xinv_l

* extra-large inverter
.subckt xinv_xl out in cc vv
XMP out in cc cc sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=96 nf=1 m=1
XMN out in vv vv sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=1 m=1
.ends xinv_xl

* output driver inverter (sized for ~20 ohm pull-up / ~10 ohm pull-down
* so the bondwire loop into the 30 pF power-FET gate is near critically
* damped)
.subckt xinv_f out in cc vv
XMP out in cc cc sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=170 nf=1 m=1
XMN out in vv vv sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=1 m=1
.ends xinv_f

* 2-input NOR (series PMOS, parallel NMOS)
.subckt xnor2 out a b cc vv
XMP1 n1   a  cc cc sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XMP2 out  b  n1 cc sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XMN1 out  a  vv vv sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
XMN2 out  b  vv vv sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
.ends xnor2

* floating inverter built from 5 V devices: its input can swing from
* VSS up to VBST (i.e. 1.8 V outside its own rails) during level
* shifting and switch-node flying
.subckt xinv5 out in cc vv
XMP out in cc cc sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XMN out in vv vv sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1 m=1
.ends xinv5

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* bootstrap driver
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* --- 6. floating return path: tie VLX (bootstrap cap bottom) to VSW ---
* gate rides on VBST, so VGS equals the bootstrap voltage (~1.8 V)
* and the tie stays on in both switch-node states
XTIE VSW VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1 m=4

* --- 1. input squarer ---
XIN1 inb IN  VDD VSS xinv_s
XIN2 in2 inb VDD VSS xinv_s

* --- 2. dead-time latch: QH = NOR(INb, QLd), QL = NOR(IN, QHd) ---
XNQH qh  inb qld VDD VSS xnor2
XNQL ql  in2 qhd VDD VSS xnor2

* RC feedback arm A: delays QH -> QH_d (sets high-off -> low-on dt)
XRH  qh dh  VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=154
XCH  dh VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10 m=1
XDH1 dh1 dh  VDD VSS xinv_s
XDH2 qhd dh1 VDD VSS xinv_s

* RC feedback arm B: delays QL -> QL_d (sets low-off -> high-on dt)
XRL  ql dl  VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=112
XCL  dl VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10 m=1
XDL1 dl1 dl  VDD VSS xinv_s
XDL2 qld dl1 VDD VSS xinv_s

* --- 3. low-side path: QL -> GN2 ---
XLC1 ql1  ql  VDD VSS xinv_m
XLC2 ql2  ql1 VDD VSS xinv_l
XLC3 ql3  ql2 VDD VSS xinv_xl
XLC4 GN2  ql3 VDD VSS xinv_f

* --- 4. high-side path: QH -> level shift -> floating chain -> GN ---
* VDD-domain buffer for the shifter NFET gate
XHB1 qhb  qh  VDD VSS xinv_m
XHB2 hen  qhb VDD VSS xinv_xl

* static level shifter: P pulled up to VBST through poly R, pulled
* down to VSS by a 5 V NFET driven by HEN
XRP  VBST p VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=100
XSHN p hen VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=1

* floating receiver (5 V devices) then floating buffer chain
XFI1 hf   p   VBST VLX xinv5
XFC1 hf1  hf  VBST VLX xinv_m
XFC2 hf2  hf1 VBST VLX xinv_l
XFC3 hf3  hf2 VBST VLX xinv_xl
XFC4 GN   hf3 VBST VLX xinv_f

* --- 5. bootstrap refresh switch: VDD -> VBST while QL is high ---
XCS1 q1b   ql  VDD VSS xinv_m
XCS2 q2    q1b VDD VSS xinv_l
XCS3 pgate q2  VDD VSS xinv_xl
XSW  VBST pgate VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1 m=1

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* =====================================================================
*  All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver
*  (SKY130 SPICE, ngspice-46)
*
*  Ports:
*    IN   PWM input (0..1.8 V, 50 ohm source)
*    GN   high-side power NMOS gate   (drive referenced to VSW)
*    GN2  low-side  power NMOS gate   (drive referenced to VSS)
*    VBST bootstrap rail  (off-chip Cboot between VBST and VLX)
*    VDD  1.8 V supply
*    VLX  floating ground reference (= switch node)
*    VSS  ground
*    VSW  switch node
*
*  Architecture
*   1. VLX is tied to VSW by a large VBST-gated NFET so the bootstrap
*      bottom plate always follows the switch node.
*   2. Feed-forward delayed-input logic makes the dead times:
*        GN2   = NOR(A, Ad1)
*        set   = Ad1 & !Ad2        -> high side ON
*        reset = !A   & Ad1        -> high side OFF
*        chg   = A | AdT           -> bootstrap charger enable
*   3. Low side: plain CMOS tapered inverter chain.
*   4. High side: cross-coupled floating latch referenced to VLX/VBST.
*        set  : NFET, gate = sp (ground domain, direct) - valid because
*               the set pulse only occurs while VLX = 0.
*        reset: NFET, gate = kr, a capacitively kicked node biased to
*               VLX.  A rail transition moves kr the WRONG way for a
*               spurious reset, so it can only fire at the reset pulse
*               or during the fly-down (where the high side is already
*               off) - both harmless.
*   5. Bootstrap charger: 5 V PFET from VDD to VBST, enabled by the
*      delayed input so it never dumps a charged bootstrap back into
*      VDD while VBST is above VDD.  A self-biased trickle PFET
*      guarantees VBST never collapses.
* =====================================================================

.param cboot=10n

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* --------------------------------------------------------------------
* 1.  VLX = VSW return switch
*     d=VSW g=VBST s=VLX b=VLX : VGS = VBST-VLX ~ 1.8 V in both states
* --------------------------------------------------------------------
XSWVLX VSW VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=400 nf=1

* --------------------------------------------------------------------
* 2.  Input buffer
* --------------------------------------------------------------------
XIP1 n_in IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XIN1 n_in IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XIP2 a n_in VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XIN2 a n_in VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1

* --------------------------------------------------------------------
* 3.  Delay lines  (poly resistor + MIM cap + 2 recovery inverters)
*     D1 ~4.5 ns  (dead-time element)
*     D2 ~2.5 ns  (set pulse width)
*     DT ~18 ns   (bootstrap charger enable after the fly-down)
* --------------------------------------------------------------------
* --- D1 from A ---
XRD1 a d1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.5 l=22 m=1
XCD1 d1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=13 l=12 m=1
XD1P ad1n d1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XD1N ad1n d1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XD1P2 ad1 ad1n VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XD1N2 ad1 ad1n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* --- D2 from Ad1 ---
XRD2 ad1 d2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.5 l=20 m=1
XCD2 d2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=11 l=11 m=1
XD2P ad2n d2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XD2N ad2n d2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XD2P2 ad2 ad2n VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XD2N2 ad2 ad2n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* --- DT from A ---
XRD3 a dT VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.5 l=58 m=1
XCD3 dT VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=16 l=15 m=1
XDP1 adTn dT VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XDN1 adTn dT VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XDP2 adT adTn VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XDN2 adT adTn VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* --------------------------------------------------------------------
* 4.  Ground-domain logic
* --------------------------------------------------------------------
*  set pulse  sp = NOR(ad1n, ad2) = Ad1 & !Ad2
XSP_P1 nsp1 ad1n VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSP_P2 sp ad2 nsp1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSP_N1 sp ad1n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSP_N2 sp ad2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

*  reset pulse rp = NOR(a, ad1n) = !A & Ad1
XRP_P1 nrp1 a VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XRP_P2 rp_raw ad1n nrp1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XRP_N1 rp_raw a VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XRP_N2 rp_raw ad1n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
*  strong buffer for the level shifter coupling cap
XRPB_P rp_b rp_raw VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XRPB_N rp_b rp_raw VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1

*  low side logic  GN2 = !A & !Ad1
XG2_P1 ng21 a VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XG2_P2 gn2_n ad1 ng21 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XG2_N1 gn2_n a VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XG2_N2 gn2_n ad1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

*  charger gate  chg_gate = A | AdT  (NAND of the complements)
XCH_P1 chg_gate ab VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XCH_P2 chg_gate adTn VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XCH_N1 zzchg ab VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XCH_N2 chg_gate adTn zzchg VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* --------------------------------------------------------------------
* 5.  Low-side gate driver GN2
* --------------------------------------------------------------------
XG2IP g2a gn2_n VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XG2IN g2a gn2_n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XG2OP GN2 g2a VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200 nf=1
XG2ON GN2 g2a VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=1

* --------------------------------------------------------------------
* 6.  Floating SR latch  (rails VBST / VLX)
*     q  = VLX  -> high side ON
*     q  = VBST -> high side OFF
* --------------------------------------------------------------------
XLP1 q qb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XLN1 q qb VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XLP2 qb q VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XLN2 qb q VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1

*  fail-safe: weak always-on PFET forces q high (high side OFF) at
*  power up and if the latch ever loses its state
XLPFS q VLX VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=2 nf=1

*  set device : NFET, gate = sp (ground domain), source = VLX
XMS q sp VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1

*  reset kick node : biased to VLX by a MOS resistor, kicked up by C
XRBIAS VLX VBST kr VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XCKR rp_b kr sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=12 l=12 m=1

*  reset device : NFET, gate = kr, source = VLX
XMR qb kr VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1

* --------------------------------------------------------------------
* 7.  High-side output buffer  (floating domain)
* --------------------------------------------------------------------
XHOP qm q VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XHON qm q VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XH2P q2 qm VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
XH2N q2 qm VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XH3P GN q2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200 nf=1
XH3N GN q2 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=1

* --------------------------------------------------------------------
* 8.  Bootstrap charger
* --------------------------------------------------------------------
*  main charger, enabled by chg_gate (high = off)
XCHG VBST chg_gate VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1
*  self-biased trickle charger, only conducts while VBST < VDD-|Vtp|
XTRI VBST VBST VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* --------------------------------------------------------------------
* 9.  On-chip bootstrap capacitance
* --------------------------------------------------------------------
XCBOOT VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=75 m=1

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Sky130 bootstrap high-side gate driver for an all-NMOS half-bridge
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*
*   IN buffer (even # of inversions) -> p = IN, and NOR(p,d3) = chg_n
*   RC taps:  d1 = p delayed (HS turn-on), d2 = p delayed (LS turn-on),
*             d3 = p delayed (bootstrap charger enable)
*   hs_on = p AND d1        (HS turns on Da1 after p rises)
*   ls_on = NOT(p OR d2)    (LS turns on Da2 after p falls)
*   hs_off= nb              (HS turns off as soon as p falls)
*   chg_n = NOR(p, d3)      (1 = charge the reservoir, 0 = hold it)
*   Floating-domain inverter turns chg_n into cg (swings VLX..VBST) so the
*   charger PMOS is really off while VBST sits above VDD.
*   Charger: PMOS source=VDD drain=VBST body=VDD -> can also start from 0 V.
*   Cross-coupled 5 V PMOS level shifter, la/lb swing VLX..VBST
*   Floating 2-stage buffer drives GN;  low-side buffer drives GN2
*   On-chip MOS reservoir + off-chip cboot between VBST and VLX
*   Very low-impedance VLX <-> VSW tie so the floating domain rides the switch node
*
.param cboot=2n

* ============================================================
*  Helper subcircuits -- 1.8 V core devices
* ============================================================
.subckt iv1 in out vvdd vvss
XMN out in vvss vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP out in vvdd vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends iv1

.subckt iv3 in out vvdd vvss
XMN out in vvss vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XMP out in vvdd vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
.ends iv3

.subckt iv10 in out vvdd vvss
XMN out in vvss vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XMP out in vvdd vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
.ends iv10

.subckt iv100 in out vvdd vvss
XMN out in vvss vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=1
XMP out in vvdd vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200 nf=1
.ends iv100

.subckt na2 in1 in2 out vvdd vvss
XMP1 out in1 vvdd vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMP2 out in2 vvdd vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMN1 nn1 in1 vvss vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XMN2 out in2 nn1 vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
.ends na2

.subckt no2 in1 in2 out vvdd vvss
XMN1 out in1 vvss vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XMN2 out in2 vvss vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XMP1 np1 in1 vvdd vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XMP2 out in2 np1 vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
.ends no2

* ============================================================
*  Top-level driver
* ============================================================
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---------- very low-impedance VLX <-> VSW tie ----------
XTN VLX VDD VSW VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1 m=2
XTP VLX VSS VSW VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1 m=4

* ---------- input buffer: p = IN, nb = /p ----------
XI1 IN n1 VDD VSS iv1
XI2 n1 p  VDD VSS iv10
XI3 p  nb VDD VSS iv10

* ---------- RC delay taps ----------
* tap 1: high-side turn-on delay
XDR1 p d1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.5 l=10
XDC1 d1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=8 l=8 mf=1
* tap 2: low-side turn-on delay
XDR2 p d2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.5 l=10
XDC2 d2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=8 l=8 mf=1
* tap 3: charger enable delay (longer: wait for VSW collapse)
XDR3 p d3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.5 l=16
XDC3 d3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=8 l=8 mf=1

* ---------- control logic ----------
* hs_on = p AND d1
XG1  p   d1  an1 VDD VSS na2
XG1B an1 hs_on VDD VSS iv3
* hs_off = nb (= /p)
XH1  nb   ho1 VDD VSS iv3
XH2  ho1 hs_off VDD VSS iv3
* ls_on = NOT(p OR d2)
XG2  p  d2 ls_on VDD VSS no2
* chg_n = NOR(p, d3)  -> 1 = charge
XG3  p  d3 chg_n VDD VSS no2

* ---------- level shifter (5 V devices, la/lb swing VLX..VBST) ----------
XLS1 lb la VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XLS2 la lb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

circuit:

* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* 5V device examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* Cap:  XC a b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 m=4
*
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   - GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain, referenced to VBST/VLX)
*   - GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   - IN   : PWM input
*   - VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   - VDD  : driver supply
*   - VLX  : floating reference for the bootstrap driving (bootstrap cap bottom)
*   - VSS  : ground
*   - VSW  : switch node (midpoint of the external half-bridge power stage)
*
* The external power stage (two 450x50um NMOS), the 3.6 ohm load, and
* the 2 nH / 5 mOhm wirebond parasitics are all provided by the testbench.
* The testbench also adds 0.3 nH / 3 mOhm off-chip parasitics on the VDD and
* VSS supply rails.
* The testbench connects a designable off-chip bootstrap capacitor between
* the VBST and VLX pads through the wirebond parasitics. You choose its value
* by declaring .param cboot=<value> (at most 100 nF), e.g.:
*   .param cboot=620p
* You must design the bootstrap driver (charging path, level shifters,
* floating high-side buffer, low-side buffer, dead-time) and choose the sizes
* of the on-chip bootstrap capacitor and the internal devices so that the total
* on-chip device area (transistors + capacitors) does not exceed 35000 um^2.
* MOS area is W*L*nf*multiplicity; capacitor area is W*L*multiplicity. Local
* helper subcircuits are expanded recursively. Use only one multiplicity alias
* (m, mult, or mf) per instance and literal finite SPICE geometry values.
* Device voltage constraints (enforced on external nodes): v(VBST)-v(VLX) and
* v(GN2) peaks must stay below 2.15 V (1.8 V devices); v(VBST) peak must stay
* below 5.65 V (5 V devices).
.param cboot=100n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* The bootstrap reference is the switch node.  The small series resistance
* avoids an ideal short while keeping the two floating references together.
XREF VLX VSW sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po w=1 l=1e-6 r=1m

* Inverter producing the complementary input used by the asymmetric delays.
XINB nin IN VDD VSS inv18

* HS_D and LS_D charge slowly on their respective turn-on edges.  The NMOS
* discharge devices make both turn-off edges fast, creating non-overlap.
XHD HS_D IN sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po w=1 l=0.001 r=1.6k
XCHD HS_D VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=50 mult=1
XHSD HS_D nin VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2

XLD LS_D nin sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po w=1 l=0.001 r=4k
XCLD LS_D VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=50 mult=1
XLSD LS_D IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2

* HIN/HINB are complementary, delayed high-side level-shifter commands.
XHINV hs_b HS_D VDD VSS inv18
XHIN HIN hs_b VDD VSS inv18

* Low-side command and its complement drive a full CMOS gate buffer.
XBOOTCTL_P ls_b LS_D VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=3
XBOOTCTL_N ls_b LS_D VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=3
XLSBUF_P GN2 ls_b VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=9
XLSBUF_N GN2 ls_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=9

* Synchronous bootstrap charging switch.  It is on with the low-side
* command and off before the high-side command is released.
XPBOOT VBST ls_b VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* Cross-coupled floating latch.  The 5 V NMOS level shifters can reset the
* latch while VSW is high; the latch then holds the state in the floating
* domain.
XPH1 HCTL HCTLB VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=60 nf=10
XPH2 HCTLB HCTL VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=60 nf=10
XNH1 HCTL HIN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100 nf=14
XNH2 HCTLB hs_b VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=100 nf=14

* Floating high-side output stage.  GN is clamped to VLX when off and to
* the bootstrap top rail when on, so its gate-source drive tracks the cap.
XPHO GN HCTL VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=370 nf=53
XNHO GN HCTL VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=160 nf=23
XGO GN VLX sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po w=1 l=0.001 r=1meg
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap gate driver.
* The off-chip bootstrap capacitance is intentionally modest: it has enough
* stored charge for the power-FET gate while allowing startup before 0.5 us.
.param cboot=50n

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* The bootstrap-return pad follows the power-switch source.  This small
* resistance also damps the otherwise ideal pad/package loop.
RREF VLX VSW 5m

* Input complement.
XINP INB IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XINN INB IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* Rising high-side request: slow to assert, fast to cancel.
RH VDD HT 4k
XHRST HT INB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XHCAP HT VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=16 w=16 mult=1
XHIP HBAR HT VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XHIN HBAR HT VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XHBP HEN HBAR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=4
XHBN HEN HBAR VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XHCBP HENB HEN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=4
XHCBN HENB HEN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2

* Rising low-side request: slow to assert, fast to cancel.
RL VDD LT 10k
XLRST LT IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XLCAP LT VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=16 w=16 mult=1
XLIP LBAR LT VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XLIN LBAR LT VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XLBP LEN LBAR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=4
XLBN LEN LBAR VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XLBBP LENB LEN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=4
XLBBN LENB LEN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2

* Ground-referenced low-side output buffer and a small gate stopper.
XLGOP GNL LENB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=20
XLGON GNL LENB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
RLG GNL GN2 30

* Bootstrap charger.  With LEN high, CPG is pulled to VSS and the isolated
* well PMOS charges VBST.  When LEN falls, CPG follows VBST and blocks the
* path before the bootstrap node rises above VDD.
RCPG VBST CPG 10k
XCPDN CPG LEN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XCPCH VBST CPG VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4 m=10

* Cross-coupled static level shifter.  HSCTRL is low for an asserted high
* command and is actively restored to VBST when the high side is disabled.
XLSAP HSCTRL HSB VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XLSBP HSB HSCTRL VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap gate driver.
* The external bootstrap capacitor is deliberately modest: it is much larger
* than the power-FET gate charge, but its bond resonance remains well above
* the PWM repetition rate.
.param cboot=2n

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* Keep the bootstrap return and the source sense together while adding enough
* loss to damp the two 2 nH bond wires and CBOOT.
XREF VLX VBST VSW VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=150

* Local complement of the received PWM.
XIP INB IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=2
XIN INB IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=2

* Rising-edge delay for the high-side turn-on.  INB resets HD promptly when
* the high side is commanded off.
XRHRES VDD HD VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=11
XCH HD VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 mult=1
XRH HD INB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4
XHP HBAR HD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=2
XHN HBAR HD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=2
XHBP HC HBAR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4
XHBN HC HBAR VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4

* Falling-edge delay for the low-side turn-on.  IN resets LD immediately.
XRLRES VDD LD VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=17
XCL LD VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 mult=1
XRL LD IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4
XLP LBAR LD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=3
XLN LBAR LD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=3

* Low-side output buffer.  LBAR is high during an input-high interval, so
* GN2 is actively held low until the delayed low-side command is valid.
XLOP GN2 LBAR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=18
XLON GN2 LBAR VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=12

* High-voltage static level shifter.  Pulling QH low selects high-side ON;
* pulling QL low selects high-side OFF.  Both outputs are valid from VSS to
* VBST, allowing them to drive the floating output devices directly.
XLSHP QH QL VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=8
XLSLP QL QH VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=3
XLSHN QH HC VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=20
XLSLN QL INB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=12

* Floating high-side buffer, referred to the bootstrap capacitor terminals.
XHOP GN QH VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=160
XHON GN QH VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=80

* Active bootstrap charging path.  With GN low it charges VBST from VDD;
* with GN at VBST its source/body-following PMOS is fully isolated.
XBOOT VDD GN VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1 m=200
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
.param cboot=2n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* Connect VLX to VSW (floating reference = switch node)
R_LX VLX VSW 0.001

* === Dead-time generation: cross-coupled NOR latch ===
* Falling edges are immediate; rising edges are delayed by feedback.
* dead_hl = dead_lh = feedback_delay when LS path delay matches HS path delay.
XINV_IN IN_b IN VDD VSS inv

* HS latch: hs_en = NOR(IN_b, ls_en_fb)
XNOR_HS hs_en_b IN_b ls_en_fb vdd vss nor2
XINV_HS_EN hs_en hs_en_b vdd vss inv

* LS latch: ls_en = NOR(IN, hs_en_fb)
XNOR_LS ls_en_b IN hs_en_fb vdd vss nor2
XINV_LS_EN ls_en ls_en_b vdd vss inv

* Feedback delays (~5ns = 1 slow inverter)
XFB_HS hs_en_fb hs_en vdd vss inv_slow
XFB_LS ls_en_fb ls_en vdd vss inv_slow

* === Level shifter: VDD/VSS -> VBST/VLX ===
XLS ls_out ls_out_b hs_en hs_en_b VBST VSS level_shifter

* === HS buffer (VBST/VLX domain, 3 stages) ===
XHS1 hs1 ls_out VBST VLX inv_hs1
XHS2 hs2 hs1 VBST VLX inv_hs2
XHS3 GN hs2 VBST VLX inv_hs3

* === LS matching delay + buffer ===
* Matching delay: equalize LS path to HS path (level_shifter + HS_buffer)
* Target: matching_delay ≈ level_shifter_delay
* Use 2 slow inverters + 1 fast inverter ≈ 11ns
XMLS1 mls1 ls_en vdd vss inv_slow
XMLS2 mls2 mls1 vdd vss inv_slow
XMLS3 mls3 mls2 vdd vss inv

XLS1 ls1 mls3 VDD VSS inv_ls1
XLS2 ls2 ls1 VDD VSS inv_ls2
XLS3 GN2 ls2 VDD VSS inv_ls3

* === Bootstrap charging ===
XCHG VBST IN VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=12 m=7

.ends bootstrap_driver

* === Helper subcircuits ===

.subckt inv out in vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt inv_slow out in vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
.ends inv_slow

.subckt nor2 out in1 in2 vdd vss
XP1 mid in1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 out in2 mid mid sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1 out in1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN2 out in2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends nor2

.subckt nand2 out in1 in2 vdd vss
XP1 out in1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 out in2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1 out in1 mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN2 mid in2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt level_shifter out out_b in in_b vbst vss
XP1 out out_b vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XP2 out_b out vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XN1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4 m=8
XN2 out_b in_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4 m=8
.ends level_shifter

.subckt inv_hs1 out in vbst vlx
XN out in vlx vlx sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=2
XP out in vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
.ends inv_hs1

.subckt inv_hs2 out in vbst vlx
XN out in vlx vlx sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=4 m=4
XP out in vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=8
.ends inv_hs2

.subckt inv_hs3 out in vbst vlx
XN out in vlx vlx sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=4 m=20

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* === Input stage: drives level shifter only ===
XINV_IN_P int1 IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=2
XINV_IN_N int1 IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=2

* Separate buffer chain from IN for GN2
* IN → inv_A → inv_B → inv_C → GN2 (3 inversions = inverted from IN)
* inv_A large, inv_B small (delay), inv_C large (output)
XINV_LS_A_P lsa IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=2
XINV_LS_A_N lsa IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=2
XINV_LS_B_P lsb lsa VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XINV_LS_B_N lsb lsa VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XINV_LS_C_P GN2 lsb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=8
XINV_LS_C_N GN2 lsb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=8

XLS_P1 node_hsb node_ls VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XLS_P2 node_ls node_hsb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XLS_N1 node_ls int1 VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1

XINV_HS1_P hs1 node_ls VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Sky130 MOS syntax examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
* 5V device examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1 m=1
* Cap:  XC a b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 m=4
*
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   - GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain, referenced to VBST/VLX)
*   - GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   - IN   : PWM input
*   - VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   - VDD  : driver supply
*   - VLX  : floating reference for the bootstrap driving (bootstrap cap bottom)
*   - VSS  : ground
*   - VSW  : switch node (midpoint of the external half-bridge power stage)
*
* The external power stage (two 450x50um NMOS), the 3.6 ohm load, and
* the 2 nH / 5 mOhm wirebond parasitics are all provided by the testbench.
* The testbench also adds 0.3 nH / 3 mOhm off-chip parasitics on the VDD and
* VSS supply rails.
* The testbench connects a designable off-chip bootstrap capacitor between
* the VBST and VLX pads through the wirebond parasitics. You choose its value
* by declaring .param cboot=<value> (at most 100 nF), e.g.:
*   .param cboot=620p
* You must design the bootstrap driver (charging path, level shifters,
* floating high-side buffer, low-side buffer, dead-time) and choose the sizes
* of the on-chip bootstrap capacitor and the internal devices so that the total
* on-chip device area (transistors + capacitors) does not exceed 35000 um^2.
* MOS area is W*L*nf*multiplicity; capacitor area is W*L*multiplicity. Local
* helper subcircuits are expanded recursively. Use only one multiplicity alias
* (m, mult, or mf) per instance and literal finite SPICE geometry values.
* Device voltage constraints (enforced on external nodes): v(VBST)-v(VLX) and
* v(GN2) peaks must stay below 2.15 V (1.8 V devices); v(VBST) peak must stay
* below 5.65 V (5 V devices).
.param cboot=100n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* Low-ohmic die metallization ties the bootstrap reference and the sensed
* power-device source together.  It avoids a threshold loss in the floating
* supply return path.
RTRACK VLX VSW 1m

* Two series PMOS switches form the bootstrap charger.  HB blocks the floating
* side whenever IN requests high-side drive; VLX blocks the input-side switch
* until the switch node has returned low.
XBOOTL NCHG VLX VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1000 nf=1
XBOOTF BST HB NCHG BST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1000 nf=1
RBSTDAMP VBST BST 1
XCBST BST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=100 w=240 mult=1

* Ground-domain complement of IN.
XINVP NIN IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=1
XINVN NIN IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=1

* Rising-edge delay for the high-side command.  HD is actively reset by NIN;
* its long-channel pull-up and MIM load provide the turn-on blanking interval.
XHDP HD VSS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4.2 nf=1
XHDN HD NIN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=1
XCHD HD VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=5 w=5 mult=1

* Cross-coupled 5 V level shifter.  HA is low only for an asserted high-side
* command and otherwise follows the floating bootstrap rail.
XLSP1 HA HB BST BST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XLSP2 HB HA BST BST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
RLS1 HA HN1 50
RLS2 HB HN2 50
XLSN1 HN1 HD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1
XLSN2 HN2 NIN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1

* Floating high-side output buffer.  Both devices are 5 V devices because
* their terminals translate with VBST/VLX during the high-side interval.
XHIP GN HA BST BST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=500 nf=1
XHIN GN HA VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=300 nf=1

* Falling-edge delay for the low-side command.  LCTRL is restored high quickly
* when IN rises and discharges through a long-channel NMOS after IN falls.
XLDP LCTRL NIN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.4 nf=2
XLDN LCTRL NIN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=4.2 nf=1
XCLD LCTRL VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=5 w=25 mult=1

* Low-side output: immediate pull-down on an asserted input and delayed
* pull-up after the high-side command has been removed.
XLOP GN2 LCTRL VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=105 nf=15
XLON GN2 IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=70 nf=10
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver (SKY130)
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   - GN   : high-side gate output (floating domain, referenced to VBST/VLX)
*   - GN2  : low-side gate output (VDD/VSS domain)
*   - IN   : PWM input
*   - VBST : bootstrap cap top terminal
*   - VDD  : driver supply
*   - VLX  : floating reference for the bootstrap driving (bootstrap cap bottom)
*   - VSS  : ground
*   - VSW  : switch node (midpoint of the external half-bridge power stage)
*
* Off-chip bootstrap capacitor (declared here, wired by the testbench):
.param cboot=2.2n
*
* Architecture
*   1. VLX-VSW always-on transmission gate (5 V).
*   2. Bootstrap charging PMOS VDD->VBST gated by GN (ON when HS off).
*   3. On-chip MIM bootstrap capacitor for HF charge.
*   4. Input buffer -> RC delay -> AND/NOR dead-time logic.
*   5. Low-side CMOS output buffer -> GN2.
*   6. High-side cross-coupled level shifter (native 5 V NMOS pull-downs
*      for fast edges at 1.8 V gate drive) -> single strong floating
*      inverter -> GN.
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* VLX-VSW always-on transmission gate.
* NMOS conducts when VLX is low, PMOS conducts when VLX is high.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XNSW  VLX VDD VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 m=20
XPSW  VLX VSS VSW VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 m=20

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bootstrap charging PMOS: VDD -> VBST, gate=GN, bulk=VBST.
* GN=VLX (HS off) -> ON; GN=VBST (HS on) -> OFF.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XCHG  VBST GN VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 m=120

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* On-chip bootstrap capacitor (MIM 2 fF/um^2): 100 x 100 = 20 pF
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XCB   VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100 m=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Input buffer (two inverters)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XIP1  INB IN  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1
XIN1  INB IN  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 m=1
XIP2  INC INB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1
XIN2  INC INB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 m=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Dead-time RC delay: INC -> DLYN -> DLY -> DLYB
* res_high_po w=2 l=57 ~ 10 kohm (scaled from measured 2.47 kohm at l=14)
* cap_mim w=l=19 -> 0.72 pF; tau ~ 7.3 ns, delay to mid-rail ~ 5 ns
* Threshold inverter matched (r=1) so Vth_inv tracks VDD/2.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XR1   INC  DLYN VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=2 l=57
XC1   DLYN VSS  sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=19 l=19 m=1
XDP1  DLY  DLYN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4   m=1
XDN1  DLY  DLYN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1   m=1
XDP2  DLYB DLY  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 m=1
XDN2  DLYB DLY  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Dead-time logic
*   HSC = INC AND DLYB   (HS on after delay; HS off immediately)
*   LSC = NOR(INC, DLYB) (LS off immediately; LS on after delay)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* NAND(INC, DLYB) -> NAND, then INV -> HSC
XNA1  NAND INC  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1
XNA2  NAND DLYB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1
XNA3  NAND INC  ND1  VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1
XNA4  ND1  DLYB VSS  VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1
XHI1  HSC NAND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 m=1
XHI2  HSC NAND VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1
* NOR(INC, DLYB) -> LSC
XNO1  NR1 INC  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 m=1
XNO2  LSC DLYB NR1  VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 m=1
XNO3  LSC INC  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 m=1
XNO4  LSC DLYB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 m=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Low-side output driver: LSC -> LSCD -> LSC2 -> GN2
* LSCD is an RC-delayed copy of LSC that matches the high-side
* level-shifter latency so both dead-time edges land near mid-window.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XRLS  LSC  LSCD VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=2 l=50
XCLS  LSCD VSS  sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=12 l=12 m=1
XLP1  LSC2 LSCD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20  m=1
XLN1  LSC2 LSCD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10  m=1
XLP2  GN2  LSC2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=400 m=1
XLN2  GN2  LSC2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200 m=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Level-shifter input: HSC -> HSCD (RC delay) -> HSCB
* The RC on HSCD shifts both HS edges together so the dead-time
* pair stays centered after the two-stage floating buffer.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XRHS  HSC HSCD VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=2 l=20
XCHS  HSCD VSS  sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=5 m=1
XHB1  HSCB HSCD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 m=1
XHB2  HSCB HSCD VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Cross-coupled level shifter (5 V).
* Native NMOS pull-downs (Vth~0.04 V) so 1.8 V HSC/HSCB drive is hard.
*   HSC=1 -> out=0,   out_b=VBST
*   HSC=0 -> out=VBST, out_b=0
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XLS1  out_b out  VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40  m=1
XLS2  out   out_b VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40  m=1
XLS3  out   HSCD VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_05v0_nvt l=0.9 w=100 m=2
XLS4  out_b HSCB VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_05v0_nvt l=0.9 w=100 m=2

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Floating output buffer: out_b -> hs_a -> GN  (two inversions)
*   out_b=VBST (HSC=1) -> hs_a=VLX -> GN=VBST  (HS on)
*   out_b=0    (HSC=0) -> hs_a=VBST -> GN=VLX   (HS off)
* Stage 1: 5 V PMOS + native NMOS (out_b is VSS-referenced).
* Stage 2: 1.8 V CMOS referenced to VLX/VBST so Vgs,Vds <= Vcap.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XFL1  hs_a out_b VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10  m=1
XFL2  hs_a out_b VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_05v0_nvt l=0.9 w=50  m=2
XHP1  GN hs_a VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200 m=1
XHN1  GN hs_a VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 m=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Default pull-down on GN: on when VLX is low (startup / HS off).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XPD   GN VDD VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=1

.ends bootstrap_driver

* =========================================================
