XDS1 inx ns1 vdd vss inv_s
XCS1 vss ns1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=500 nf=1 m=1
XDS2 ns1 ndlys vdd vss inv_s
XCS2 vss ndlys vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=150 nf=1 m=1

* --- long delay (LS turn-on): inxb -> nl1 -> ndlyl ---
XDL1 inxb nl1 vdd vss inv_s
XCL1 vss nl1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=800 nf=1 m=1
XDL2 nl1 ndlyl vdd vss inv_s
XCL2 vss ndlyl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=1 m=1

* --- non-overlap ---
* hs_cmd = inx AND ndlys   (HS on after short delay, off immediately)
* ls_cmd = inxb AND ndlyl  (LS on after long delay, off immediately)
XNA1 inx ndlys nhs vdd vss nand2_s
XIH1 nhs hs_cmd vdd vss inv_s
XNA2 inxb ndlyl nls vdd vss nand2_s
XIH2 nls ls_cmd vdd vss inv_s

* --- low-side driver chain (VDD/VSS domain) ---
XLS1 ls_cmd ls1 vdd vss inv_m
XLS2 ls1 gn2i vdd vss inv_l
XRR2 gn2i GN2 sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po w=1 l=0.1 r=0

* --- bootstrap charging switch ---
* PMOS VDD->VBST, bulk=VBST. Gate driven by delayed level-shifter n2:
*   HS on:  nhg=VBST -> Vsg=0, OFF, blocks reverse VBST->VDD
*   HS off: nhg=0    -> Vsg=VDD, ON, charges Cboot to VDD
* Asymmetric delay keeps nhg high until VBST has fallen after HS turn-off,
* so the PMOS never turns on in reverse during the race.
XIBN n2 n2b vbst vlx inv_s
XICH n2b nhg vbst vlx inv_asym
XCHC vlx nhg vlx vlx sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=1 m=1
XCHG vbst nhg vdd vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=2 m=1

* --- level shifter (VDD/VSS -> VBST/VLX), 5V cross-coupled ---
* n1 = 0 when hs_cmd=1 (HS on), n1 = VBST when hs_cmd=0
XNLS hs_cmd hs_cmdb vdd vss inv_s
XNP1 n1 hs_cmd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=2 m=1
XNP2 n2 hs_cmdb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=2 m=1
XPP1 n1 n2 vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2 m=1
XPP2 n2 n1 vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2 m=1

* --- floating domain first stage (5V, input swings VSS..VBST) ---
XHV1 n1 hs0 vbst vlx inv_hv

* --- floating 1.8V buffers + output stage ---
XHB1 hs0 hs1 vbst vlx inv_m
XHB2 hs1 gni vbst vlx inv_l
XRRG gni GN sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po w=1 l=0.1 r=0

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver
* DUT: .subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* Single 1.8 V supply. Off-chip bootstrap capacitor (cboot, <= 100 nF) is
* connected between VBST and VLX through 2 nH / 5 mOhm wirebond parasitics
* (provided by the testbench). The on-chip charge pump regulates the floating
* bootstrap cap voltage to ~2.12 V so that, after the ~0.45 V gate-charge
* sag each on-time, vgs_avg stays inside [1.65 V, 1.85 V].
.param cboot=100n
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*==================================================================
* VDD domain: input buffer  (in0 = IN, in1 = ~IN)
*==================================================================
Xni1 in1 in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
Xpi1 in1 in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
Xni2 in0 in1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
Xpi2 in0 in1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
*==================================================================
* Dead-time generator (VDD domain):
*   hs = NOR(in1, ls_dly)     hs on when IN high and ls off for dead time
*   ls = NOR(in0, hs_dly)     ls on when IN low  and hs off for dead time
* NOR2: parallel nfets (out->vss) + series pfets (vdd->out)
*==================================================================
Xnoh1 n1a in1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.7 nf=1
Xnoh2 n1a ls_dly vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.7 nf=1
Xpoh1 midhs in1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.3 nf=1
Xpoh2 hs ls_dly midhs vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.3 nf=1
Xnd1 d1x hs vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
Xpd1 d1x hs vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
Xnd1b hs_dly d1x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
Xpd1b hs_dly d1x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1

Xnol1 n1b in0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.7 nf=1
Xnol2 n1b hs_dly vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.7 nf=1
Xpol1 midls in0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.3 nf=1
Xpol2 ls hs_dly midls vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.3 nf=1
Xnd2 d2x ls vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
Xpd2 d2x ls vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
Xnd2b ls_dly d2x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
Xpd2b ls_dly d2x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1

*==================================================================
* Low-side gate driver (VDD domain, rail-to-rail 0..1.8 V) -> GN2
*==================================================================
Xnlb1 g2i ls vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.7 nf=1
Xplb1 g2i ls vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
Xnlb2 GN2 g2i vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=10
Xplb2 GN2 g2i vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=10
*==================================================================
* Level shifter #1: hs/ls (VDD domain) -> fsh/fshb (floating, ~0..VBST)
*==================================================================
Xnls1 na hs vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xnls2 nb ls vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xpls1 nb na VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
Xpls2 na nb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
*==================================================================
* High-side floating buffer -> GN (pull-up to VBST, pull-down to VLX)
*==================================================================
Xmpu VBST Gpu GN VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10
Xmpd VLX fshb GN VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10
Xmsgpu VLX fshb Gpu VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10
Xmdgpu VBST VBST Gpu VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xcc fsh Gpu sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=5 mult=20
Xcb2 Gpu GN sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=2 l=2 mult=4
*==================================================================
* Charge pump (VSS referenced) -> BOOST rail (~2.7 V), clocked by ~IN
*==================================================================
Xcdp P in1 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10 mult=165
Xmpd1 VDD VDD P VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xmpd2 P P BOOST VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* Bootstrap startup path: pfet diode VDD -> VBST. Charges VBST at start-up (VLX=0)
* so floating level shifter #1 can latch; turns off once VBST > VDD (regulated).
Xdst vbst vbst vdd vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
*==================================================================
* Regulated bootstrap recharge switch: Mcharge drain=BOOST, source=VBST
* GGc gate control: kicked by ~IN, held by Switch A (fsh, HS on) and
* Switch B (nok_f, VBST at/above trip). Comparator sets ok (VDD domain)
* high while VBST < trip (~2.12 V); level shifter #2 -> nok_f.
*==================================================================
Xmnchg BOOST GGc VBST VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=16
Xmswa VLX fsh GGc VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=10
Xmswb VLX na2 GGc VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=10
Xck in1 GGc sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=6 l=6 mult=50
Xmdpu BOOST BOOST GGc VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
*==================================================================
* Comparator: trip VBST at ~2.12 V (sense ratio + VDD/2 reference)
*==================================================================
Xr1 S VBST VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=270 mult=1
Xr2 VSS S VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=200 mult=1
Xrf1 VREF VDD VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=200 mult=1
Xrf2 VSS VREF VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=200 mult=1
Xncpa outA S ta VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xncpb outB VREF ta VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xrtail VSS ta VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=200 mult=1
Xmpcpa outA outB vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xmpcpb outB outA vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xnok ok outB vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xpok ok outB vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xnnok nok ok vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xpnok nok ok vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
*==================================================================
* Level shifter #2: ok/nok (VDD domain) -> ok_f/nok_f (floating)
*==================================================================
Xnls2a na2 nok vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xnls2b nb2 ok vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xpls2a nb2 na2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
Xpls2b na2 nb2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver
* DUT pins: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*
* Architecture:
*   - VDD domain inverter: IN -> INb.
*   - Contention-free dead-time generation:
*     had = IN with slow rise (RC) and fast fall (inb pulldown)
*     hs_cmd = buffer(had) => HS on delayed, HS off immediate.
*     hbd = IN with fast rise (inb pullup) and slow fall (RC to IN)
*     lsb = buffer(hbd) => LS off immediate, LS on delayed (lsb active low).
*     GN2 = !lsb.
*   - Floating level shifter (VBST/VLX supplied, HV devices):
*     hs_cmd=1 pulls Q to VSS (LOW => HS on).
*     hs_cmdb=1 pulls QB to VSS (LOW => HS off via latch).
*   - HS output buffer (floating domain): GN = VBST (HS on) / VLX (HS off).
*   - LS output buffer (VDD domain): GN2 = VDD (LS on) / VSS (LS off).
*   - Bootstrap diode: PMOS source=VDD, gate=QB, drain=VBST.
*     QB=0 (HS off) => diode ON, charges VBST to VDD (Vc -> 1.8 V).
*     QB=VBST (HS on) => diode OFF, cap holds Vc, v(GN)-v(VSW) ~ Vc.

.param cboot=47n

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* ---------------- VDD domain: IN -> INb ----------------
XIP inb in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 mult=1
XIN inb in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 mult=1

* ---------------- dead-time path A: had (slow rise, fast fall) -> hs_cmd ----------------
XRH in had vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=20 mult=1
XHDN had inb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1 mult=1
XIH1 hcn had vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 mult=1
XIH2 hcn had vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 mult=1
XIH3 hs_cmd hcn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 mult=1
XIH4 hs_cmd hcn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 mult=1

* ---------------- dead-time path B: hbd (fast rise, slow fall) -> lsb ----------------
XHBUP hbd inb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1 mult=1
XRHb hbd in vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=20 mult=1
XIL1 lcn hbd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 mult=1
XIL2 lcn hbd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 mult=1
XIL3 lsb lcn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 mult=1
XIL4 lsb lcn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 mult=1

* ---------------- hs_cmdb = !hs_cmd (VDD domain) ----------------
XHC1 hs_cmdb hs_cmd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 mult=1
XHC2 hs_cmdb hs_cmd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 mult=1

* ---------------- floating level shifter (VBST/VLX supplied) ----------------
XMA q hs_cmd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 mult=1
XMB qb hs_cmdb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 mult=1
XPL1 q qb vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 mult=1
XPL2 qb q vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 mult=1

* weak DC paths on level-shifter outputs (fix OP singularity at startup)
XRQ q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=200 mult=1
XRQB qb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=200 mult=1

* ---------------- HS output buffer (floating domain) ----------------
XPGNu gn q vbst vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=80 nf=1 mult=1
XNGNd gn q vlx vlx sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=80 nf=1 mult=1

* ---------------- LS output buffer (VDD domain), inverts lsb -> GN2 ----------------
XLP2 gn2 lsb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1 mult=1
XLN2 gn2 lsb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1 mult=1

* ---------------- bootstrap diode VDD -> VBST (gate=QB) ----------------
XPDIODE vbst qb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1000 nf=1 mult=1

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver.
* DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
*   GN   high-side gate drive, floating domain (rail pair VBST/VSW)
*   GN2  low-side gate drive, VDD/VSS domain
*   VSW  Kelvin reference of the high-side source (switch node)
*   VLX  bootstrap return pad; tied to VSW on chip (wide TG jumper) so the
*        HS gate-loop return closes through the external VLX wirebond + cboot.
*
* Architecture:
*   dly    = RC-delayed copy of inb (poly R + MIM C), trip-symmetric inverter
*   hson   = AND(IN , delayed IN ) : HS on delayed Td after IN rise, off fast
*   lson   = AND(inb, delayed inb) : LS on delayed Td after IN fall, off fast
*   (hson and lson are mutually exclusive by construction -> no shoot-through)
*   Floating SR latch in the VBST/VSW domain drives the HS output taper:
*     SET   : hson rises while VSW~0 -> g5v0 NMOS pulls qb to VSW directly
*     RESET : hsonb rising edge (IN fall, VSW~1.8) coupled through a MIM cap
*             to a g5v0 NMOS gate referenced to VSW; bleeds back with ~10ns RC
*   Bootstrap charge switch (g5v0 PMOS VDD->VBST) on only while LS is on.
*
.param cboot=2200p

* ---------------- local helpers ----------------
.subckt bd_inv o i vp vm
XP o i vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XN o i vm vm sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
.ends bd_inv

.subckt bd_nand o a b vp vm
XP1 o a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XP2 o b vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XN1 o a nm vm sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XN2 nm b vm vm sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
.ends bd_nand

* ---------------- driver ----------------
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ===== VSW <-> VLX on-chip jumper (bootstrap gate-loop return) =====
XJN VSW VDD VLX VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=135
XJP VSW VSS VLX VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=135

* ===== input buffer and RC dead-time delay =====
XI1 inb IN VDD VSS bd_inv m=2
XR1 inb dly VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=12
XC1 dly VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10 m=6
* trip ~0.9V (symmetric rising/falling delay)
XP2s dlyb dly VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5
XN2s dlyb dly VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1

* ===== dead-time logic =====
* hson = AND(IN, delayed IN): rises Td after IN rise, falls with IN
XN1 n1 IN dlyb VDD VSS bd_nand
XI4 hson n1 VDD VSS bd_inv m=4
XI5 hsonb hson VDD VSS bd_inv m=8
* lson = AND(inb, delayed inb): rises Td after IN fall, falls with IN
XN2 n2 inb dly VDD VSS bd_nand
XI6 lson n2 VDD VSS bd_inv m=4
XI6b lsonb lson VDD VSS bd_inv m=2

* ===== floating SR latch (VBST/VSW domain) =====
XI7 qb q VBST VSW bd_inv m=2
XI8 q qb VBST VSW bd_inv m=2
* SET: fires at hson rise while VSW ~ 0 (low side was on)
XMSET qb hson VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=2
* RESET: hsonb rising edge coupled to a VSW-referenced pulse node
XC3 hsonb rp sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10 m=2
XR3 rp VSW VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=65
XRST q rp VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=2
* weak default reset defines the startup state (overpowered by XMSET)
XM0 q VDD VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=2 w=0.42

* ===== high-side output taper (floating domain) =====
XI9 f1 q VBST VSW bd_inv m=2
XI10 f2 f1 VBST VSW bd_inv m=6
XI11 f3 f2 VBST VSW bd_inv m=18
XPU GN f3 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=18
XPD GN f3 VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=14

* ===== low-side output taper (VDD/VSS domain) =====
XJ1 g1 lson VDD VSS bd_inv m=2
XJ2 g2 g1 VDD VSS bd_inv m=6
XJ3 g3 g2 VDD VSS bd_inv m=18
XLU GN2 g3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=12
XLD GN2 g3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=14

* ===== bootstrap charge switch: on only while the low side is on =====
* XSW gate (c4) must reach VBST to hold XSW off when VBST > VDD+|Vt|.
* lson (VDD domain) is level-shifted into the VBST/VSW domain:
*   XLSF  pulls lsf to VSW while lson=1.8 (works because VSW~0 then);
*   XPLSF weak pullup takes lsf to VBST when lson=0 (load = gates only);
*   XIV1/XIV2 buffer lsf push-pull onto c4:
*     lson=1 -> c4=VSW(=0)  -> XSW hard on  (charges cboot toward VDD)
*     lson=0 -> c4=VBST     -> XSW hard off (holds charge at any VBST)
XLSF lsf lson VSW VSW sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=4
XPLSF lsf VSW VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.42
XIV1 c4b lsf VBST VSW bd_inv
XIV2 c4 c4b VBST VSW bd_inv m=2
XSW VBST c4 VDD VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=200

* ===== on-chip supply/bootstrap decoupling =====
XC4 VBST VSW sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10 m=10
XC5 VDD VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10 m=10

.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* All-NMOS half-bridge bootstrap high-side gate driver.
* Topology:
*  - VLX pad tracks VSW through a damped transmission-gate tie, so the
*    bootstrap capacitor bottom plate follows the switch node.
*  - Two identical inverter-chain delay lines generate the dead time:
*    HSon = AND(delayed IN, IN), LSon = AND(delayed INB, INB) -> delayed
*    turn-on, immediate turn-off on both edges. The matched chains track
*    PVT, keeping the dead time stable.
*  - Capacitive pulse coupling level-shifts the HSon edges into the floating
*    (VBST/VLX) domain, where an SR latch holds the high-side state with no
*    static current.
*  - A low-Ron 5V PMOS switch charges the bootstrap cap from VDD while the
*    low-side FET conducts (VLX ~ 0), so the cap charges to ~VDD.
*  - Floating tapered buffer drives GN; ground-domain tapered buffer drives GN2.
* Geometry convention: w is the per-finger width, m is the finger count.
.param cboot=10n

* --- helper: minimum inverter -------------------------------------------
.subckt inv1 a y vd vs
XP0 y a vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XN0 y a vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
.ends inv1

* --- helper: tapered inverters -------------------------------------------
.subckt inv2 a y vd vs
XP0 y a vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36
XN0 y a vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
.ends inv2

.subckt inv3 a y vd vs
XP0 y a vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=2
XN0 y a vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5
.ends inv3

.subckt inv4 a y vd vs
XP0 y a vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=6
XN0 y a vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=3
.ends inv4

.subckt inv5 a y vd vs
XP0 y a vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=18
XN0 y a vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=9
.ends inv5

* --- helper: high-side output stage. Like inv5 but with a heavier pull-up:
* while VSW rises, the high-side gate needs continuous Cgs charge current
* (source follower action of the power FET), and the stronger P device keeps
* GN tracking VBST tightly instead of lagging ~1 V behind.
.subckt inv5h a y vd vs
XP0 y a vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=30
XN0 y a vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=9
.ends inv5h

* --- helper: 2-input NAND -------------------------------------------------
.subckt nand2 a b y vd vs
XP0 y a vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP1 y b vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XN0 y a mid vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XN1 mid b vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
.ends nand2

* --- helper: delay element (two inverters + MIM load cap ~80fF) -----------
.subckt dlyel a y vd vs
X0 a m vd vs inv1
X1 m y vd vs inv1
XC0 m vs sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=2 w=5 m=4
.ends dlyel

* --- helper: dead-time delay line (8 elements) ----------------------------
.subckt dlychain a y vd vs
XE0 a d1 vd vs dlyel
XE1 d1 d2 vd vs dlyel
XE2 d2 d3 vd vs dlyel
XE3 d3 d4 vd vs dlyel
XE4 d4 d5 vd vs dlyel
XE5 d5 d6 vd vs dlyel
XE6 d6 d7 vd vs dlyel
XE7 d7 y vd vs dlyel
.ends dlychain

* --- helper: shorter delay line (6 elements) for the HS turn-on path ------
* HSon arrives ~1 ns earlier than with the full chain so that GN is already
* rising when VSW crosses 0.9 V; since GN is driven from the bootstrap rail
* (which tracks VSW through the cap), an early GN rise keeps vgs ~ capv
* through the whole switch-node slew. This matters most for the 20 ns pulse.
.subckt dlychain6 a y vd vs
XE0 a d1 vd vs dlyel
XE1 d1 d2 vd vs dlyel
XE2 d2 d3 vd vs dlyel
XE3 d3 d4 vd vs dlyel
XE4 d4 d5 vd vs dlyel
XE5 d5 y vd vs dlyel
.ends dlychain6

* --- DUT ------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW
* Floating reference tracks the switch node (damped TG tie). Ron must be low
* enough that VLX tracks VSW through the 2nH bondwire into the (off-chip)
* bootstrap cap: tau ~ Ron*Cboot needs to be << the shortest on-time.
XTGN VSW VDD VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=200
XTGP VSW VSS VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=400
* While the low side conducts, this clamp pins VLX to ~0 and provides the
* return path for the bootstrap charging current (it supplements the TG tie
* while the charging pulse flows). It must release before the high side turns
* on. Gate takes a strong NON-INVERTED copy of LSon (buffered by the XLSD/
* XLSB pair): wiring it to the inverted copy was a bug that made it fight
* the TG tie during the high-side phase and drag VLX ~0.4 V below VSW.
XLSD LSON lsb1 VDD VSS inv4
XLSB lsb1 LSd VDD VSS inv4
XVLX0 VLX LSd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=80

* Input buffer / edge sharpening.
XI0 IN s1 VDD VSS inv1
XI1 s1 P VDD VSS inv1
XI2 P INB VDD VSS inv1

* Matched dead-time delay lines (HS chain two elements shorter, see above).
XDL1 P PD VDD VSS dlychain
XDL2 INB INBD VDD VSS dlychain

* HSon = AND(PD, P);  LSon = AND(INBD, INB).
XND1 PD P nh VDD VSS nand2
XI3 nh HSON VDD VSS inv1
XND2 INBD INB nl VDD VSS nand2
XI4 nl LSON VDD VSS inv2

* Pre-drive buffers.
XI5 LSON LS2 VDD VSS inv2
XI6 HSON hsd VDD VSS inv2
XI7 HSON HSONB VDD VSS inv1
XI8 HSONB hsd2 VDD VSS inv2

* Bootstrap charger. The pass switch must be junction-safe while VBST swings
* ~2 V above VDD during the high-side on-time, so it is an NMOS with bulk at
* VSS (both n+ junctions then stay reverse biased at any VBST) and its gate
* (pg) is bootstrapped above VDD each low-side phase:
*  - prp is a ~0.7 ns pulse at the start of the low-side phase; it kicks m3g
*    (precharged toward VDD-Vth by XPR2) up to ~2.4 V, and XPR precharges pg
*    toward m3g-Vth. When prp falls, m3g drops and XPR turns off, so it
*    cannot clamp pg back to VDD.
*  - boost cap XCB then kicks pg up further (phb is a delayed copy of LSon);
*    diode-connected XCL2 clamps pg to VDD + Vth, so MCHG charges VBST up to
*    VDD + Vth2 - VthMCHG + delta, ~ VDD. XCL2 and MCHG are matched LVT
*    devices at the same Vsb, so the threshold cancels and the final
*    bootstrap voltage tracks VDD over PVT (no overcharge of cboot).
*  - XDIS discharges pg during the high-side phase so MCHG is firmly off.
XD0 LSon ld1 VDD VSS dlyel
XD1 ld1 ld2 VDD VSS dlyel
XD2 ld2 ld3 VDD VSS dlyel
XD3 ld3 ld4 VDD VSS dlyel
XD4 ld4 ld5 VDD VSS dlyel
* prp = LSon AND NOT(ld3): a ~1.5 ns pulse at the start of the low-side
* phase, buffered by a strong inverter that drives the kick cap XCM3.
* The rising edge kicks m3g (precharged toward VDD-Vth by XPR2) up so XPR
* precharges pg; the falling edge (at ld3) kicks m3g back down, turning XPR
* off before the boost kick arrives (phb, from ld5, ~1 ns later). XPR2 then
* holds m3g at ~VDD-Vth during the low-side phase, and XDM3 bleeds m3g to 0
* during the high-side phase, so XPR never fights XDIS (no DC charging current).
XILD ld3 ld3b VDD VSS inv1
XNPD LSon ld3b nn VDD VSS nand2
XPP nn prp VDD VSS inv4
XPR2 VDD LSon m3g VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 m=16
XDM3 m3g HSON VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 m=4
XCM3 m3g prp sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=5 w=10 m=10
XPR VDD m3g pg VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 m=32
XPH2 ld5 pb1 VDD VSS inv4
XPH3 pb1 phb VDD VSS inv4
XCB pg phb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=5 w=10 m=60
XCL2 pg pg VDD VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 m=6
XDIS pg HSON VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 m=4
XCHG VBST pg VDD VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 m=800

* Capacitive level shift into the floating domain.
* hsd2 = HSON (set pulse on high-side turn-on), hsd = NOT HSON (reset pulse
* on high-side turn-off). The clamp diodes are diode-connected NMOS with the
* diode at the pulse node (anode=hs/kr, cathode=VLX): they clamp hs/kr to
* VLX+Vth after each kick; the coupling cap's return edge then pulls the node
* back below VLX, so the set/reset switches are always released.
XC0 hsd2 hs sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=5 w=10 m=3
XCL0 hs hs VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XC1 hsd kr sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=5 w=10 m=3
XCL1 kr kr VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84

* Set/reset switches and SR latch (floating domain).
XSET qb hs VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=2
XRST q kr VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 m=2
XLP1 qb q VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XLN1 qb q VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XLP2 q qb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XLN2 q qb VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1

* Floating high-side output buffer (referenced to VBST/VLX). Three
* inversions: driven from qb so that the SET latch state drives GN high.
XF0 qb f1 VBST VLX inv3
XF1 f1 f2 VBST VLX inv4
XF2 f2 GN VBST VLX inv5h

* Low-side output buffer.
XG0 LS2 g1 VDD VSS inv3
XG1 g1 g2 VDD VSS inv4
XG2 g2 GN2 VDD VSS inv5

* On-chip decoupling across the bootstrap rails (~8pF). The bondwire
* inductors and this cap form the resonator that rings the cap voltage at
* the switch-node edges; a LARGER cap here lowers the resonant impedance
* and reduces the overshoot amplitude.
XCD VBST VLX sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 l=10 w=10 m=80
.ends bootstrap_driver

taskTitle: Design an All-NMOS Half-Bridge Bootstrap High-Side Gate Driver
circuit:
* Bootstrap high-side gate driver, all-NMOS half-bridge, single 1.8V supply.
* SKY130, ngspice. DUT ports: GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW.
*
* Architecture
*  - Input buffer; xhigh-po-R / MIM-C delay lines set all timing. Each delay
*    line ends in a 3-stage taper that sharpens the slow RC ramp into a fast
*    edge (~0.5ns) needed by the capacitive level shift.
*  - hs_logic = IN OR delay(IN, h~2.7ns): holds the high side on briefly past
*    the IN falling edge (external VSW decays through the 3.6 ohm load with a
*    ~1.3ns tail).
*  - HS set pulse hset = AND(hs_logic, delay(hs_logic, D_lh)); HS reset at the
*    hs_logic falling edge (IN fall + h).
*  - LS on = NOR(hs_logic, delay(hs_logic, D_hl)): LS turns on D_hl after the
*    HS reset.
*  - Level shift into the floating VBST/VLX domain is capacitive (0.5pF MIM AC
*    coupling, 2.9k bleed to VLX): hset/nhs edges kick the SET/RESET nodes of
*    a floating SR latch made of two cross-coupled 5V inverters. A 2pF cap
*    from VDD to the reset node defines the power-up state (HS off) if the
*    supply ramps; the first-cycle edges resolve it otherwise.
*  - Floating tapered 5V output buffer drives GN from the VBST/VLX rails.
*  - Low-side driver: tapered 1.8V chain driving GN2.
*  - Bootstrap charging: 5V PMOS VDD->VBST, on exactly while the low side is
*    commanded on (loop closed through the LS FET). The charging / gate-drive
*    return loop is closed on-die by shorting VLX to VSW through a wide NMOS
*    (gate = VBST, on once the boot cap is charged; the HS bulk diode seeds
*    the first charge).
*  - On-chip MIM decoupling on VDD/VSS.
*
.param cboot=1.2n

.subckt bootstrap_driver GN GN2 IN VBST VDD VLX VSS VSW

* ---------------- input buffer ----------------
XN0 n_in1 IN  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP0 n_in1 IN  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XN1 s     n_in1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP1 s     n_in1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36
XN2 ns    s   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP2 ns    s   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36

* ---------------- delay line dh = delay(s, h), h ~ 2.7ns ----------------
XR_dh s dh_raw VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=2
XC_dh dh_raw VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=21
XN3 dhr1 dh_raw VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XP3 dhr1 dh_raw VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XN4 dh   dhr1   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP4 dh   dhr1   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XN4b dhx dh     VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP4b dhx dh     VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36

* ---------------- hs_logic = OR(s, dhx) = NAND(ns, dhx) ----------------
XN5 hsl ns   mid_a VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XN6 mid_a dhx VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP5 hsl ns   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP6 hsl dhx  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68

* ---------------- delay line d1 = delay(hsl, D_lh), D_lh ~ 3ns ----------------
XR_d1 hsl d1_raw VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=3
XC_d1 d1_raw VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=15
XN8 d1r1 d1_raw VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XP8 d1r1 d1_raw VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XN9 d1x  d1r1   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP9 d1x  d1r1   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XN9b d1  d1x    VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP9b d1  d1x    VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36

* ---------------- hs_set = NAND(hsl, d1); nhs = NOT hs_set ----------------
XN10 t_hs hsl mid_b VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XN11 mid_b d1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP10 t_hs hsl VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP11 t_hs d1  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XN12 hset t_hs VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36
XP12 hset t_hs VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72
XN13 nhs hset VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36
XP13 nhs hset VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72

* ---------------- delay line d1h = delay(hsl, D_hl), D_hl ~ 5.7ns ----------------
XR_h hsl d1h_raw VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=3
XC_h d1h_raw VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=32
XN14 d1hr1 d1h_raw VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XP14 d1hr1 d1h_raw VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XN14b d1h  d1hr1  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP14b d1h  d1hr1  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XN14c d1hx d1h    VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP14c d1hx d1h    VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36

* ---------------- lson = NOT hsl AND NOT d1h = NAND(nhsl, d1hx) ----------------
XN15 nhsl hsl VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP15 nhsl hsl VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XN16 t_ls nhsl mid_c VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XN17 mid_c d1hx VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP16 t_ls nhsl  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP17 t_ls d1hx  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XN18 lson t_ls VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP18 lson t_ls VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36

* ---------------- bootstrap charger: on while LS is on ----------------
XN19 gchg1 lson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP19 gchg1 lson VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36
XMC VBST gchg1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=6.5 m=120

* ---------------- low-side output driver ----------------
XN21 a1 lson VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP21 a1 lson VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36
XN22 a2 a1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36
XP22 a2 a1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72
XN23 a3 a2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72
XP23 a3 a2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72
XN24 GN2 a3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=6
XP24 GN2 a3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 m=10

* ---------------- on-die VLX<->VSW short (gate = VBST: on once booted) --------
XNS VSW VBST VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.5 m=50

* ---------------- VDD/VSS decoupling ----------------
XC_dec VDD VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=100

* ---------------- capacitive level shift into floating domain ----------------
XC_s hset sfl sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=17
XC_r nhs  rfl sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=17
XR_s sfl VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=8
XR_r rfl VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=8

* ---------------- floating SR latch (5V devices, rails VBST/VLX) --------------
* SET: sfl pulse pulls qb low -> q high -> HS on.
* RESET: rfl pulse pulls q low -> HS off.
XP30 q  qb VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2
XN30 q  qb VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1
XP31 qb q  VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2
XN31 qb q  VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=1
XM_set qb sfl VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20
XM_rst q  rfl VLX VLX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=25
XC_pwr VDD rfl sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=68

* ---------------- floating output buffer ----------------
XP32 ib1   qb    VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4
XN32 ib1   qb    VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=2
XP33 gdrv1 ib1   VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=2
XN33 gdrv1 ib1   VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=1
XP35 gdrv2 gdrv1 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=8
XN35 gdrv2 gdrv1 VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=4
XP36 gdrv  gdrv2 VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=28
XN36 gdrv  gdrv2 VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=16
XP34 GN gdrv VBST VBST sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=100
XN34 GN gdrv VLX  VLX  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=7 m=90

.ends bootstrap_driver
